            "text": "Project: Parking Garage Attendant System\r\n\r\nI'm building this in Python in GitHub Codespaces. Context: a busy multi-level city-centre parking garage where cars come and go all day. The attendant needs to check cars in, check them out, and charge the right fee — and by evening the transaction log is huge, so lookups can't degrade.\r\n\r\nBuild in this order, don't skip ahead:\r\n\r\nPhase 1 — Check-in/check-out + fee (get this exactly right first)\r\n\r\nCheck a car in (plate + timestamp), check it out (plate → compute duration).\r\nPart-hours round UP (1hr 1min = 2 hours charged).\r\nTiered rate: first hour at rate A, every additional hour at a lower rate B, capped at a daily maximum — a car parked all day never pays more than the cap.\r\nBuild this fee logic as its own isolated, testable unit (e.g. a RateCard class) before touching spots at all.\r\nWrite unit tests for: exactly 1 hour, 1 hour + 1 minute, multiple hours, and a stay long enough to hit the daily cap.\r\n\r\nPhase 2 — Spot types + no double-parking\r\n\r\nThree spot types: compact, standard, EV (EV has a charger). An EV vehicle must be assigned an EV spot — no exceptions. Decide and state your rule for whether compact/standard vehicles can overflow into the other's spots when their own type is full.\r\nAssigning a spot must be atomic — two check-ins can never be given the same spot.\r\nTests for: EV-only enforcement, spot exhaustion (no free spot of that type → check-in fails cleanly), no double-assignment.\r\n\r\nPhase 3 — Instant queries\r\n\r\n\"Is an EV spot free right now?\" must be an O(1)-ish lookup (e.g. a dict[SpotType, set[spot_id]] of free spots), not a scan of every spot.\r\n\"Find this car by plate\" must also be O(1)-ish (e.g. dict[plate, Ticket] for currently-parked cars) — never a linear search through the day's history.\r\nKeep the growing historical log completely separate from this active/live state, so log size never slows down check-in, check-out, or the two queries above.\r\n\r\nHow I want you to work with me:\r\n\r\nPropose the class design (Vehicle, Spot, Ticket, RateCard, ParkingGarage) first and wait for my confirmation before writing code.\r\nThen implement and test Phase 1 fully, pause, then Phase 2, pause, then Phase 3.\r\nGive me a simple CLI at the end so I can interactively check cars in/out and ask \"is an EV spot free.\"\r\nProject structure: /src (models.py, rate_card.py, garage.py, cli.py), /tests, and a README documenting my rounding rule and daily-cap policy.\r\nThis should work for any EV vehicles MUST get an EV spot (has a charger), no exceptions. If compact/standard spots of the exact type are full, allow overflow into the other of those two (never into EV). Reject check-in cleanly if no valid spot exists.\r\nCheck out a car by plate — compute duration from entry to now, rounding any partial hour UP to a full hour. Free the spot on checkout.\r\nAnswer \"is a spot of type X free right now?\" in O(1) — no scanning all spots.\r\nFind a currently parked car by plate in O(1) — no scanning the log.\r\nKeep a separate historical log of every completed transaction (entry/exit time, plate, spot, fee) that grows all day without ever slowing down check-in, check-out, or the two lookups above.\r\nGuarantee no double-parking — a spot can never be assigned to two cars at once.\r\n\r\nImplementation requirements:\r\n\r\nPython 3, no external dependencies beyond stdlib for the core logic.\r\nClass structure: Vehicle, Spot, SpotType (enum: COMPACT, STANDARD, EV), Ticket, RateCard (holds rates + calculate_fee(entry_time, exit_time)), ParkingGarage (orchestrates everything).\r\nData structures: dict[plate -> Ticket] for active cars, dict[SpotType -> set[spot_id]] for free spots by type, a separate list[Ticket] (or append-only log) for history.\r\nGarage config (number of levels, spots per level per type, rates, cap) should be passed in / configurable, not hardcoded — this must work for any garage.\r\nInclude a simple interactive CLI (cli.py) to check in, check out, query spot availability, and look up a car by plate.\r\nInclude a /tests folder with unit tests covering:\r\nFee calc: exactly 1 hour, 1hr 1min (rounds to 2hrs), multi-hour, hitting the daily cap.\r\nSpot logic: EV-only enforcement, overflow between compact/standard, spot exhaustion, no double-assignment.\r\nLookup: find car by plate, availability check reflects real-time state.\r\nInclude a README.md documenting: rounding rule, daily-cap policy (reset per 24hrs from entry — state this explicitly), and the compact/standard overflow rule you chose.\r\n\r\nProject structure:\r\n\r\n/src\r\n  models.py\r\n  rate_card.py\r\n  garage.py\r\n  cli.py\r\n/tests\r\n  test_rate_card.py\r\n  test_garage.py\r\nREADME.md\r\n\r\nBuild it end-to-end now: models → rate_card + tests → garage + tests → CLI → README.           "value": "## Proposed Class Design\n\n- `Vehicle`\n  - `plate: str`\n  - `vehicle_type: SpotType`\n\n- `SpotType`\n  - Enum values: `COMPACT`, `STANDARD`, `EV`\n\n- `Spot`\n  - `spot_id: str`\n  - `level: int`\n  - `spot_type: SpotType`\n  - `has_charger: bool`\n  - `occupied: bool`\n\n- `Ticket`\n  - `plate: str`\n  - `vehicle: Vehicle`\n  - `spot_id: str`\n  - `entry_time: datetime`\n  - `exit_time: datetime | None`\n  - `fee: Decimal | None`\n\n- `RateCard`\n  - `first_hour_rate`\n  - `additional_hour_rate`\n  - `daily_cap`\n  - `calculate_fee(entry_time, exit_time)`\n\n  Partial hours round up. The first charged hour uses rate A; every later charged hour uses rate B. The total is capped at the configured daily maximum.\n\n- `ParkingGarage`\n  - `active_tickets: dict[str, Ticket]`\n  - `free_spots: dict[SpotType, set[str]]`\n  - `spots: dict[str, Spot]`\n  - `history: list[Ticket]`\n  - Methods:\n    - `check_in(vehicle, entry_time)`\n    - `check_out(plate, exit_time)`\n    - `find_car(plate)`\n    - `is_spot_free(spot_type)`\n    - internal atomic spot assignment/release methods\n\n### Overflow Rule\n\nCompact and standard vehicles may overflow into each other’s spots when their preferred type is full. EV vehicles may only use EV spots. EV spots are never used by compact or standard vehicles.\n\n### Important Configuration Choice\n\nThe daily cap will apply per parking stay, measured from that ticket’s entry time. It does not depend on the historical log and does not reset based on the calendar date.\n\nPlease confirm this design, especially the compact/standard overflow rule. After confirmation, implementation should proceed in this order:\n\n1. Phase 1: `RateCard` and fee tests\n2. Pause for confirmation\n3. Phase 2: spots and atomic assignment\n4. Phase 3: O(1)-style indexes, history, CLI, and README\n\n## Ready-to-Paste Codespaces Prompt\n\n```text\nBuild this project incrementally and stop after each phase for my confirmation.\n\nProject: Parking Garage Attendant System\n\nWorkspace structure:\n\n/src\n  models.py\n  rate_card.py\n  garage.py\n  cli.py\n/tests\n  test_rate_card.py\n  test_garage.py\nREADME.md\n\nUse Python 3 and only the standard library. Implement RateCard in src/rate_card.py.\n2. Add focused unit tests in tests/test_rate_card.py for:\n   - exactly one hour\n   - one hour and one minute\n   - multiple hours\n   - a stay reaching the daily cap\n   - invalid or reversed timestamps if appropriate\n3. Add free-spot indexes using dict[SpotType, set[spot_id]].\n3. Keep completed tickets in a separate append-only history list.\n4. Ensure check-in, check-out, plate lookup, and availability checks do not scan the history.\n5. Add tests for:\n   - finding an active car by plate\n   - availability changing after check-in and checkout\n   - completed tickets appearing in history\n   - history remaining separate from active tickets\n6. Implement src/cli.py for:\n   - check-in\n   - check-out\n   - checking whether an EV spot is free\n   - checking whether any spot type is free\n   - finding a currently parked car\n7. Write README.md documenting:\n   - the rounding rule\n   - the per-stay daily-cap rule\n   - the compact/standard overflow rule\n   - configuration examples\n   - how to run the CLI\n   - how to run tests\n8.                 "text": "from dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\n\nclass SpotType(str, Enum):\n\tCOMPACT = \"compact\"\n\tSTANDARD = \"standard\"\n\tEV = \"ev\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Vehicle:\n\tplate: str\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\n\tdef __post_init__(self) -> None:\n\t\tif not self.plate.strip():\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"plate must not be empty\")\n\t\tif isinstance(self.vehicle_type, str):\n\t\t\tobject.__setattr__(self, \"vehicle_type\", SpotType(self.vehicle_type.lower()))\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Spot:\n\tspot_id: str\n\tlevel: int\n\tspot_type: SpotType\n\thas_charger: bool = False\n\toccupied: bool = False\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Ticket:\n\tplate: str\n\tvehicle: Vehicle\n\tspot_id: str\n\tentry_time: datetime\n\texit_time: datetime | None = None\n\tfee: Decimal | None = None\n",

          "edits": [
            [
              {
                "text": "from datetime import datetime, timedelta\nfrom decimal import Decimal, ROUND_CEILING\n\n\nclass RateCard:\n\t\"\"\"Tiered per-stay pricing with a configurable maximum charge.\"\"\"\n\n\tdef __init__(\n\t\tself,\n\t\tfirst_hour_rate: Decimal | int | str | float,\n\t\tadditional_hour_rate: Decimal | int | str | float,\n\t\tdaily_cap: Decimal | int | str | float,\n\t) -> None:\n\t\tself.first_hour_rate = Decimal(str(first_hour_rate))\n\t\tself.additional_hour_rate = Decimal(str(additional_hour_rate))\n\t\tself.daily_cap = Decimal(str(daily_cap))\n\t\tif min(self.first_hour_rate, self.additional_hour_rate, self.daily_cap) < 0:\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"rates and daily_cap must not be negative\")\n\n\tdef calculate_fee(self, entry_time: datetime, exit_time: datetime) -> Decimal:\n\t\tif exit_time < entry_time:\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"exit_time must not precede entry_time\")\n\t\tduration = exit_time - entry_time\n\t\tcharged_hours = int(\n\t\t\t(Decimal(duration.total_seconds()) / Decimal(timedelta(hours=1).total_seconds()))\n\t\t\t.to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_CEILING)\n\t\t)\n\t\tif charged_hours == 0:\n\t\t\treturn Decimal(\"0.00\")\n\n\t\tfee = self.first_hour_rate\n\t\tif charged_hours > 1:\n\t\t\tfee += Decimal(charged_hours - 1) * self.additional_hour_rate\n\t\treturn min(fee, self.daily_cap).quantize(Decimal(\"0.01\"))\n",
                "range": {

              {
                "text": "from datetime import datetime\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\n\nfrom .models import Spot, SpotType, Ticket, Vehicle\nfrom .rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nclass GarageError(Exception):\n\t\"\"\"Base exception for expected garage operation failures.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass VehicleAlreadyParkedError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass NoSpotAvailableError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass CarNotFoundError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass ParkingGarage:\n\tdef __init__(\n\t\tself,\n\t\tlevels: int,\n\t\tspots_per_level: Mapping[SpotType | str, int],\n\t\trate_card: RateCard,\n\t) -> None:\n\t\tif levels < 1:\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"levels must be at least 1\")\n\t\tnormalized_counts = {\n\t\t\tSpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type): count\n\t\t\tfor spot_type, count in spots_per_level.items()\n\t\t}\n\t\tif any(count < 0 for count in normalized_counts.values()):\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"spot counts must not be negative\")\n\n\t\tself.rate_card = rate_card\n\t\tself.spots: dict[str, Spot] = {}\n\t\tself.free_spots: dict[SpotType, set[str]] = {\n\t\t\tspot_type: set() for spot_type in SpotType\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor level in range(1, levels + 1):\n\t\t\tfor spot_type in SpotType:\n\t\t\t\tfor number in range(1, normalized_counts.get(spot_type, 0) + 1):\n\t\t\t\t\tspot_id = f\"L{level}-{spot_type.value.upper()}-{number}\"\n\t\t\t\t\tspot = Spot(\n\t\t\t\t\t\tspot_id=spot_id,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tlevel=level,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tspot_type=spot_type,\n\t\t\t\t\t\thas_charger=spot_type is SpotType.EV,\n\t\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\t\tself.spots[spot_id] = spot\n\t\t\t\t\tself.free_spots[spot_type].add(spot_id)\n\n\t\tself.active_tickets: dict[str, Ticket] = {}\n\t\tself.history: list[Ticket] = []\n\n\tdef check_in(self, vehicle: Vehicle, entry_time: datetime | None = None) -> Ticket:\n\t\tif vehicle.plate in self.active_tickets:\n\t\t\traise VehicleAlreadyParkedError(f\"{vehicle.plate} is already parked\")\n\n\t\tspot_type = self._spot_type_for(vehicle.vehicle_type)\n\t\tspot_id = next(\n\t\t\t(candidate for candidate in spot_type if self.free_spots[candidate]), None\n\t\t)\n\t\tif spot_id is None:\n\t\t\traise NoSpotAvailableError(\n\t\t\t\tf\"no spot available for {vehicle.vehicle_type.value} vehicle\"\n\t\t\t)\n\n\t\tselected_type = spot_type[0]\n\t\tselected_id = self.free_spots[selected_type].pop()\n\t\tspot = self.spots[selected_id]\n\t\tspot.occupied = True\n\t\tticket = Ticket(\n\t\t\tplate=vehicle.plate,\n\t\t\tvehicle=vehicle,\n\t\t\tspot_id=selected_id,\n\t\t\tentry_time=entry_time or datetime.now(),\n\t\t)\n\t\tself.active_tickets[vehicle.plate] = ticket\n\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef check_out(\n\t\tself, plate: str, exit_time: datetime | None = None\n\t) -> Ticket:\n\t\tticket = self.active_tickets.pop(plate, None)\n\t\tif ticket is None:\n\t\t\traise CarNotFoundError(f\"no active ticket for {plate}\")\n\t\tticket.exit_time = exit_time or datetime.now()\n\t\tticket.fee = self.rate_card.calculate_fee(ticket.entry_time, ticket.exit_time)\n\t\tspot = self.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\t\tspot.occupied = False\n\t\tself.free_spots[spot.spot_type].add(spot.spot_id)\n\t\tself.history.append(ticket)\n\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef int:\n\t\tnormalized_type = SpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type)\n\t\treturn len(self.free_spots[normalized_type])\n\n\t@staticmethod\n\tdef _spot_type_for(vehicle_type: SpotType) -> list[SpotType]:\n\t\tif vehicle_type is SpotType.EV:\n\t\t\treturn [SpotType.EV]\n\t\tif vehicle_type is SpotType.COMPACT:\n\t\t\treturn [SpotType.COMPACT,                 "text": "from datetime import datetime\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom .garage import CarNotFoundError, GarageError, ParkingGarage\nfrom .models import SpotType, Vehicle\nfrom .rate_card import RateCard\n\n\ndef build_default_garage() -> ParkingGarage:\n\treturn ParkingGarage(\n\t\tlevels=2,\n\t\tspots_per_level={SpotType.COMPACT: 10, SpotType.STANDARD: 15, SpotType.EV: 5},\n\t\trate_card=RateCard(Decimal(\"5.00\"), Decimal(\"3.00\"), Decimal(\"25.00\")),\n\t)\n\n\ndef main() -> None:\n\tgarage = build_default_garage()\n\tprint(\"Parking garage CLI. Commands: in, out, free, find, quit\")\n\twhile True:\n\t\ttry:\n\t\t\tcommand = input(\"> \").strip().lower()\n\t\texcept (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt):\n\t\t\tprint()\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\ttry:\n\t\t\tif command in {\"quit\", \"exit\"}:\n\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\tif command == \"in\":\n\t\t\t\tplate = input(\"Plate: \").strip()\n\t\t\t\tvehicle_type = SpotType(input(\"Type (compact/standard/ev): \").strip().lower())\n\t\t\t\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(plate, vehicle_type))\n\t\t\t\tprint(f\"Checked in at {ticket.spot_id} ({ticket.entry_time.isoformat()})\")\n\t\t\telif command == \"out\":\n\t\t\t\tticket = garage.check_out(input(\"Plate: \").strip())\n\t\t\t\tprint(f\"Fee: ${ticket.fee:.2f}\")\n\t\t\telif command == \"free\":\n\t\t\t\tvehicle_type = SpotType(input(\"Type (compact/standard/ev): \").strip().lower())\n\t\t\t\tprint(\"yes\" if garage.is_spot_free(vehicle_type) else \"no\")\n\t\t\telif command == \"find\":\n\t\t\t\tticket = garage.find_car(input(\"Plate: \").strip())\n\t\t\t\tprint(f\"{ticket.spot_id} since {ticket.entry_time.isoformat()}\" if ticket else \"Not parked\")\n\t\t\telse:\n\t\t\t\tprint(\"Unknown command\")\n\t\texcept (ValueError, GarageError) as error:\n\t\t\tprint(f\"Error: {error}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n\tmain()\n",

          "edits": [

              {
                "text": "# Parking Garage Attendant System\n\nA configurable Python parking garage system with tiered fees, EV-only charging\nspots, compact/standard overflow, and constant-time-style live lookups.\n\n## Policies\n\n- Partial hours round up: a stay of 1 hour and 1 minute is charged as 2 hours.\n- The first charged hour uses `first_hour_rate`; every later charged hour uses\n\t`additional_hour_rate`.\n- `daily_cap` is a per-stay maximum. It applies to the elapsed stay from entry\n\tto exit and is not tied to the calendar date.\n- Compact vehicles prefer compact spots and overflow into standard spots when\n\tneeded. Standard vehicles do the reverse. Neither type can use EV spots.\n- EV vehicles may use only EV spots.\n\n## Run tests\n\n```bash\npython -m pytest\n```\n\n## Run the CLI\n\n```bash\npython -m src.cli\n```\n\nThe default CLI configuration is only an example. `ParkingGarage` accepts the\nnumber of levels, spots per level by type, and a `RateCard`, so applications can\nprovide any garage configuration.\n\n## Design\n\nCurrently parked vehicles are stored in `active_tickets`, indexed by plate.\nFree spots are indexed by `SpotType` and spot ID. Completed tickets are appended\nto the separate `history` list, so historical log growth does not require scans\nfor check-in, checkout, plate lookup, or availability queries.\n\n## Stretch features\n\n1. Persist completed transactions and restore active state after a restart.\n2. Add reservations and a queue for full spot types.\n3. Add daily reports for revenue, occupancy, and average stay duration.",

                "text": "from datetime import datetime\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\n\nfrom .models import Spot, SpotType, Ticket, Vehicle\nfrom .rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nclass GarageError(Exception):\n\t\"\"\"Base exception for expected garage operation failures.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass VehicleAlreadyParkedError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass NoSpotAvailableError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass CarNotFoundError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass ParkingGarage:\n\tdef __init__(\n\t\tself,\n\t\tlevels: int,\n\t\tspots_per_level: Mapping[SpotType | str, int],\n\t\trate_card: RateCard,\n\t) -> None:\n\t\tif levels < 1:\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"levels must be at least 1\")\n\t\tnormalized_counts = {\n\t\t\tSpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type): count\n\t\t\tfor spot_type, count in spots_per_level.items()\n\t\t}\n\t\tif any(count < 0 for count in normalized_counts.values()):\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"spot counts must not be negative\")\n\n\t\tself.rate_card = rate_card\n\t\tself.spots: dict[str, Spot] = {}\n\t\tself.free_spots: dict[SpotType, set[str]] = {\n\t\t\tspot_type: set() for spot_type in SpotType\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor level in range(1, levels + 1):\n\t\t\tfor spot_type in SpotType:\n\t\t\t\tfor number in range(1, normalized_counts.get(spot_type, 0) + 1):\n\t\t\t\t\tspot_id = f\"L{level}-{spot_type.value.upper()}-{number}\"\n\t\t\t\t\tspot = Spot(\n\t\t\t\t\t\tspot_id=spot_id,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tlevel=level,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tspot_type=spot_type,\n\t\t\t\t\t\thas_charger=spot_type is SpotType.EV,\n\t\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\t\tself.spots[spot_id] = spot\n\t\t\t\t\tself.free_spots[spot_type].add(spot_id)\n\n\t\tself.active_tickets: dict[str, Ticket] = {}\n\t\tself.history: list[Ticket] = []\n\n\tdef check_in(self, vehicle: Vehicle, entry_time: datetime | None = None) -> Ticket:\n\t\tif vehicle.plate in self.active_tickets:\n\t\t\traise VehicleAlreadyParkedError(f\"{vehicle.plate} is already parked\")\n\n\t\tcandidate_types = self._spot_type_for(vehicle.vehicle_type)\n\t\tselected_type = next(\n\t\t\t(candidate for candidate in candidate_types if self.free_spots[candidate]), None\n\t\t)\n\t\tif selected_type is None:\n\t\t\traise NoSpotAvailableError(\n\t\t\t\tf\"no spot available for {vehicle.vehicle_type.value} vehicle\"\n\t\t\t)\n\n\t\tselected_id = self.free_spots[selected_type].pop()\n\t\tspot = self.spots[selected_id]\n\t\tspot.occupied = True\n\t\tticket = Ticket(\n\t\t\tplate=vehicle.plate,\n\t\t\tvehicle=vehicle,\n\t\t\tspot_id=selected_id,\n\t\t\tentry_time=entry_time or datetime.now(),\n\t\t)\n\t\tself.active_tickets[vehicle.plate] = ticket\n\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef check_out(\n\t\tself, plate: str, exit_time: datetime | None = None\n\t) -> Ticket:\n\t\tticket = self.active_tickets.pop(plate, None)\n\t\tif ticket is None:\n\t\t\traise CarNotFoundError(f\"no active ticket for {plate}\")\n\t\tticket.exit_time = exit_time or datetime.now()\n\t\tticket.fee = self.rate_card.calculate_fee(ticket.entry_time, ticket.exit_time)\n\t\tspot = self.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\t\tspot.occupied = False\n\t\tself.free_spots[spot.spot_type].add(spot.spot_id)\n\t\tself.history.append(ticket)\n\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef find_car(self, plate: str) -> Ticket | None:\n\t\treturn self.active_tickets.get(plate)\n\n\tdef is_spot_free(self, spot_type: SpotType | str) -> bool:\n\t\tnormalized_type = SpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type)\n\t\treturn bool(self.free_spots[normalized_type])\n\n\tdef available_spot_count(self, spot_type: SpotType | str) -> int:\n\t\tnormalized_type = SpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type)\n\t\treturn len(self.free_spots[normalized_type])\n\n\t@staticmethod\n\tdef _spot_type_for(vehicle_type: SpotType) -> list[SpotType]:\n\t\tif vehicle_type is SpotType.EV:\n\t\t\treturn [SpotType.EV]\n\t\tif vehicle_type is SpotType.COMPACT:\n\t\t\treturn [SpotType.COMPACT, SpotType.STANDARD]\n\t\treturn [SpotType.STANDARD, SpotType.COMPACT]\n",

WEB UI\r\n==================================================\r\n\r\nBuild a clean, modern parking garage dashboard.\r\n\r\nThe UI should have:\r\n\r\nHEADER:\r\nParking Garage Attendant System\r\n\r\nDASHBOARD CARDS:\r\n- Total Spots\r\n- Available Spots\r\n- Occupied Spots\r\n- Available EV Spots\r\n\r\nCHECK-IN SECTION:\r\n- License Plate input\r\n- Vehicle type dropdown:\r\n  Compact\r\n  Standard\r\n  EV\r\n- Check In button\r\n\r\nCHECK-OUT SECTION:\r\n- License Plate input\r\n- Check Out button\r\n\r\nSEARCH SECTION:\r\n- Search vehicle by plate\r\n- Show:\r\n  plate\r\n  vehicle type\r\n  spot\r\n  level\r\n  entry time\r\n  current status\r\n\r\nAVAILABILITY SECTION:\r\nShow:\r\n- Compact available\r\n- Standard available\r\n- EV available\r\n\r\nThere should be a clear indicator when an EV spot is available.\r\n\r\nTRANSACTION HISTORY:\r\nShow recent completed transactions with:\r\n- plate\r\n- vehicle type\r\n- spot\r\n- entry time\r\n- exit time\r\n- fee\r\n\r\nMake the UI responsive and visually clean.\r\n\r\nUse JavaScript fetch() to communicate with FastAPI.\r\n\r\nDo not reload the entire page for every action.\r\n\r\nShow success/error messages clearly.\r\n\r\n==================================================\r\n10. CLI\r\n==================================================\r\n\r\nKeep a simple CLI in:\r\n\r\nsrc/cli.py\r\n\r\nIt should allow an attendant to:\r\n\r\n1. Check in\r\n2. Check out\r\n3. Find vehicle by plate\r\n4. Check EV availability\r\n5. Show availability\r\n6. Exit\r\n\r\nThe web application is the main interface, but the CLI should also work.\r\n\r\n==================================================\r\n11. TESTS\r\n==================================================\r\n\r\nWrite comprehensive pytest tests.\r\n\r\nRateCard tests:\r\n\r\n- exactly 1 hour\r\n- 1 hour + 1 minute\r\n- 30 minutes\r\n- multiple hours\r\n- daily cap\r\n- invalid timestamps\r\n\r\nGarage tests:\r\n\r\n- successful check-in\r\n- successful checkout\r\n- EV vehicle gets EV spot\r\n- EV cannot use compact\r\n- EV cannot use standard\r\n- compact overflow into standard\r\n- standard overflow into compact\r\n- compact/standard cannot use EV\r\n- spot exhaustion\r\n- duplicate check-in rejected\r\n- no double assignment\r\n- checkout frees spot\r\n- active ticket lookup\r\n- EV availability updates correctly\r\n- historical transactions recorded separately\r\n\r\nAPI tests:\r\n\r\n- check-in endpoint\r\n- check-out endpoint\r\n- vehicle lookup endpoint\r\n- availability endpoint\r\n- invalid requests\r\n- unavailable spot response\r\n\r\nRun:\r\n\r\npytest -v\r\n\r\nDo not consider the project complete until the tests pass.\r\n\r\n==================================================\r\n12. README\r\n==================================================\r\n\r\nCreate a professional README explaining:\r\n\r\n- Project overview\r\n- Features\r\n- Architecture\r\n- Project structure\r\n- Installation\r\n- Running locally\r\n- Running in GitHub Codespaces\r\n- API endpoints\r\n- Fee calculation\r\n- Rounding rule\r\n- Daily cap policy\r\n- Spot assignment rules\r\n- Compact/standard overflow rule\r\n- EV restrictions\r\n- Complexity of important operations\r\n- Testing instructions\r\n- Example API requests\r\n\r\nClearly state:\r\n\r\n\"Partial hours are always rounded UP to the next whole charged hour.\"\r\n\r\nClearly state:\r\n\r\n\"The daily cap limits the total charge for one continuous parking stay.\"\r\n\r\nClearly state:\r\n\r\n\"EV vehicles can only use EV spots. Compact and Standard vehicles may overflow into each other's spots, but neither may use EV spots.\"\r\n\r\n==================================================\r\n13. CODE QUALITY\r\n==================================================\r\n\r\nFollow good engineering practices:\r\n\r\n- type hints\r\n- docstrings where useful\r\n- meaningful names\r\n- small functions\r\n- separation of concerns\r\n- no duplicated business logic\r\n- no unnecessary global state\r\n- clear error handling\r\n- no hardcoded garage capacity\r\n- no linear search through transaction history for active queries\r\n\r\nKeep business logic independent from FastAPI routes.\r\n\r\n==================================================\r\n14. RUN EVERYTHING\r\n==================================================\r\n\r\nAfter implementation:\r\n\r\n1. Install dependencies:\r\n\r\npip install -r requirements.txt\r\n\r\n2. Run tests:\r\n\r\npytest -v\r\n\r\n3. If tests fail:\r\n   - inspect the error\r\n   - fix the implementation\r\n   - rerun tests\r\n   - continue until all tests pass\r\n\r\n4. Start the web server:\r\n\r\nuvicorn src.api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000\r\n\r\nIf that command does not work because of the project structure, fix the project structure or command.\r\n\r\n5. Make sure port 8000 is forwarded publicly/privately through GitHub Codespaces.\r\n\r\n6. Open the forwarded port / browser preview so the web application is actually running and accessible.\r\n\r\n7. Verify the main UI works:\r\n   - open dashboard\r\n   - check in a vehicle\r\n   - check availability\r\n   - search vehicle\r\n   - check out vehicle\r\n   - verify fee\r\n   - verify spot becomes free\r\n   - verify transaction appears in history\r\n\r\n==================================================\r\n15. FINAL RESPONSE\r\n==================================================\r\n\r\nOnly after everything is implemented and tested, give me a concise summary containing:\r\n\r\n- What was built\r\n- Important files created\r\n- Test result\r\n- How to run it\r\n- The port the application is running on\r\n- Any URL/forwarded-port link available in Codespaces\r\n- Any assumptions made\r\n\r\nIMPORTANT:\r\nDo not stop at \"here is how you can implement it.\"\r\n\r\nActually create the files, write the code, run the tests, fix errors, start the server, and leave the application running in the Codespace.",

                "text": "from dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom uuid import uuid4\n\n\nclass SpotType(str, Enum):\n\tCOMPACT = \"compact\"\n\tSTANDARD = \"standard\"\n\tEV = \"ev\"\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Vehicle:\n\tplate: str\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\n\tdef __post_init__(self) -> None:\n\t\tif not self.plate.strip():\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"plate must not be empty\")\n\t\tif isinstance(self.vehicle_type, str):\n\t\t\tobject.__setattr__(self, \"vehicle_type\", SpotType(self.vehicle_type.lower()))\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Spot:\n\tspot_id: str\n\tlevel: int\n\tspot_type: SpotType\n\thas_charger: bool = False\n\toccupied: bool = False\n\tvehicle: Vehicle | None = None\n\tticket_id: str | None = None\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Ticket:\n\tplate: str\n\tvehicle: Vehicle\n\tspot_id: str\n\tentry_time: datetime\n\texit_time: datetime | None = None\n\tfee: Decimal | None = None\n\tticket_id: str = \"\"\n\n\tdef __post_init__(self) -> None:\n\t\tif not self.ticket_id:\n\t\t\tself.ticket_id = uuid4().hex[:12].upper()\n",

                "text": "from datetime import datetime\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nfrom threading import Lock\n\nfrom .models import Spot, SpotType, Ticket, Vehicle\nfrom .rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nclass GarageError(Exception):\n\t\"\"\"Base exception for expected garage operation failures.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass VehicleAlreadyParkedError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass NoSpotAvailableError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass CarNotFoundError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass ParkingGarage:\n\tdef __init__(\n\t\tself,\n\t\tlevels: int,\n\t\tspots_per_level: Mapping[SpotType | str, int],\n\t\trate_card: RateCard,\n\t) -> None:\n\t\tif levels < 1:\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"levels must be at least 1\")\n\t\tnormalized_counts = {\n\t\t\tSpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type): count\n\t\t\tfor spot_type, count in spots_per_level.items()\n\t\t}\n\t\tif any(count < 0 for count in normalized_counts.values()):\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"spot counts must not be negative\")\n\n\t\tself.rate_card = rate_card\n\t\tself.spots: dict[str, Spot] = {}\n\t\tself.free_spots: dict[SpotType, set[str]] = {\n\t\t\tspot_type: set() for spot_type in SpotType\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor level in range(1, levels + 1):\n\t\t\tfor spot_type in SpotType:\n\t\t\t\tfor number in range(1, normalized_counts.get(spot_type, 0) + 1):\n\t\t\t\t\tspot_id = f\"L{level}-{spot_type.value.upper()}-{number}\"\n\t\t\t\t\tspot = Spot(\n\t\t\t\t\t\tspot_id=spot_id,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tlevel=level,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tspot_type=spot_type,\n\t\t\t\t\t\thas_charger=spot_type is SpotType.EV,\n\t\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\t\tself.spots[spot_id] = spot\n\t\t\t\t\tself.free_spots[spot_type].add(spot_id)\n\n\t\tself.active_tickets: dict[str, Ticket] = {}\n\t\tself.history: list[Ticket] = []\n\t\tself._lock = Lock()\n\n\tdef check_in(self, vehicle: Vehicle, entry_time: datetime | None = None) -> Ticket:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tif vehicle.plate in self.active_tickets:\n\t\t\t\traise VehicleAlreadyParkedError(f\"{vehicle.plate} is already parked\")\n\n\t\t\tcandidate_types = self._spot_type_for(vehicle.vehicle_type)\n\t\t\tselected_type = next(\n\t\t\t\t(candidate for candidate in candidate_types if self.free_spots[candidate]), None\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tif selected_type is None:\n\t\t\t\traise NoSpotAvailableError(\n\t\t\t\t\tf\"no spot available for {vehicle.vehicle_type.value} vehicle\"\n\t\t\t\t)\n\n\t\t\tselected_id = self.free_spots[selected_type].pop()\n\t\t\tspot = self.spots[selected_id]\n\t\t\tticket = Ticket(\n\t\t\t\tplate=vehicle.plate,\n\t\t\t\tvehicle=vehicle,\n\t\t\t\tspot_id=selected_id,\n\t\t\t\tentry_time=entry_time or datetime.now(),\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tspot.occupied = True\n\t\t\tspot.vehicle = vehicle\n\t\t\tspot.ticket_id = ticket.ticket_id\n\t\t\tself.active_tickets[vehicle.plate] = ticket\n\t\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef check_out(\n\t\tself, plate: str, exit_time: datetime | None = None\n\t) -> Ticket:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tticket = self.active_tickets.pop(plate, None)\n\t\t\tif ticket is None:\n\t\t\t\traise CarNotFoundError(f\"no active ticket for {plate}\")\n\t\t\tticket.exit_time = exit_time or datetime.now()\n\t\t\tticket.fee = self.rate_card.calculate_fee(ticket.entry_time, ticket.exit_time)\n\t\t\tspot = self.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\t\t\tspot.occupied = False\n\t\t\tspot.vehicle = None\n\t\t\tspot.ticket_id = None\n\t\t\tself.free_spots[spot.spot_type].add(spot.spot_id)\n\t\t\tself.history.append(ticket)\n\t\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef find_car(self, plate: str) -> Ticket | None:\n\t\treturn self.active_tickets.get(plate)\n\n\tdef is_spot_free(self, spot_type: SpotType | str) -> bool:\n\t\tnormalized_type = SpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type)\n\t\treturn bool(self.free_spots[normalized_type])\n\n\tdef available_spot_count(self, spot_type: SpotType | str) -> int:\n\t\tnormalized_type = SpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type)\n\t\treturn len(self.free_spots[normalized_type])\n\n\t@staticmethod\n\tdef _spot_type_for(vehicle_type: SpotType) -> list[SpotType]:\n\t\tif vehicle_type is SpotType.EV:\n\t\t\treturn [SpotType.EV]\n\t\tif vehicle_type is SpotType.COMPACT:\n\t\t\treturn [SpotType.COMPACT, SpotType.STANDARD]\n\t\treturn [SpotType.STANDARD, SpotType.COMPACT]\n",

                "text": "from datetime import datetime\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, Field\n\nfrom .garage import CarNotFoundError, NoSpotAvailableError, ParkingGarage, VehicleAlreadyParkedError\nfrom .models import SpotType, Ticket, Vehicle\nfrom .rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nBASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n\n\ndef build_garage() -> ParkingGarage:\n\treturn ParkingGarage(\n\t\tlevels=3,\n\t\tspots_per_level={SpotType.COMPACT: 10, SpotType.STANDARD: 15, SpotType.EV: 5},\n\t\trate_card=RateCard(50, 30, 200),\n\t)\n\n\ngarage = build_garage()\napp = FastAPI(title=\"Parking Garage Attendant System\", version=\"1.0.0\")\n\n\nclass CheckInRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\tentry_time: datetime | None = None\n\n\nclass CheckOutRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\texit_time: datetime | None = None\n\n\ndef ticket_data(ticket: Ticket, include_exit: bool = False) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tspot = garage.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\tdata: dict[str, object] = {\n\t\t\"ticket_id\": ticket.ticket_id,\n\t\t\"plate\": ticket.plate,\n\t\t\"vehicle_type\": ticket.vehicle.vehicle_type.value,\n\t\t\"spot_id\": ticket.spot_id,\n\t\t\"level\": spot.level,\n\t\t\"entry_time\": ticket.entry_time.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"status\": \"completed\" if ticket.exit_time else \"parked\",\n\t}\n\tif include_exit:\n\t\tdata[\"exit_time\"] = ticket.exit_time.isoformat() if ticket.exit_time else None\n\t\tdata[\"fee\"] = str(ticket.fee) if ticket.fee is not None else None\n\treturn data\n\n\ndef error_response(error: Exception) -> HTTPException:\n\tif isinstance(error, VehicleAlreadyParkedError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, NoSpotAvailableError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, CarNotFoundError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(error))\n\treturn HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(error))\n\n\n@app.get(\"/\", response_class=FileResponse)\ndef index() -> FileResponse:\n\treturn FileResponse(BASE_DIR / \"templates\" / \"index.html\")\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check-in\", status_code=201)\ndef check_in(payload: CheckInRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tvehicle = Vehicle(payload.plate.strip().upper(), payload.vehicle_type)\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.check_in(vehicle, payload.entry_time))}\n\texcept (ValueError, VehicleAlreadyParkedError, NoSpotAvailableError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check-out\")\ndef check_out(payload: CheckOutRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.check_out(payload.plate.strip().upper(), payload.exit_time), True)}\n\texcept (ValueError, CarNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/vehicle/{plate}\")\ndef vehicle_lookup(plate: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tticket = garage.find_car(plate.strip().upper())\n\tif ticket is None:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"vehicle is not currently parked\")\n\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(ticket)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability\")\ndef availability() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tcounts = {spot_type.value: garage.available_spot_count(spot_type) for spot_type in SpotType}\n\treturn {\"available\": counts, \"total\": len(garage.spots), \"occupied\": len(garage.active_tickets)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability/{spot_type}\")\ndef type_availability(spot_type: SpotType) -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\"spot_type\": spot_type.value, \"available\": garage.available_spot_count(spot_type), \"is_free\": garage.is_spot_free(spot_type)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/transactions\")\ndef transactions() -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\"transactions\": [ticket_data(ticket, True) for ticket in reversed(garage.history)]}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tavailability_data = availability()\n\treturn {\n\t\t**availability_data,\n\t\t\"active_vehicles\": len(garage.active_tickets),\n\t\t\"completed_transactions\": len(garage.history),\n\t\t\"ev_available\": garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.EV),\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/static/{asset_path:path}\")\ndef static_asset(asset_path: str) -> FileResponse:\n\tpath = BASE_DIR / \"static\" / asset_path\n\tif not path.is_file() or BASE_DIR not in path.resolve().parents:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"asset not found\")\n\treturn FileResponse(path)",

                "text": "const $ = (selector) => document.querySelector(selector);\nconst api = async (url, options = {}) => { const response = await fetch(url, {headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, ...options}); const data = await response.json(); if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.detail || 'Request failed'); return data; };\nconst showMessage = (text, error = false) => { const node = $('#message'); node.textContent = text; node.className = `message show${error ? ' error' : ''}`; setTimeout(() => { node.className = 'message'; }, 5000); };\nconst formatTime = (value) => value ? new Date(value).toLocaleString([], {month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}) : '—';\nasync function refresh() { const dashboard = await api('/api/dashboard'); $('#total-spots').textContent = dashboard.total; $('#available-spots').textContent = Object.values(dashboard.available).reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0); $('#occupied-spots').textContent = dashboard.occupied; $('#ev-spots').textContent = dashboard.available.ev; $('#ev-status').textContent = dashboard.ev_available ? 'Charger ready' : 'All occupied'; $('#updated').textContent = `Updated ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})}`; $('#availability').innerHTML = Object.entries(dashboard.available).map(([type,count]) => `<div class=\"availability-item ${type === 'ev' ? 'ev' : ''}\"><strong>${count}</strong><span>${type} available</span></div>`).join(''); const history = await api('/api/transactions'); $('#transaction-count').textContent = `${history.transactions.length} completed`; $('#history-body').innerHTML = history.transactions.slice(0, 12).map(t => `<tr><td><strong>${t.plate}</strong></td><td><span class=\"type\">${t.vehicle_type}</span></td><td>${t.spot_id}</td><td>${formatTime(t.entry_time)}</td><td>${formatTime(t.exit_time)}</td><td class=\"money-cell\">$${Number(t.fee).toFixed(2)}</td></tr>`).join('') || '<tr><td colspan=\"6\">No completed transactions yet.</td></tr>'; }\n$('#check-in-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const form = new FormData(event.target); try { const data = await api('/api/check-in', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({plate: form.get('plate'), vehicle_type: form.get('vehicle_type')})}); showMessage(`${data.ticket.plate} assigned to ${data.ticket.spot_id}`); event.target.reset(); await refresh(); } catch (error) { showMessage(error.message, true); } });\n$('#check-out-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const form = new FormData(event.target); try { const data = await api('/api/check-out', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({plate: form.get('plate')})}); showMessage(`${data.ticket.plate} checked out. Fee: $${Number(data.ticket.fee).toFixed(2)}`); event.target.reset(); await refresh(); } catch (error) { showMessage(error.message, true); } });\n$('#search-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const plate = new FormData(event.target).get('plate'); try { const data = await api(`/api/vehicle/${encodeURIComponent(plate)}`); const t = data.ticket; $('#search-result').className = 'search-result'; $('#search-result').innerHTML = `<strong>${t.plate}</strong>${t.vehicle_type.toUpperCase()} · ${t.spot_id} · Level ${t.level}<br>Parked since ${formatTime(t.entry_time)}`; } catch (error) { $('#search-result').className = 'search-result empty'; $('#search-result').textContent = error.message; } });\nrefresh().catch(error => showMessage(error.message, true));",

                "text": "from datetime import datetime\n\nimport pytest\nfrom fastapi.testclient import TestClient\n\nfrom src import api\nfrom src.garage import ParkingGarage\nfrom src.models import TestClient:\n\tmonkeypatch.setattr(\n\t\tapi,\n\t\t\"garage\",\n\t\tParkingGarage(\n\t\t\tlevels=1,\n\t\t\tspots_per_level={SpotType.COMPACT: 1, SpotType.STANDARD: 1, SpotType.EV: 1},\n\t\t\trate_card=RateCard(5, 3, 25),\n\t\t),\n\t)\n\treturn TestClient(api.app)\n\n\ndef test_dashboard_and_check_in(client: TestClient) -> None:\n\tresponse = client.get(\"/api/dashboard\")\n\tassert response.status_code == 200\n\tassert response.json()[\"total\"] == 3\n\n\tresponse = client.post(\n\t\t\"/api/check-in\",\n\t\tjson={\"plate\": \"abc123\", \"vehicle_type\": \"ev\", \"entry_time\": \"2026-01-01T08:00:00\"},\n\t)\n\tassert response.status_code == 201\n\tassert response.json()[\"ticket\"][\"spot_id\"].startswith(\"L1-EV\")\n\n\ndef test_lookup_availability_and_checkout(client: TestClient) -> None:\n\tclient.post(\n\t\t\"/api/check-in\",\n\t\tjson={\"plate\": \"CAR9\", \"vehicle_type\": \"compact\", \"entry_time\": \"2026-01-01T08:00:00\"},\n\t)\n\tassert client.get(\"/api/vehicle/car9\").status_code == 200\n\tassert client.get(\"/api/spots/availability/ev\").json()[\"is_free\"] is True\n\tcheckout = client.post(\n\t\t\"/api/check-out\",\n\t\tjson={\"plate\": \"CAR9\", \"exit_time\": \"2026-01-01T09:01:00\"},\n\t)\n\tassert checkout.status_code == 200\n\tassert checkout.json()[\"ticket\"][\"fee\"] == \"8.00\"\n\tassert len(client.get(\"/api/transactions\").json()[\"transactions\"]) == 1\n\n\ndef test_invalid_and_unavailable_requests(client: TestClient) -> None:\n\tassert           "edits": [
            [
              {
                "text": "# Parking Garage Attendant System\n\nA complete FastAPI web application and CLI for a configurable parking garage\nwith tiered fees, EV-only charging spots, compact/standard overflow, and\nconstant-time-style live lookups.\n\n## Features\n\n- Live check-in, check-out, plate lookup, availability, and transaction history.\n- Responsive dashboard served by FastAPI with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.\n- Atomic in-memory spot assignment protected for concurrent requests.\n- Configurable levels, spot counts, rates, and per-stay daily cap.\n\n## Policies\n\n- Partial hours round up: a stay of 1 hour and 1 minute is charged as 2 hours.\n- The first charged hour uses `first_hour_rate`; every later charged hour uses\n\t`additional_hour_rate`.\n- `daily_cap` is a per-stay maximum. It applies to the elapsed stay from entry\n\tto exit and is not tied to the calendar date.\n- Compact vehicles prefer compact spots and overflow into standard spots when\n\tneeded. Standard vehicles do the reverse. Neither type can use EV spots.\n- EV vehicles may use only EV spots.\n\n## Run tests\n\n```bash\npython3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt\npython3 -m pytest -v\n```\n\n## Run the web application\n\n```bash\nuvicorn src.api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000\n```\n\nIn GitHub Codespaces, open the forwarded port `8000` in the Ports panel. The\nroot page is the attendant dashboard.\n\nYou can also run `python3 run.py`.\n\n## API\n\n- `POST /api/check-in` with `{\"plate\":\"ABC123\",\"vehicle_type\":\"ev\"}`\n- `POST /api/check-out` with `{\"plate\":\"ABC123\"}`\n- `GET /api/vehicle/{plate}`\n- `GET /api/spots/availability`\n- `GET /api/spots/availability/{spot_type}`\n- `GET /api/transactions`\n- `GET /api/dashboard`\n\nThe API returns `409` for duplicate check-ins and unavailable compatible spots,\n`404` for missing active vehicles, and `422` for invalid request data.\n\n## Architecture\n\n`models.py`, `rate_card.py`, and `garage.py` contain framework-independent\nbusiness logic. `api.py` adapts those objects to HTTP. The browser dashboard\nuses `fetch()` and updates only affected regions after each action. Active\nvehicles use `dict[plate, Ticket]`; free spots use\n`dict[SpotType, set[spot_id]]`; completed transactions stay in a separate\nappend-only list. These live operations do not scan transaction history.\n\n## Run the CLI\n\n```bash\npython -m src.cli\n```\n\nThe default CLI configuration is only an example. `ParkingGarage` accepts the\nnumber of levels, spots per level by type, and a `RateCard`, so applications can\nprovide any garage configuration.\n\n## Design\n\nCurrently parked vehicles are stored in `active_tickets`, indexed by plate.\nFree spots are indexed by `SpotType` and spot ID. Completed tickets are appended\nto the separate `history` list, so historical log growth does not require scans\nfor check-in, checkout, plate lookup, or availability queries.\n\n## Stretch features\n\n1. Persist completed transactions and restore active state after a restart.\n2. Add reservations and a queue for full spot types.\n3. Add daily reports for revenue, occupancy, and average stay duration.",

PHASE 1 — FEE CALCULATION\r\n==================================================\r\n\r\nImplement RateCard as an isolated, testable unit BEFORE coupling it to parking spots.\r\n\r\nRules:\r\n\r\n- Parking duration is calculated from entry_time to exit_time.\r\n- Any partial hour rounds UP.\r\n\r\nExamples:\r\n\r\nExactly 1 hour:\r\n→ 1 charged hour\r\n\r\n1 hour 1 minute:\r\n→ 2 charged hours\r\n\r\n2 hours 1 minute:\r\n→ 3 charged hours\r\n\r\n30 minutes:\r\n→ 1 charged hour\r\n\r\nUse ceiling logic correctly.\r\n\r\nPricing:\r\n\r\nFirst charged hour:\r\nfirst_hour_rate\r\n\r\nEvery additional charged hour:\r\nextra_hour_rate\r\n\r\nExample:\r\n\r\nfirst_hour_rate = 50\r\nextra_hour_rate = 30\r\n\r\n1 hour = 50\r\n2 hours = 80\r\n3 hours = 110\r\n4 hours = 140\r\n\r\nDaily cap:\r\n\r\nThe fee must never exceed daily_cap.\r\n\r\nExample:\r\n\r\nfirst_hour_rate = 50\r\nextra_hour_rate = 30\r\ndaily_cap = 200\r\n\r\nAny calculated fee above 200 becomes 200.\r\n\r\nDocument the policy clearly in README.\r\n\r\nUse the following interpretation:\r\nThe daily cap applies to a continuous parking stay and limits the total charge for that stay. It does not require scanning historical transactions.\r\n\r\nHandle invalid timestamps safely, such as exit_time earlier than entry_time.\r\n\r\n==================================================\r\n5. PHASE 2 — PARKING SPOTS\r\n==================================================\r\n\r\nSupport:\r\n\r\nCOMPACT\r\nSTANDARD\r\nEV\r\n\r\nEV vehicles MUST be assigned to EV spots.\r\n\r\nEV vehicles must NEVER be assigned to compact or standard spots.\r\n\r\nEV spots must have charger information.\r\n\r\nOverflow rule:\r\n\r\n- Compact vehicle:\r\n  1. Try COMPACT\r\n  2. If no compact spot is available, use STANDARD\r\n  3. Never use EV\r\n\r\n- Standard vehicle:\r\n  1. Try STANDARD\r\n  2. If no standard spot is available, use COMPACT\r\n  3.             "text": "Before adding anything new, investigate and fix this bug: when I check a\r\ncar in and immediately check it out (near-zero duration), the fee charged\r\nis showing as the full daily_cap instead of the first_hour_rate. Trace\r\nthrough the fee calculation for a near-instant stay, write a regression\r\ntest for \"check-in and check-out within the same minute charges\r\nfirst_hour_rate, not daily_cap\", and fix the underlying logic. Show me the\r\nbefore/after.\r\n\r\nOnce that's fixed and tests still pass, restructure the web UI (currently\r\none long page) into tabs, and add these features:\r\n\r\n1. TABS:\r\n   - \"Dashboard\" — the live stats cards (total/available/occupied/EV free)\r\n     plus a compact recent-activity feed.\r\n   - \"Check In / Check Out\" — the existing forms, cleaned up: show a live\r\n     preview of which spot type will be assigned before submitting, and a\r\n     clear success/error toast instead of a plain text line.\r\n   - \"Search & History\" — the \"Locate a vehicle\" search, plus the full\r\n     transaction history table with: a text filter (by plate), a date\r\n     range filter, and pagination (don't render the whole history at once\r\n     if it grows large).\r\n   - \"Reports\" — new tab with: total revenue today, total revenue this\r\n     week, current occupancy % by spot type (compact/standard/EV) as a\r\n     simple bar or donut visualization, and average stay duration across\r\n     completed transactions.\r\n\r\n2. UX polish:\r\n   - Add loading states for every action (check-in, check-out, search) so\r\n     the UI never looks frozen while waiting on the backend.\r\n   - Add inline validation (e.g. reject an empty plate before hitting the\r\n     API, show which field is wrong).\r\n   - Add empty states for when there's no history yet / no matching search\r\n     results, instead of a blank area.\r\n   - Make the \"EV spots free\" card visually distinct from the two other\r\n     spot-type cards (color, icon, or a small charger glyph) since it's\r\n     the one rule with zero exceptions in this system.\r\n   - Keep the whole thing responsive — usable on a narrower window, not\r\n     just full-width desktop.\r\n\r\n3. Don't change the underlying RateCard/ParkingGarage class logic or the\r\n   O(1) lookup structures — this is a frontend/API-layer change plus the\r\n   one bug fix above, not a redesign of Phase 1-3.\r\n\r\nRun the full test suite at the end and confirm everything still passes,\r\nincluding the new regression test.",
            "kind": "text"
          }
        ],
        "text": "Before adding anything new, investigate and fix this bug: when I check a\r\ncar in and immediately check it out (near-zero duration), the fee charged\r\nis showing as the full daily_cap instead of the first_hour_rate. Trace\r\nthrough the fee calculation for a near-instant stay, write a regression\r\ntest for \"check-in and check-out within the same minute charges\r\nfirst_hour_rate, not daily_cap\", and fix the underlying logic. Show me the\r\nbefore/after.\r\n\r\nOnce that's fixed and tests still pass, restructure the web UI (currently\r\none long page) into tabs, and add these features:\r\n\r\n1. TABS:\r\n   - \"Dashboard\" — the live stats cards (total/available/occupied/EV free)\r\n     plus a compact recent-activity feed.\r\n   - \"Check In / Check Out\" — the existing forms, cleaned up: show a live\r\n     preview of which spot type will be assigned before submitting, and a\r\n     clear success/error toast instead of a plain text line.\r\n   - \"Search & History\" — the \"Locate a vehicle\" search, plus the full\r\n     transaction history table with: a text filter (by plate), a date\r\n     range filter, and pagination (don't render the whole history at once\r\n     if it grows large).\r\n   - \"Reports\" — new tab with: total revenue today, total revenue this\r\n     week, current occupancy % by spot type (compact/standard/EV) as a\r\n     simple bar or donut visualization, and average stay duration across\r\n     completed transactions.\r\n\r\n2. UX polish:\r\n   - Add loading states for every action (check-in, check-out, search) so\r\n     the UI never looks frozen while waiting on the backend.\r\n   - Add inline validation (e.g. reject an empty plate before hitting the\r\n     API, show which field is wrong).\r\n   - Add empty states for when there's no history yet / no matching search\r\n     results, instead of a blank area.\r\n   - Make the \"EV spots free\" card visually distinct from the two other\r\n     spot-type cards (color, icon, or a small charger glyph) since it's\r\n     the one rule with zero exceptions in this system.\r\n   - Keep the whole thing responsive — usable on a narrower window, not\r\n     just full-width desktop.\r\n\r\n3. Don't change the underlying RateCard/ParkingGarage class logic or the\r\n   O(1) lookup structures — this is a frontend/API-layer change plus the\r\n   one bug fix above, not a redesign of Phase 1-3.\r\n\r\nRun the full test suite at the end and confirm everything still passes,\r\nincluding the new regression test."

                "text": "from datetime import datetime, timedelta\nfrom decimal import Decimal, ROUND_CEILING\n\n\nclass RateCard:\n\t\"\"\"Tiered per-stay pricing with a configurable maximum charge.\"\"\"\n\n\tdef __init__(\n\t\tself,\n\t\tfirst_hour_rate: Decimal | int | str | float,\n\t\tadditional_hour_rate: Decimal | int | str | float,\n\t\tdaily_cap: Decimal | int | str | float,\n\t) -> None:\n\t\tself.first_hour_rate = Decimal(str(first_hour_rate))\n\t\tself.additional_hour_rate = Decimal(str(additional_hour_rate))\n\t\tself.daily_cap = Decimal(str(daily_cap))\n\t\tif min(self.first_hour_rate, self.additional_hour_rate, self.daily_cap) < 0:\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"rates and daily_cap must not be negative\")\n\n\tdef calculate_fee(self, entry_time: datetime, exit_time: datetime) -> Decimal:\n\t\tif exit_time < entry_time:\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"exit_time must not precede entry_time\")\n\t\tduration = exit_time - entry_time\n\t\tcharged_hours = max(1, int(\n\t\t\t(Decimal(duration.total_seconds()) / Decimal(timedelta(hours=1).total_seconds()))\n\t\t\t.to_integral_value(rounding=ROUND_CEILING)\n\t\t))\n\n\t\tfee = self.first_hour_rate\n\t\tif charged_hours > 1:\n\t\t\tfee += Decimal(charged_hours - 1) * self.additional_hour_rate\n\t\treturn min(fee, self.daily_cap).quantize(Decimal(\"0.01\"))\n",

SpotType.STANDARD: 15, SpotType.EV: 5},\n\t\trate_card=RateCard(50, 30, 200),\n\t)\n\n\ngarage = build_garage()\napp = FastAPI(title=\"Parking Garage Attendant System\", version=\"1.0.0\")\n\n\nclass else \"parked\",\n\t}\n\tif include_exit:\n\t\tdata[\"exit_time\"] = ticket.exit_time.isoformat() if ticket.exit_time else None\n\t\tdata[\"fee\"] = str(ticket.fee) if ticket.fee is not None else None\n\treturn data\n\n\ndef error_response(error: Exception) -> HTTPException:\n\tif isinstance(error, VehicleAlreadyParkedError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif \"templates\" / \"index.html\")\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check-in\", status_code=201)\ndef check_in(payload: CheckInRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tvehicle = \"available\": garage.available_spot_count(spot_type), \"is_free\": garage.is_spot_free(spot_type)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/transactions\")\ndef transactions(\n\tplate: str = \"\",\n\tfrom_date: date | None = None,\n\tto_date: date | None = None,\n\tpage: int = Query(1, ge=1),\n\tpage_size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100),\n) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tfiltered = [ticket for ticket in page_size),\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tavailability_data = availability()\n\treturn {\n\t\t**availability_data,\n\t\t\"active_vehicles\": len(garage.active_tickets),\n\t\t\"completed_transactions\": len(garage.history),\n\t\t\"ev_available\": garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.EV),\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reports\")\ndef reports() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tnow = datetime.now()\n\ttoday = now.date()\n\tweek_start = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday())\n\tcompleted = garage.history\n\trevenue_today = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() == today), 0)\n\trevenue_week = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() >= week_start), 0)\n\tstay_seconds = [\n\t\t(ticket.exit_time - ticket.entry_time).total_seconds()\n\t\tfor ticket in completed\n\t\tif ticket.exit_time is not None\n\t]\n\toccupancy: dict[str, dict[str, float | int]] = {}\n\tfor spot_type in SpotType:\n\t\ttype_spots = [spot for spot in garage.spots.values() if spot.spot_type is spot_type]\n\t\toccupied = sum(spot.occupied for spot in type_spots)\n\t\toccupancy[spot_type.value] = {\n\t\t\t\"occupied\": occupied,\n\t\t\t\"total\": len(type_spots),\n\t\t\t\"percentage\": round((occupied / len(type_spots)) * 100, 1) if type_spots else 0,\n\t\t}\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"revenue_today\": str(revenue_today),\n\t\t\"revenue_week\": str(revenue_week),\n\t\t\"occupancy\": occupancy,\n\t\t\"average_stay_minutes\": round(sum(stay_seconds) / len(stay_seconds) / 60, 1) if stay_seconds else 0,\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/static/{asset_path:path}\")\ndef static_asset(asset_path: str) -> FileResponse:\n\tpath = BASE_DIR / \"static\" / asset_path\n\tif not path.is_file() or BASE_DIR not in path.resolve().parents:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"asset not found\")\n\treturn FileResponse(path)",

' error' : ''}`; setTimeout(() => { node.className = 'toast'; }, 4500); };\nconst formatTime = (value) => value ? new Date(value).toLocaleString([], {month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}) : '—';\nconst setBusy = (button, busy, label) => { button.disabled = busy; if (busy) { button.dataset.label = button.innerHTML; button.innerHTML = `${label} <span>…</span>`; } else { button.innerHTML = button.dataset.label; } };\nconst validate = (input, errorNode) => { const valid = input.value.trim().length > 0; input.classList.toggle('invalid', !valid); errorNode.textContent = valid ? '' : 'Enter a license plate.'; return valid; };\nlet currentPage = 1;\nasync function refreshDashboard() { const dashboard = await api('/api/dashboard'); $('#total-spots').textContent = dashboard.total; $('#available-spots').textContent = Object.values(dashboard.available).reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0); $('#occupied-spots').textContent = dashboard.occupied; $('#ev-spots').textContent = dashboard.available.ev; $('#ev-status').textContent = dashboard.ev_available ? 'Charger ready' : 'All occupied'; $('#updated').textContent = `Updated ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})}`; $('#availability').innerHTML = Object.entries(dashboard.available).map(([type,count]) => `<div class=\"availability-item ${type === 'ev' ? 'ev' : ''}\"><strong>${count}</strong><span>${type} available</span></div>`).join(''); const history = await api('/api/transactions?page=1&page_size=5'); $('#activity').innerHTML = history.transactions.length ? history.transactions.map(t => `<div class=\"activity-row\"><time>${formatTime(t.exit_time)}</time><span><strong>${t.plate}</strong> checked out at ${t.spot_id}</span><span class=\"fee\">$${Number(t.fee).toFixed(2)}</span></div>`).join('') : '<div class=\"empty\">No completed activity yet.</div>'; }\nasync function refreshReports() { const data = await api('/api/reports'); $('#revenue-today').textContent = `$${Number(data.revenue_today).toFixed(2)}`; $('#revenue-week').textContent = `$${Number(data.revenue_week).toFixed(2)}`; $('#average-stay').textContent = data.average_stay_minutes; $('#occupancy-bars').innerHTML = Object.entries(data.occupancy).map(([type, item]) => `<div class=\"bar-row ${type}\"><span>${type.toUpperCase()}</span><div class=\"bar\"><i style=\"width:${item.percentage}%\"></i></div><strong>${item.percentage}%</strong></div>`).join(''); }\nasync function loadHistory() { const params = new URLSearchParams({page: currentPage, page_size: 10}); const plate = $('#history-filter').value.trim(); if (plate) params.set('plate', plate); if ($('#from-date').value) params.set('from_date', $('#from-date').value); if ($('#to-date').value) params.set('to_date', $('#to-date').value); const data = await api(`/api/transactions?${params}`); $('#transaction-count').textContent = `${data.total} completed`; $('#page-label').textContent = `Page ${data.page} of ${data.pages}`; $('#previous-page').disabled = data.page <= 1; $('#next-page').disabled = data.page >= data.pages; $('#history-body').innerHTML = data.transactions.length ? data.transactions.map(t => `<tr><td><strong>${t.plate}</strong></td><td><span class=\"type\">${t.vehicle_type}</span></td><td>${t.spot_id}</td><td>${formatTime(t.entry_time)}</td><td>${formatTime(t.exit_time)}</td><td class=\"money-cell\">$${Number(t.fee).toFixed(2)}</td></tr>`).join('') : '<tr><td colspan=\"6\" class=\"empty\">No matching transactions.</td></tr>'; }\nasync function updatePreview() { const type = $('#check-in-form select').value; const data = await api(`/api/spots/availability/${type}`); const fallback = type === 'compact' ? 'standard' : 'compact'; const fallbackData = type === 'ev' ? null : await api(`/api/spots/availability/${fallback}`); let text = data.is_free ? `${type.toUpperCase()} spot available — preferred assignment.` : fallbackData?.is_free ? `${type.toUpperCase()} full — overflow capacity will be used.` : `${type.toUpperCase()} unavailable — check-in will be rejected.`; $('#spot-preview').textContent = text; $('#spot-preview').style.borderColor = data.is_free ? 'var(--acid)' : fallbackData?.is_free ? 'var(--orange)' : 'var(--danger)'; }\nfunction wireValidation(input, errorSelector) { return validate(input, $(errorSelector)); }\nfor (const tab of document.querySelectorAll('.tab')) tab.addEventListener('click', async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.tab,.tab-panel').forEach(node => node.classList.remove('active')); tab.classList.add('active'); $(`#tab-${tab.dataset.tab}`).classList.add('active'); if (tab.dataset.tab === 'history') await loadHistory(); if (tab.dataset.tab === 'reports') await refreshReports(); });\n$('#check-in-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const form = event.target; const input = form.elements.plate; if (!wireValidation(input, '[data-error=\"plate\"]')) return; const button = form.querySelector('button'); setBusy(button, true, 'Assigning'); try { const data = await api('/api/check-in', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({plate: input.value, vehicle_type: form.elements.vehicle_type.value})}); toast(`${data.ticket.plate} assigned to ${data.ticket.spot_id}`); form.reset(); await Promise.all([refreshDashboard(), refreshReports()]); updatePreview(); } catch (error) { toast(error.message, true); } finally { setBusy(button, false); } });\n$('#check-out-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const form = event.target; const input = form.elements.plate; if (!wireValidation(input, '[data-error=\"checkout-plate\"]')) return; const button = form.querySelector('button'); setBusy(button, true, 'Calculating'); try { const data = await api('/api/check-out', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({plate: input.value})}); toast(`${data.ticket.plate} checked out. Fee: $${Number(data.ticket.fee).toFixed(2)}`); form.reset(); await Promise.all([refreshDashboard(), refreshReports()]); } catch (error) { toast(error.message, true); } finally { setBusy(button, false); } });\n$('#search-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const form = event.target; const input = form.elements.plate; if (!wireValidation(input, '[data-error=\"search-plate\"]')) return; const button = form.querySelector('button'); setBusy(button, true, 'Searching'); try { const data = await api(`/api/vehicle/${encodeURIComponent(input.value)}`); const t = data.ticket; $('#search-result').className = 'search-result'; $('#search-result').innerHTML = `<strong>${t.plate}</strong>${t.vehicle_type.toUpperCase()} · ${t.spot_id} · Level ${t.level}<br>Parked since ${formatTime(t.entry_time)}`; } catch (error) { $('#search-result').className = 'search-result empty'; $('#search-result').textContent = error.message; } finally { setBusy(button, false); } });\n$('#check-in-form select').addEventListener('change', updatePreview); ['#history-filter','#from-date','#to-date'].forEach(selector => $(selector).addEventListener('input', () => { currentPage = 1; loadHistory().catch(error => toast(error.message, true)); })); $('#previous-page').addEventListener('click', () => { if (currentPage > 1) { currentPage--; loadHistory(); } }); $('#next-page').addEventListener('click', () => { currentPage++; loadHistory(); });\nPromise.all([refreshDashboard(), refreshReports(), updatePreview()]).catch(error => toast(error.message, true));\n",

' error' : ''}`; setTimeout(() => { node.className = 'toast'; }, 4500); };\nconst formatTime = (value) => value ? new Date(value).toLocaleString([], {month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}) : '—';\nconst setBusy = (button, busy, label) => { button.disabled = busy; if (busy) { button.dataset.label = button.innerHTML; button.innerHTML = `${label} <span>…</span>`; } else { button.innerHTML = button.dataset.label; } };\nconst validate = (input, errorNode) => { const valid = input.value.trim().length > 0; input.classList.toggle('invalid', !valid); errorNode.textContent = valid ? '' : 'Enter a license plate.'; return valid; };\nlet currentPage = 1;\nasync function refreshDashboard() { const dashboard = await api('/api/dashboard'); $('#total-spots').textContent = dashboard.total; $('#available-spots').textContent = Object.values(dashboard.available).reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0); $('#occupied-spots').textContent = dashboard.occupied; $('#ev-spots').textContent = dashboard.available.ev; $('#ev-status').textContent = dashboard.ev_available ? 'Charger ready' : 'All occupied'; $('#updated').textContent = `Updated ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})}`; const availabilityMarkup = Object.entries(dashboard.available).map(([type,count]) => `<div class=\"availability-item ${type === 'ev' ? 'ev' : ''}\"><strong>${count}</strong><span>${type} available</span></div>`).join(''); $('#availability').innerHTML = availabilityMarkup; $('#dashboard-availability').innerHTML = availabilityMarkup; const history = await api('/api/transactions?page=1&page_size=5'); $('#activity').innerHTML = history.transactions.length ? history.transactions.map(t => `<div class=\"activity-row\"><time>${formatTime(t.exit_time)}</time><span><strong>${t.plate}</strong> checked out at ${t.spot_id}</span><span class=\"fee\">$${Number(t.fee).toFixed(2)}</span></div>`).join('') : '<div class=\"empty\">No completed activity yet.</div>'; }\nasync function refreshReports() { const data = await api('/api/reports'); $('#revenue-today').textContent = `$${Number(data.revenue_today).toFixed(2)}`; $('#revenue-week').textContent = `$${Number(data.revenue_week).toFixed(2)}`; $('#average-stay').textContent = data.average_stay_minutes; $('#occupancy-bars').innerHTML = Object.entries(data.occupancy).map(([type, item]) => `<div class=\"bar-row ${type}\"><span>${type.toUpperCase()}</span><div class=\"bar\"><i style=\"width:${item.percentage}%\"></i></div><strong>${item.percentage}%</strong></div>`).join(''); }\nasync function loadHistory() { const params = new URLSearchParams({page: currentPage, page_size: 10}); const plate = $('#history-filter').value.trim(); if (plate) params.set('plate', plate); if ($('#from-date').value) params.set('from_date', $('#from-date').value); if ($('#to-date').value) params.set('to_date', $('#to-date').value); const data = await api(`/api/transactions?${params}`); $('#transaction-count').textContent = `${data.total} completed`; $('#page-label').textContent = `Page ${data.page} of ${data.pages}`; $('#previous-page').disabled = data.page <= 1; $('#next-page').disabled = data.page >= data.pages; $('#history-body').innerHTML = data.transactions.length ? data.transactions.map(t => `<tr><td><strong>${t.plate}</strong></td><td><span class=\"type\">${t.vehicle_type}</span></td><td>${t.spot_id}</td><td>${formatTime(t.entry_time)}</td><td>${formatTime(t.exit_time)}</td><td class=\"money-cell\">$${Number(t.fee).toFixed(2)}</td></tr>`).join('') : '<tr><td colspan=\"6\" class=\"empty\">No matching transactions.</td></tr>'; }\nasync function updatePreview() { const type = $('#check-in-form select').value; const data = await api(`/api/spots/availability/${type}`); const fallback = type === 'compact' ? 'standard' : 'compact'; const fallbackData = type === 'ev' ? null : await api(`/api/spots/availability/${fallback}`); let text = data.is_free ? `${type.toUpperCase()} spot available — preferred assignment.` : fallbackData?.is_free ? `${type.toUpperCase()} full — overflow capacity will be used.` : `${type.toUpperCase()} unavailable — check-in will be rejected.`; $('#spot-preview').textContent = text; $('#spot-preview').style.borderColor = data.is_free ? 'var(--acid)' : fallbackData?.is_free ? 'var(--orange)' : 'var(--danger)'; }\nfunction wireValidation(input, errorSelector) { return validate(input, $(errorSelector)); }\nfor (const tab of document.querySelectorAll('.tab')) tab.addEventListener('click', async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.tab,.tab-panel').forEach(node => node.classList.remove('active')); tab.classList.add('active'); $(`#tab-${tab.dataset.tab}`).classList.add('active'); if (tab.dataset.tab === 'history') await loadHistory(); if (tab.dataset.tab === 'reports') await refreshReports(); });\n$('#check-in-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const form = event.target; const input = form.elements.plate; if (!wireValidation(input, '[data-error=\"plate\"]')) return; const button = form.querySelector('button'); setBusy(button, true, 'Assigning'); try { const data = await api('/api/check-in', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({plate: input.value, vehicle_type: form.elements.vehicle_type.value})}); toast(`${data.ticket.plate} assigned to ${data.ticket.spot_id}`); form.reset(); await Promise.all([refreshDashboard(), refreshReports()]); updatePreview(); } catch (error) { toast(error.message, true); } finally { setBusy(button, false); } });\n$('#check-out-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const form = event.target; const input = form.elements.plate; if (!wireValidation(input, '[data-error=\"checkout-plate\"]')) return; const button = form.querySelector('button'); setBusy(button, true, 'Calculating'); try { const data = await api('/api/check-out', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({plate: input.value})}); toast(`${data.ticket.plate} checked out.             "text": "Update the parking garage system to use Indian conventions for currency\r\nand license plates:\r\n\r\n1. CURRENCY: Change every place fees are displayed or calculated from $\r\n   (dollars) to ₹ (Indian Rupees) — the RateCard's rates, the CLI output,\r\n   the web dashboard (check-out fee message, transaction history table,\r\n   reports/revenue numbers), and any hardcoded $ in tests or sample data.\r\n   Fee amounts stay as plain numbers internally (don't change the\r\n   RateCard math), just the currency symbol and formatting shown to the\r\n   user — format as ₹XX or ₹XX.XX (no comma separators needed unless you\r\n   want to add Indian-style lakh/crore grouping, e.g. ₹1,00,000 vs\r\n   ₹100,000 — use the Indian grouping style if you add separators at all).\r\n\r\n2. INDIAN NUMBER PLATE FORMAT: Indian plates follow the format\r\n   STATE-RTO-SERIES-NUMBER, e.g. \"KA01AB1234\" or \"MH-12-CD-5678\"\r\n   (2-letter state code, 2-digit RTO district code, 1-2 letter series,\r\n   4-digit number). Add validation for this:\r\n   - Accept plates with or without hyphens, but normalize/store them\r\n     consistently (pick one canonical stored format, e.g. always\r\n     uppercase with hyphens: \"KA-01-AB-1234\").\r\n   - Reject clearly invalid formats at check-in with a clear error\r\n     message (e.g. \"abc123\" or a plate missing the state code) rather\r\n     than silently accepting garbage.\r\n   - Auto-uppercase plate input as the user types or on submit, since\r\n     Indian plates are always uppercase.\r\n   - Update the CLI and web form's plate input placeholder/example to an\r\n     Indian-format plate (e.g. \"e.g. KA01AB1234\") instead of the current\r\n     placeholder.\r\n\r\n3. Update existing tests: any test using a $ fee assertion or a\r\n   non-Indian-format plate (like \"KX24 LMP\") should be updated to use ₹\r\n   and a valid Indian-format plate instead, so the test suite still\r\n   reflects real expected input.\r\n\r\n4. Update README.md to state the plate format rule you implemented\r\n   (which formats are accepted, how they're normalized/stored) and note\r\n   that fees are in ₹.\r\n\r\nDon't change the underlying fee calculation logic (RateCard math) — this\r\nis a display/validation-layer change. Run the full test suite after and\r\nconfirm everything passes.",
            "kind": "text"
          }
        ],
        "text": "Update the parking garage system to use Indian conventions for currency\r\nand license plates:\r\n\r\n1. CURRENCY: Change every place fees are displayed or calculated from $\r\n   (dollars) to ₹ (Indian Rupees) — the RateCard's rates, the CLI output,\r\n   the web dashboard (check-out fee message, transaction history table,\r\n   reports/revenue numbers), and any hardcoded $ in tests or sample data.\r\n   Fee amounts stay as plain numbers internally (don't change the\r\n   RateCard math), just the currency symbol and formatting shown to the\r\n   user — format as ₹XX or ₹XX.XX (no comma separators needed unless you\r\n   want to add Indian-style lakh/crore grouping, e.g. ₹1,00,000 vs\r\n   ₹100,000 — use the Indian grouping style if you add separators at all).\r\n\r\n2. INDIAN NUMBER PLATE FORMAT: Indian plates follow the format\r\n   STATE-RTO-SERIES-NUMBER, e.g. \"KA01AB1234\" or \"MH-12-CD-5678\"\r\n   (2-letter state code, 2-digit RTO district code, 1-2 letter series,\r\n   4-digit number). Add validation for this:\r\n   - Accept plates with or without hyphens, but normalize/store them\r\n     consistently (pick one canonical stored format, e.g. always\r\n     uppercase with hyphens: \"KA-01-AB-1234\").\r\n   - Reject clearly invalid formats at check-in with a clear error\r\n     message (e.g. \"abc123\" or a plate missing the state code) rather\r\n     than silently accepting garbage.\r\n   - Auto-uppercase plate input as the user types or on submit, since\r\n     Indian plates are always uppercase.\r\n   - Update the CLI and web form's plate input placeholder/example to an\r\n     Indian-format plate (e.g. \"e.g. KA01AB1234\") instead of the current\r\n     placeholder.\r\n\r\n3. Update existing tests: any test using a $ fee assertion or a\r\n   non-Indian-format plate (like \"KX24 LMP\") should be updated to use ₹\r\n   and a valid Indian-format plate instead, so the test suite still\r\n   reflects real expected input.\r\n\r\n4. Update README.md to state the plate format rule you implemented\r\n   (which formats are accepted, how they're normalized/stored) and note\r\n   that fees are in ₹.\r\n\r\nDon't change the underlying fee calculation logic (RateCard math) — this\r\nis a display/validation-layer change. Run the full test suite after and\r\nconfirm everything passes."

                "text": "from dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nimport re\nfrom uuid import uuid4\n\n\nclass SpotType(str, Enum):\n\tCOMPACT = \"compact\"\n\tSTANDARD = \"standard\"\n\tEV = \"ev\"\n\n\nPLATE_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"^([A-Z]{2})-?(\\d{2})-?([A-Z]{1,2})-?(\\d{4})$\")\n\n\ndef normalize_plate(plate: str) -> str:\n\t\"\"\"Validate and canonicalize an Indian registration plate.\"\"\"\n\tcompact = re.sub(r\"[\\s-]+\", \"\", plate).upper()\n\tmatch = PLATE_PATTERN.fullmatch(compact)\n\tif match is None:\n\t\traise ValueError(\n\t\t\t\"invalid Indian plate; use 2 letters, 2 digits, 1-2 series letters, \"\n\t\t\t\"and 4 digits (for example KA01AB1234)\"\n\t\t)\n\treturn \"-\".join(match.groups())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Vehicle:\n\tplate: str\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\n\tdef __post_init__(self) -> None:\n\t\tobject.__setattr__(self, \"plate\", normalize_plate(self.plate))\n\t\tif isinstance(self.vehicle_type, str):\n\t\t\tobject.__setattr__(self, \"vehicle_type\", SpotType(self.vehicle_type.lower()))\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Spot:\n\tspot_id: str\n\tlevel: int\n\tspot_type: SpotType\n\thas_charger: bool = False\n\toccupied: bool = False\n\tvehicle: Vehicle | None = None\n\tticket_id: str | None = None\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Ticket:\n\tplate: str\n\tvehicle: Vehicle\n\tspot_id: str\n\tentry_time: datetime\n\texit_time: datetime | None = None\n\tfee: Decimal | None = None\n\tticket_id: str = \"\"\n\n\tdef __post_init__(self) -> None:\n\t\tif not self.ticket_id:\n\t\t\tself.ticket_id = uuid4().hex[:12].upper()\n",
