                "text": "from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Query\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, Field\n\nfrom .garage import CarNotFoundError, NoSpotAvailableError, ParkingGarage, VehicleAlreadyParkedError\nfrom .models import SpotType, Ticket, Vehicle, normalize_plate\nfrom .rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nBASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n\n\ndef build_garage() -> ParkingGarage:\n\treturn ParkingGarage(\n\t\tlevels=3,\n\t\tspots_per_level={SpotType.COMPACT: 10, SpotType.STANDARD: 15, SpotType.EV: 5},\n\t\trate_card=RateCard(50, 30, 200),\n\t)\n\n\ngarage = build_garage()\napp = FastAPI(title=\"Parking Garage Attendant System\", version=\"1.0.0\")\n\n\nclass CheckInRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\tentry_time: datetime | None = None\n\n\nclass CheckOutRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\texit_time: datetime | None = None\n\n\ndef ticket_data(ticket: Ticket, include_exit: bool = False) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tspot = garage.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\tdata: dict[str, object] = {\n\t\t\"ticket_id\": ticket.ticket_id,\n\t\t\"plate\": ticket.plate,\n\t\t\"vehicle_type\": ticket.vehicle.vehicle_type.value,\n\t\t\"spot_id\": ticket.spot_id,\n\t\t\"level\": spot.level,\n\t\t\"entry_time\": ticket.entry_time.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"status\": \"completed\" if ticket.exit_time else \"parked\",\n\t}\n\tif include_exit:\n\t\tdata[\"exit_time\"] = ticket.exit_time.isoformat() if ticket.exit_time else None\n\t\tdata[\"fee\"] = str(ticket.fee) if ticket.fee is not None else None\n\treturn data\n\n\ndef error_response(error: Exception) -> HTTPException:\n\tif isinstance(error, VehicleAlreadyParkedError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, NoSpotAvailableError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, CarNotFoundError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(error))\n\treturn HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(error))\n\n\n@app.get(\"/\", response_class=FileResponse)\ndef index() -> FileResponse:\n\treturn FileResponse(BASE_DIR / \"templates\" / \"index.html\")\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check-in\", status_code=201)\ndef check_in(payload: CheckInRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tvehicle = Vehicle(payload.plate, payload.vehicle_type)\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.check_in(vehicle, payload.entry_time))}\n\texcept (ValueError, VehicleAlreadyParkedError, NoSpotAvailableError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check-out\")\ndef check_out(payload: CheckOutRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.check_out(normalize_plate(payload.plate), payload.exit_time), True)}\n\texcept (ValueError, CarNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/vehicle/{plate}\")\ndef vehicle_lookup(plate: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tnormalized_plate = normalize_plate(plate)\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(error)) from error\n\tticket = garage.find_car(normalized_plate)\n\tif ticket is None:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"vehicle is not currently parked\")\n\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(ticket)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability\")\ndef availability() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tcounts = {spot_type.value: garage.available_spot_count(spot_type) for spot_type in SpotType}\n\treturn {\"available\": counts, \"total\": len(garage.spots), \"occupied\": len(garage.active_tickets)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability/{spot_type}\")\ndef type_availability(spot_type: SpotType) -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\"spot_type\": spot_type.value, \"available\": garage.available_spot_count(spot_type), \"is_free\": garage.is_spot_free(spot_type)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/transactions\")\ndef transactions(\n\tplate: str = \"\",\n\tfrom_date: date | None = None,\n\tto_date: date | None = None,\n\tpage: int = Query(1, ge=1),\n\tpage_size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100),\n) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tfiltered = [ticket for ticket in reversed(garage.history) if (\n\t\t(not plate or normalize_plate(plate) in ticket.plate)\n\t\tand (from_date is None or ticket.entry_time.date() >= from_date)\n\t\tand (to_date is None or ticket.entry_time.date() <= to_date)\n\t)]\n\tstart = (page - 1) * page_size\n\tpage_items = filtered[start:start + page_size]\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"transactions\": [ticket_data(ticket, True) for ticket in page_items],\n\t\t\"page\": page,\n\t\t\"page_size\": page_size,\n\t\t\"total\": len(filtered),\n\t\t\"pages\": max(1, (len(filtered) + page_size - 1) // page_size),\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tavailability_data = availability()\n\treturn {\n\t\t**availability_data,\n\t\t\"active_vehicles\": len(garage.active_tickets),\n\t\t\"completed_transactions\": len(garage.history),\n\t\t\"ev_available\": garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.EV),\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reports\")\ndef reports() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tnow = datetime.now()\n\ttoday = now.date()\n\tweek_start = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday())\n\tcompleted = garage.history\n\trevenue_today = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() == today), 0)\n\trevenue_week = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() >= week_start), 0)\n\tstay_seconds = [\n\t\t(ticket.exit_time - ticket.entry_time).total_seconds()\n\t\tfor ticket in completed\n\t\tif ticket.exit_time is not None\n\t]\n\toccupancy: dict[str, dict[str, float | int]] = {}\n\tfor spot_type in SpotType:\n\t\ttype_spots = [spot for spot in garage.spots.values() if spot.spot_type is spot_type]\n\t\toccupied = sum(spot.occupied for spot in type_spots)\n\t\toccupancy[spot_type.value] = {\n\t\t\t\"occupied\": occupied,\n\t\t\t\"total\": len(type_spots),\n\t\t\t\"percentage\": round((occupied / len(type_spots)) * 100, 1) if type_spots else 0,\n\t\t}\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"revenue_today\": str(revenue_today),\n\t\t\"revenue_week\": str(revenue_week),\n\t\t\"occupancy\": occupancy,\n\t\t\"average_stay_minutes\": round(sum(stay_seconds) / len(stay_seconds) / 60, 1) if stay_seconds else 0,\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/static/{asset_path:path}\")\ndef static_asset(asset_path: str) -> FileResponse:\n\tpath = BASE_DIR / \"static\" / asset_path\n\tif not path.is_file() or BASE_DIR not in path.resolve().parents:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"asset not found\")\n\treturn FileResponse(path)",

                "text": "from datetime import datetime\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nfrom .garage import CarNotFoundError, GarageError, ParkingGarage\nfrom .models import SpotType, Vehicle\nfrom .rate_card import RateCard\n\n\ndef build_default_garage() -> ParkingGarage:\n\treturn ParkingGarage(\n\t\tlevels=2,\n\t\tspots_per_level={SpotType.COMPACT: 10, SpotType.STANDARD: 15, SpotType.EV: 5},\n\t\trate_card=RateCard(Decimal(\"5.00\"), Decimal(\"3.00\"), Decimal(\"25.00\")),\n\t)\n\n\ndef main() -> None:\n\tgarage = build_default_garage()\n\tprint(\"Parking garage CLI. Commands: in, out, free, find, quit\")\n\twhile True:\n\t\ttry:\n\t\t\tcommand = input(\"> \").strip().lower()\n\t\texcept (EOFError, KeyboardInterrupt):\n\t\t\tprint()\n\t\t\tbreak\n\t\ttry:\n\t\t\tif command in {\"quit\", \"exit\"}:\n\t\t\t\tbreak\n\t\t\tif command == \"in\":\n\t\t\t\tplate = input(\"Plate (e.g. KA01AB1234): \").strip()\n\t\t\t\tvehicle_type = SpotType(input(\"Type (compact/standard/ev): \").strip().lower())\n\t\t\t\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(plate, vehicle_type))\n\t\t\t\tprint(f\"Checked in at {ticket.spot_id} ({ticket.entry_time.isoformat()})\")\n\t\t\telif command == \"out\":\n\t\t\t\tticket = garage.check_out(input(\"Plate: \").strip())\n\t\t\t\tprint(f\"Fee: ₹{ticket.fee:.2f}\")\n\t\t\telif command == \"free\":\n\t\t\t\tvehicle_type = SpotType(input(\"Type (compact/standard/ev): \").strip().lower())\n\t\t\t\tprint(\"yes\" if garage.is_spot_free(vehicle_type) else \"no\")\n\t\t\telif command == \"find\":\n\t\t\t\tticket = garage.find_car(input(\"Plate (e.g. KA01AB1234): \").strip())\n\t\t\t\tprint(f\"{ticket.spot_id} since {ticket.entry_time.isoformat()}\" if ticket else \"Not parked\")\n\t\t\telse:\n\t\t\t\tprint(\"Unknown command\")\n\t\texcept (ValueError, GarageError) as error:\n\t\t\tprint(f\"Error: {error}\")\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n\tmain()\n",

'' : 'Enter a license plate.'; return valid; };\nlet currentPage = 1;\nasync function refreshDashboard() { const dashboard = await api('/api/dashboard'); $('#total-spots').textContent = dashboard.total; $('#available-spots').textContent = Object.values(dashboard.available).reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0); $('#occupied-spots').textContent = dashboard.occupied; $('#ev-spots').textContent = dashboard.available.ev; $('#ev-status').textContent = dashboard.ev_available ? data.transactions.map(t => `<tr><td><strong>${t.plate}</strong></td><td><span class=\"type\">${t.vehicle_type}</span></td><td>${t.spot_id}</td><td>${formatTime(t.entry_time)}</td><td>${formatTime(t.exit_time)}</td><td class=\"money-cell\">₹${Number(t.fee).toFixed(2)}</td></tr>`).join('') : '<tr><td colspan=\"6\" class=\"empty\">No matching transactions.</td></tr>'; }\nasync function updatePreview() { const type = $('#check-in-form select').value; const data = await api(`/api/spots/availability/${type}`); const fallback = type === 'compact' ? Vehicle, normalize_plate\nfrom .rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nclass GarageError(Exception):\n\t\"\"\"Base exception for expected garage operation failures.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass VehicleAlreadyParkedError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass NoSpotAvailableError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass CarNotFoundError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass ParkingGarage:\n\tdef __init__(\n\t\tself,\n\t\tlevels: int,\n\t\tspots_per_level: Mapping[SpotType | str, int],\n\t\trate_card: RateCard,\n\t) -> None:\n\t\tif levels < 1:\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"levels must be at least 1\")\n\t\tnormalized_counts = {\n\t\t\tSpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type): count\n\t\t\tfor spot_type, count in spots_per_level.items()\n\t\t}\n\t\tif any(count < 0 for count in normalized_counts.values()):\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"spot counts must not be negative\")\n\n\t\tself.rate_card = rate_card\n\t\tself.spots: dict[str, Spot] = {}\n\t\tself.free_spots: dict[SpotType, set[str]] = {\n\t\t\tspot_type: set() for spot_type in SpotType\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor level in range(1, levels + 1):\n\t\t\tfor spot_type in SpotType:\n\t\t\t\tfor number in range(1, normalized_counts.get(spot_type, 0) + 1):\n\t\t\t\t\tspot_id = f\"L{level}-{spot_type.value.upper()}-{number}\"\n\t\t\t\t\tspot = Spot(\n\t\t\t\t\t\tspot_id=spot_id,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tlevel=level,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tspot_type=spot_type,\n\t\t\t\t\t\thas_charger=spot_type is SpotType.EV,\n\t\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\t\tself.spots[spot_id] = spot\n\t\t\t\t\tself.free_spots[spot_type].add(spot_id)\n\n\t\tself.active_tickets: dict[str, Ticket] = {}\n\t\tself.history: list[Ticket] = []\n\t\tself._lock = Lock()\n\n\tdef check_in(self, vehicle: Vehicle, entry_time: datetime | None = None) -> Ticket:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tif vehicle.plate in self.active_tickets:\n\t\t\t\traise VehicleAlreadyParkedError(f\"{vehicle.plate} is already parked\")\n\n\t\t\tcandidate_types = self._spot_type_for(vehicle.vehicle_type)\n\t\t\tselected_type = next(\n\t\t\t\t(candidate for candidate in candidate_types if self.free_spots[candidate]), None\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tif selected_type is None:\n\t\t\t\traise NoSpotAvailableError(\n\t\t\t\t\tf\"no spot available for {vehicle.vehicle_type.value} vehicle\"\n\t\t\t\t)\n\n\t\t\tselected_id = self.free_spots[selected_type].pop()\n\t\t\tspot = self.spots[selected_id]\n\t\t\tticket = Ticket(\n\t\t\t\tplate=vehicle.plate,\n\t\t\t\tvehicle=vehicle,\n\t\t\t\tspot_id=selected_id,\n\t\t\t\tentry_time=entry_time or datetime.now(),\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tspot.occupied = True\n\t\t\tspot.vehicle = vehicle\n\t\t\tspot.ticket_id = ticket.ticket_id\n\t\t\tself.active_tickets[vehicle.plate] = ticket\n\t\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef check_out(\n\t\tself, plate: str, exit_time: datetime | None = None\n\t) -> Ticket:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tticket = self.active_tickets.pop(normalize_plate(plate), None)\n\t\t\tif ticket is None:\n\t\t\t\traise CarNotFoundError(f\"no active ticket for {plate}\")\n\t\t\tticket.exit_time = exit_time or datetime.now()\n\t\t\tticket.fee = self.rate_card.calculate_fee(ticket.entry_time, ticket.exit_time)\n\t\t\tspot = self.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\t\t\tspot.occupied = False\n\t\t\tspot.vehicle = None\n\t\t\tspot.ticket_id = None\n\t\t\tself.free_spots[spot.spot_type].add(spot.spot_id)\n\t\t\tself.history.append(ticket)\n\t\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef find_car(self, plate: str) -> Ticket | None:\n\t\treturn self.active_tickets.get(normalize_plate(plate))\n\n\tdef is_spot_free(self, spot_type: SpotType | str) -> bool:\n\t\tnormalized_type = SpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type)\n\t\treturn bool(self.free_spots[normalized_type])\n\n\tdef available_spot_count(self, spot_type: SpotType | str) -> int:\n\t\tnormalized_type = SpotType(spot_type.lower() if SpotType.EV:\n\t\t\treturn [SpotType.EV]\n\t\tif vehicle_type is SpotType.COMPACT:\n\t\t\treturn [SpotType.COMPACT, SpotType.STANDARD]\n\t\treturn [SpotType.STANDARD, SpotType.COMPACT]\n",

FastAPI(title=\"Parking Garage Attendant System\", version=\"1.0.0\")\n\n\nclass CheckInRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\tentry_time: datetime | None = None\n\n\nclass CheckOutRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\texit_time: datetime | None = None\n\n\ndef ticket_data(ticket: Ticket, include_exit: bool = False) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tspot = garage.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\tdata: dict[str, object] = {\n\t\t\"ticket_id\": ticket.ticket_id,\n\t\t\"plate\": ticket.plate,\n\t\t\"vehicle_type\": ticket.vehicle.vehicle_type.value,\n\t\t\"spot_id\": ticket.spot_id,\n\t\t\"level\": spot.level,\n\t\t\"entry_time\": ticket.entry_time.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"status\": \"completed\" if ticket.exit_time else \"parked\",\n\t}\n\tif include_exit:\n\t\tdata[\"exit_time\"] = ticket.exit_time.isoformat() if ticket.exit_time else None\n\t\tdata[\"fee\"] = str(ticket.fee) if ticket.fee is not None else None\n\treturn data\n\n\ndef error_response(error: Exception) -> HTTPException:\n\tif isinstance(error, VehicleAlreadyParkedError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, NoSpotAvailableError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, CarNotFoundError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(error))\n\treturn HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(error))\n\n\n@app.get(\"/\", response_class=FileResponse)\ndef index() -> FileResponse:\n\treturn FileResponse(BASE_DIR / \"templates\" / \"index.html\")\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check-in\", status_code=201)\ndef check_in(payload: CheckInRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tvehicle = Vehicle(payload.plate, payload.vehicle_type)\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.check_in(vehicle, payload.entry_time))}\n\texcept (ValueError, VehicleAlreadyParkedError, NoSpotAvailableError) as error:\n\t\traise error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/vehicle/{plate}\")\ndef vehicle_lookup(plate: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tnormalized_plate = normalize_plate(plate)\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise currently parked\")\n\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(ticket)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability\")\ndef availability() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tcounts = {spot_type.value: garage.available_spot_count(spot_type) for spot_type in SpotType}\n\treturn {\"available\": counts, \"total\": len(garage.spots), \"occupied\": len(garage.active_tickets)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability/{spot_type}\")\ndef type_availability(spot_type: SpotType) -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\"spot_type\": spot_type.value, \"available\": garage.available_spot_count(spot_type), \"is_free\": garage.is_spot_free(spot_type)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/transactions\")\ndef transactions(\n\tplate: str = \"\",\n\tfrom_date: date | None = None,\n\tto_date: date | None = None,\n\tpage: int = Query(1, ge=1),\n\tpage_size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100),\n) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tnormalized_filter = normalize_plate(plate) if plate else \"\"\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(error)) from error\n\tfiltered = [ticket for ticket in reversed(garage.history) if (\n\t\t(not normalized_filter or normalized_filter in ticket.plate)\n\t\tand (from_date is None or ticket.entry_time.date() >= from_date)\n\t\tand (to_date is None or ticket.entry_time.date() <= to_date)\n\t)]\n\tstart = (page - 1) * page_size\n\tpage_items = filtered[start:start + page_size]\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"transactions\": [ticket_data(ticket, True) for ticket in page_items],\n\t\t\"page\": page,\n\t\t\"page_size\": page_size,\n\t\t\"total\": len(filtered),\n\t\t\"pages\": max(1, (len(filtered) + page_size - 1) // page_size),\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tavailability_data = availability()\n\treturn {\n\t\t**availability_data,\n\t\t\"active_vehicles\": len(garage.active_tickets),\n\t\t\"completed_transactions\": len(garage.history),\n\t\t\"ev_available\": garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.EV),\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reports\")\ndef reports() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tnow = datetime.now()\n\ttoday = now.date()\n\tweek_start = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday())\n\tcompleted = garage.history\n\trevenue_today = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() == today), 0)\n\trevenue_week = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() >= week_start), 0)\n\tstay_seconds = [\n\t\t(ticket.exit_time - ticket.entry_time).total_seconds()\n\t\tfor ticket in completed\n\t\tif ticket.exit_time is not None\n\t]\n\toccupancy: dict[str, dict[str, float | int]] = {}\n\tfor spot_type in SpotType:\n\t\ttype_spots = [spot for spot in garage.spots.values() if spot.spot_type is spot_type]\n\t\toccupied = sum(spot.occupied for spot in type_spots)\n\t\toccupancy[spot_type.value] = {\n\t\t\t\"occupied\": occupied,\n\t\t\t\"total\": len(type_spots),\n\t\t\t\"percentage\": round((occupied / len(type_spots)) * 100, 1) if type_spots else 0,\n\t\t}\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"revenue_today\": str(revenue_today),\n\t\t\"revenue_week\": str(revenue_week),\n\t\t\"occupancy\": occupancy,\n\t\t\"average_stay_minutes\": round(sum(stay_seconds) / len(stay_seconds) / 60, 1) if stay_seconds else 0,\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/static/{asset_path:path}\")\ndef static_asset(asset_path: str) -> FileResponse:\n\tpath = BASE_DIR / \"static\" / asset_path\n\tif not path.is_file() or BASE_DIR not in path.resolve().parents:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"asset not found\")\n\treturn FileResponse(path)",

' error' : ''}`; setTimeout(() => { node.className = 'toast'; }, 4500); };\nconst formatTime = (value) => value ? new Date(value).toLocaleString([], {month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}) : '—';\nconst setBusy = (button, busy, label) => { button.disabled = busy; if (busy) { button.dataset.label = button.innerHTML; button.innerHTML = `${label} <span>…</span>`; } else { button.innerHTML = button.dataset.label; } };\nconst validate = (input, errorNode) => { const valid = input.value.trim().length > 0; input.classList.toggle('invalid', !valid); errorNode.textContent = valid ? history.transactions.map(t => `<div class=\"activity-row\"><time>${formatTime(t.exit_time)}</time><span><strong>${t.plate}</strong> checked out at ${t.spot_id}</span><span class=\"fee\">₹${Number(t.fee).toFixed(2)}</span></div>`).join('') : '<div class=\"empty\">No completed activity yet.</div>'; }\nasync function refreshReports() { const data = await api('/api/reports'); $('#revenue-today').textContent = `₹${Number(data.revenue_today).toFixed(2)}`; $('#revenue-week').textContent = `₹${Number(data.revenue_week).toFixed(2)}`; $('#average-stay').textContent = data.average_stay_minutes; $('#occupancy-bars').innerHTML = Object.entries(data.occupancy).map(([type, item]) => `<div class=\"bar-row ${type}\"><span>${type.toUpperCase()}</span><div class=\"bar\"><i style=\"width:${item.percentage}%\"></i></div><strong>${item.percentage}%</strong></div>`).join(''); }\nasync function loadHistory() { const params = new URLSearchParams({page: currentPage, page_size: 10}); const plate = $('#history-filter').value.trim(); if (plate) params.set('plate', plate); if ($('#from-date').value) params.set('from_date', $('#from-date').value); if ($('#to-date').value) params.set('to_date', $('#to-date').value); const data = await api(`/api/transactions?${params}`); $('#transaction-count').textContent = `${data.total} completed`; $('#page-label').textContent = `Page ${data.page} of ${data.pages}`; $('#previous-page').disabled = data.page <= 1; $('#next-page').disabled = data.page >= data.pages; $('#history-body').innerHTML = data.transactions.length ?           "edits": [

              {
                "text": "# Parking Garage Attendant System\n\nA complete FastAPI web application and CLI for a configurable parking garage\nwith tiered fees, EV-only charging spots, compact/standard overflow, and\nconstant-time-style live lookups.\n\n## Features\n\n- Live check-in, check-out, plate lookup, availability, and transaction history.\n- Indian registration plate validation and canonical formatting.\n- Responsive dashboard served by FastAPI with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.\n- Atomic in-memory spot assignment protected for concurrent requests.\n- Configurable levels, spot counts, rates, and per-stay daily cap.\n\n## Policies\n\n- Partial hours round up: a stay of 1 hour and 1 minute is charged as 2 hours.\n- The first charged hour uses `first_hour_rate`; every later charged hour uses\n\t`additional_hour_rate`.\n- Fees are displayed in Indian Rupees (`₹`); fee amounts remain numeric\n\tinternally.\n- `daily_cap` is a per-stay maximum. It applies to the elapsed stay from entry\n\tto exit and is not tied to the calendar date.\n- Compact vehicles prefer compact spots and overflow into standard spots when\n\tneeded. Standard vehicles do the reverse. Neither type can use EV spots.\n- EV vehicles may use only EV spots.\n- Plates accept `KA01AB1234` or `MH-12-CD-5678` style input: two state letters,\n  two RTO digits, one or two series letters, and four digits. Input is\n  uppercased and stored canonically as `STATE-RTO-SERIES-NUMBER`, for example\n  `KA-01-AB-1234`.\n\n## Run tests\n\n```bash\npython3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt\npython3 -m pytest -v\n```\n\n## Run the web application\n\n```bash\nuvicorn src.api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000\n```\n\nIn GitHub Codespaces, open the forwarded port `8000` in the Ports panel. The\nroot page is the attendant dashboard.\n\nYou can also run `python3 run.py`.\n\n## API\n\n- `POST /api/check-in` with `{\"plate\":\"KA01AB1234\",\"vehicle_type\":\"ev\"}`\n- `POST /api/check-out` with `{\"plate\":\"KA-01-AB-1234\"}`\n- `GET /api/vehicle/{plate}`\n- `GET /api/spots/availability`\n- `GET /api/spots/availability/{spot_type}`\n- `GET /api/transactions`\n- `GET /api/dashboard`\n\nThe API returns `409` for duplicate check-ins and unavailable compatible spots,\n`404` for missing active vehicles, and `422` for invalid request data.\n\n## Architecture\n\n`models.py`, `rate_card.py`, and `garage.py` contain framework-independent\nbusiness logic. `api.py` adapts those objects to HTTP. The browser dashboard\nuses `fetch()` and updates only affected regions after each action. Active\nvehicles use `dict[plate, Ticket]`; free spots use\n`dict[SpotType, set[spot_id]]`; completed transactions stay in a separate\nappend-only list. These live operations do not scan transaction history.\n\n## Run the CLI\n\n```bash\npython -m src.cli\n```\n\nThe default CLI configuration is only an example. `ParkingGarage` accepts the\nnumber of levels, spots per level by type, and a `RateCard`, so applications can\nprovide any garage configuration.\n\n## Design\n\nCurrently parked vehicles are stored in `active_tickets`, indexed by plate.\nFree spots are indexed by `SpotType` and spot ID. Completed tickets are appended\nto the separate `history` list, so historical log growth does not require scans\nfor check-in, checkout, plate lookup, or availability queries.\n\n## Stretch features\n\n1. Persist completed transactions and restore active state after a restart.\n2. Add reservations and a queue for full spot types.\n3. Add daily reports for revenue, occupancy, and average stay duration.",

' error' : ''}`; setTimeout(() => { node.className = 'toast'; }, 4500); };\nconst formatTime = (value) => value ? new Date(value).toLocaleString([], {month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}) : '—';\nconst setBusy = (button, busy, label) => { button.disabled = busy; if (busy) { button.dataset.label = button.innerHTML; button.innerHTML = `${label} <span>…</span>`; } else { button.innerHTML = button.dataset.label; } };\nconst validate = (input, errorNode) => { const valid = input.value.trim().length > 0; input.classList.toggle('invalid', !valid); errorNode.textContent = valid ? '' : 'Enter a license plate.'; return valid; };\nlet currentPage = 1;\nasync function refreshDashboard() { const dashboard = await api('/api/dashboard'); $('#total-spots').textContent = dashboard.total; $('#available-spots').textContent = Object.values(dashboard.available).reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0); $('#occupied-spots').textContent = dashboard.occupied; $('#ev-spots').textContent = dashboard.available.ev; $('#ev-status').textContent = dashboard.ev_available ? 'Charger ready' : 'All occupied'; $('#updated').textContent = `Updated ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})}`; const availabilityMarkup = Object.entries(dashboard.available).map(([type,count]) => `<div class=\"availability-item ${type === 'ev' ? 'ev' : ''}\"><strong>${count}</strong><span>${type} available</span></div>`).join(''); $('#availability').innerHTML = availabilityMarkup; $('#dashboard-availability').innerHTML = availabilityMarkup; const history = await api('/api/transactions?page=1&page_size=5'); $('#activity').innerHTML = history.transactions.length ? history.transactions.map(t => `<div class=\"activity-row\"><time>${formatTime(t.exit_time)}</time><span><strong>${t.plate}</strong> checked out at ${t.spot_id}</span><span class=\"fee\">₹${Number(t.fee).toFixed(2)}</span></div>`).join('') : '<div class=\"empty\">No completed activity yet.</div>'; }\nasync function refreshReports() { const data = await api('/api/reports'); $('#revenue-today').textContent = `₹${Number(data.revenue_today).toFixed(2)}`; $('#revenue-week').textContent = `₹${Number(data.revenue_week).toFixed(2)}`; $('#average-stay').textContent = data.average_stay_minutes; $('#occupancy-bars').innerHTML = Object.entries(data.occupancy).map(([type, item]) => `<div class=\"bar-row ${type}\"><span>${type.toUpperCase()}</span><div class=\"bar\"><i style=\"width:${item.percentage}%\"></i></div><strong>${item.percentage}%</strong></div>`).join(''); }\nasync function loadHistory() { const params = new URLSearchParams({page: currentPage, page_size: 10}); const plate = $('#history-filter').value.trim(); if (plate) params.set('plate', plate); if ($('#from-date').value) params.set('from_date', $('#from-date').value); if ($('#to-date').value) params.set('to_date', $('#to-date').value); const data = await api(`/api/transactions?${params}`); $('#transaction-count').textContent = `${data.total} completed`; $('#page-label').textContent = `Page ${data.page} of ${data.pages}`; $('#previous-page').disabled = data.page <= 1; $('#next-page').disabled = data.page >= data.pages; $('#history-body').innerHTML = data.transactions.length ? data.transactions.map(t => `<tr><td><strong>${t.plate}</strong></td><td><span class=\"type\">${t.vehicle_type}</span></td><td>${t.spot_id}</td><td>${formatTime(t.entry_time)}</td><td>${formatTime(t.exit_time)}</td><td class=\"money-cell\">₹${Number(t.fee).toFixed(2)}</td></tr>`).join('') : '<tr><td colspan=\"6\" class=\"empty\">No matching transactions.</td></tr>'; }\nasync function updatePreview() { const type = $('#check-in-form select').value; const data = await api(`/api/spots/availability/${type}`); const fallback = type === 'compact' ? 'standard' : 'compact'; const fallbackData = type === 'ev' ? null : await api(`/api/spots/availability/${fallback}`); let text = data.is_free ? `${type.toUpperCase()} spot available — preferred assignment.` : fallbackData?.is_free ? `${type.toUpperCase()} full — overflow capacity will be used.` : `${type.toUpperCase()} unavailable — check-in will be rejected.`; $('#spot-preview').textContent = text; $('#spot-preview').style.borderColor = data.is_free ? 'var(--acid)' : fallbackData?.is_free ? 'var(--orange)' : 'var(--danger)'; }\nfunction wireValidation(input, errorSelector) { return validate(input, $(errorSelector)); }\nfor (const tab of document.querySelectorAll('.tab')) tab.addEventListener('click', async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.tab,.tab-panel').forEach(node => node.classList.remove('active')); tab.classList.add('active'); $(`#tab-${tab.dataset.tab}`).classList.add('active'); if (tab.dataset.tab === 'history') await loadHistory(); if (tab.dataset.tab === 'reports') await refreshReports(); });\n$('#check-in-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const form = event.target; const input = form.elements.plate; if (!wireValidation(input, '[data-error=\"plate\"]')) return; const button = form.querySelector('button'); setBusy(button, true, 'Assigning'); try { const data = await api('/api/check-in', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({plate: input.value, vehicle_type: form.elements.vehicle_type.value})}); toast(`${data.ticket.plate} assigned to ${data.ticket.spot_id}`); form.reset(); await Promise.all([refreshDashboard(), refreshReports()]); updatePreview(); } catch (error) { toast(error.message, true); } finally { setBusy(button, false); } });\n$('#check-out-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const form = event.target; const input = form.elements.plate; if (!wireValidation(input, '[data-error=\"checkout-plate\"]')) return; const button = form.querySelector('button'); setBusy(button, true, 'Calculating'); try { const data = await api('/api/check-out', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({plate: input.value})}); toast(`${data.ticket.plate} checked out. Fee: ₹${Number(data.ticket.fee).toFixed(2)}`); form.reset(); await Promise.all([refreshDashboard(), refreshReports()]); } catch (error) { toast(error.message, true); } finally { setBusy(button, false); } });\n$('#search-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const form = event.target; const input = form.elements.plate; if (!wireValidation(input, '[data-error=\"search-plate\"]')) return; const button = form.querySelector('button'); setBusy(button, true, 'Searching'); try { const data = await api(`/api/vehicle/${encodeURIComponent(input.value)}`); const t = data.ticket; $('#search-result').className = 'search-result'; $('#search-result').innerHTML = `<strong>${t.plate}</strong>${t.vehicle_type.toUpperCase()} · ${t.spot_id} · Level ${t.level}<br>Parked since ${formatTime(t.entry_time)}`; } catch (error) { $('#search-result').className = 'search-result empty'; $('#search-result').textContent = error.message; } finally { setBusy(button, false); } });\ndocument.querySelectorAll('#check-in-form input[name=\"plate\"], #check-out-form input[name=\"plate\"], #search-form input[name=\"plate\"]').forEach(input => input.addEventListener('input', () => { input.value = input.value.toUpperCase(); }));\n$('#check-in-form select').addEventListener('change', updatePreview); ['#history-filter','#from-date','#to-date'].forEach(selector => $(selector).addEventListener('input', () => { currentPage = 1; loadHistory().catch(error => toast(error.message, true)); })); $('#previous-page').addEventListener('click', () => { if (currentPage > 1) { currentPage--; loadHistory(); } }); $('#next-page').addEventListener('click', () => { currentPage++; loadHistory(); });\nPromise.all([refreshDashboard(), refreshReports(), updatePreview()]).catch(error => toast(error.message, true));\n",

                "text": "from datetime import datetime, timedelta\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom src.garage import (\n\tCarNotFoundError,\n\tNoSpotAvailableError,\n\tParkingGarage,\n\tVehicleAlreadyParkedError,\n)\nfrom src.models import SpotType, Vehicle\nfrom src.rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nSTART = datetime(2026, 1, 1, 8, 0)\n\n\ndef make_garage(**counts: int) -> ParkingGarage:\n\treturn ParkingGarage(\n\t\tlevels=1,\n\t\tspots_per_level=counts,\n\t\trate_card=RateCard(\"5.00\", \"3.00\", \"25.00\"),\n\t)\n\n\ndef test_ev_vehicle_can_only_use_ev_spot() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=1, ev=1)\n\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"KA01AB1234\", SpotType.EV), START)\n\tassert garage.spots[ticket.spot_id].spot_type is SpotType.EV\n\n\ndef test_ev_check_in_fails_when_ev_spots_are_full() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=1, ev=0)\n\twith pytest.raises(NoSpotAvailableError):\n\t\tgarage.check_in(Vehicle(\"KA01AB1234\", SpotType.EV), START)\n\n\ndef test_compact_overflows_into_standard() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=0, standard=1, ev=0)\n\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"MH12CD5678\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\tassert garage.spots[ticket.spot_id].spot_type is SpotType.STANDARD\n\n\ndef test_standard_overflows_into_compact() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=0, ev=0)\n\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"DL03EF9012\", SpotType.STANDARD), START)\n\tassert garage.spots[ticket.spot_id].spot_type is SpotType.COMPACT\n\n\ndef test_spot_exhaustion_is_clean() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=0, ev=0)\n\tgarage.check_in(Vehicle(\"GJ05GH3456\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\twith pytest.raises(NoSpotAvailableError):\n\t\tgarage.check_in(Vehicle(\"MH12CD5678\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\n\ndef test_no_double_assignment_or_duplicate_active_plate() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=2, standard=0, ev=0)\n\tfirst = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"KA01AB1234\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\twith pytest.raises(VehicleAlreadyParkedError):\n\t\tgarage.check_in(Vehicle(\"KA01AB1234\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\tsecond = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"MH12CD5678\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\tassert first.spot_id != second.spot_id\n\n\ndef test_checkout_releases_spot_and_records_history() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=0, ev=0)\n\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"UP16JK7890\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\tcompleted = garage.check_out(\"UP16JK7890\", START + timedelta(hours=1))\n\tassert completed.fee == Decimal(\"5.00\")\n\tassert garage.find_car(\"UP16JK7890\") is None\n\tassert garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.COMPACT)\n\tassert garage.history == [ticket]\n\n\ndef test_active_lookup_and_availability_are_constant_time_indexes() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=0, ev=1)\n\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"RJ14LM1234\", SpotType.EV), START)\n\tassert garage.find_car(\"RJ14LM1234\") is ticket\n\tassert not garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.EV)\n\tgarage.check_out(\"RJ14LM1234\", START + timedelta(hours=1))\n\tassert garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.EV)\n\n\ndef test_missing_car_checkout_fails() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1)\n\twith pytest.raises(CarNotFoundError):\n\t\tgarage.check_out(\"KA01AB1234\", START)\n\n\ndef test_invalid_indian_plate_is_rejected() -> None:\n\tgarage = TWO PORTALS\r\n\r\n   ATTENDANT PORTAL (the existing \"Garage Control Room\" dashboard):\r\n   - Keep everything it currently does (check-in, check-out, search,\r\n     reports).\r\n   - Add a view of upcoming/pending reservations, and a way to convert a\r\n     reservation into an active check-in when the car actually arrives\r\n     (pre-fills plate/spot type from the reservation).\r\n\r\n   CUSTOMER PORTAL (new, separate route/page, no attendant tools visible):\r\n   - Live spot availability by type (compact/standard/EV) — read-only,\r\n     same numbers the attendant sees.\r\n   - A clearly displayed rate card: first hour rate, extra hour rate,\r\n     daily cap, all in ₹ — this is the \"fair pricing\" transparency view.\r\n   - A reservation form: pick spot type, plate number (Indian format),\r\n     and an arrival time window (e.g. \"arriving within the next 2\r\n     hours\" or a specific date+time for the near future — don't build a\r\n     far-future calendar system, keep it to same-day/near-term booking).\r\n   - After choosing a reservation, go to a payment step (see #3) to\r\n     confirm it.\r\n   - A \"find my reservation\" lookup by plate or confirmation code, so a\r\n     customer can check status or cancel.\r\n\r\n2.             "text": "Here are the answers:\r\n\r\n- Payment behavior: simulated/mock payment only, as I already specified —\r\n  no real provider integration.\r\n\r\n- Reservation duration and expiration rules: a reservation is for a\r\n  specific arrival window (e.g. \"arriving within the next 2 hours\" from\r\n  when it's made). The customer has 10 minutes from creating the\r\n  reservation to complete the mock payment, or it auto-expires and\r\n  releases the spot. Once paid, the hold lasts until the end of the\r\n  arrival window; if the customer hasn't checked in by then, the\r\n  reservation expires and the spot is released back to the free pool.\r\n\r\n- Whether a reserved spot is held immediately: only after payment is\r\n  confirmed, not at the moment the reservation form is submitted. Before\r\n  payment, it's a pending reservation and doesn't remove the spot from\r\n  the free count (so the availability numbers stay honest for other\r\n  customers looking at the same moment).\r\n\r\n- Cancellation and refund behavior: the customer can cancel a paid,\r\n  not-yet-checked-in reservation via the \"find my reservation\" lookup.\r\n  Since payment is mocked, \"refund\" just means marking the reservation\r\n  cancelled and instantly releasing the held spot — no real refund flow\r\n  needed, just reflect the cancelled state clearly in the UI/API\r\n  response.\r\n\r\n- Confirmation-code format: a short human-readable code, e.g. 6\r\n  characters, uppercase letters + digits (like \"PK4X9B\") — easy for a\r\n  customer to read back at the gate or type into \"find my reservation.\"\r\n\r\n- Maximum active reservations per plate: 1 — a plate can only have one\r\n  active (pending or paid, not yet checked-in/expired/cancelled)\r\n  reservation at a time. Reject a second reservation attempt for a plate\r\n  that already has one active, with a clear error message.\r\n\r\n- What happens when the customer arrives late or no spots remain: \"late\"\r\n  means past the arrival window — that reservation has already expired\r\n  per the rule above, so it's treated as a normal walk-in at that point\r\n  (their old reservation is gone, they go through normal check-in and\r\n  take their chances on availability like anyone else). If no spot of\r\n  the requested type is available at the moment a reservation is being\r\n  made (not paid yet), reject the reservation request cleanly, same as\r\n  today's check-in rejection when spots are exhausted.\r\n\r\nGo ahead and implement both portals, real-time updates, reservations, and\r\nthe payment flow with these rules. Keep Phase 1-3 logic intact, add tests\r\nfor the new reservation behavior (including the expiration and\r\nmax-one-active-reservation-per-plate rules), and update README.md to\r\ndocument all of this.",

                "text": "from dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nimport re\nfrom uuid import uuid4\n\n\nclass SpotType(str, Enum):\n\tCOMPACT = \"compact\"\n\tSTANDARD = \"standard\"\n\tEV = \"ev\"\n\n\nclass ReservationStatus(str, Enum):\n\tPENDING_PAYMENT = \"pending_payment\"\n\tPAID = \"paid\"\n\tCANCELLED = \"cancelled\"\n\tEXPIRED = \"expired\"\n\tCHECKED_IN = \"checked_in\"\n\n\nPLATE_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"^([A-Z]{2})-?(\\d{2})-?([A-Z]{1,2})-?(\\d{4})$\")\n\n\ndef normalize_plate(plate: str) -> str:\n\t\"\"\"Validate and canonicalize an Indian registration plate.\"\"\"\n\tcompact = re.sub(r\"[\\s-]+\", \"\", plate).upper()\n\tmatch = PLATE_PATTERN.fullmatch(compact)\n\tif match is None:\n\t\traise ValueError(\n\t\t\t\"invalid Indian plate; use 2 letters, 2 digits, 1-2 series letters, \"\n\t\t\t\"and 4 digits (for example KA01AB1234)\"\n\t\t)\n\treturn \"-\".join(match.groups())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Vehicle:\n\tplate: str\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\n\tdef __post_init__(self) -> None:\n\t\tobject.__setattr__(self, \"plate\", normalize_plate(self.plate))\n\t\tif isinstance(self.vehicle_type, str):\n\t\t\tobject.__setattr__(self, \"vehicle_type\", SpotType(self.vehicle_type.lower()))\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Spot:\n\tspot_id: str\n\tlevel: int\n\tspot_type: SpotType\n\thas_charger: bool = False\n\toccupied: bool = False\n\tvehicle: Vehicle | None = None\n\tticket_id: str | None = None\n\treservation_code: str | None = None\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Ticket:\n\tplate: str\n\tvehicle: Vehicle\n\tspot_id: str\n\tentry_time: datetime\n\texit_time: datetime | None = None\n\tfee: Decimal | None = None\n\tticket_id: str = \"\"\n\n\tdef __post_init__(self) -> None:\n\t\tif not self.ticket_id:\n\t\t\tself.ticket_id = uuid4().hex[:12].upper()\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Reservation:\n\tconfirmation_code: str\n\tplate: str\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\tarrival_start: datetime\n\tarrival_end: datetime\n\tcreated_at: datetime\n\tpayment_deadline: datetime\n\tstatus: ReservationStatus = ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT\n\tspot_id: str | None = None\n\tpaid_at: datetime | None = None\n\n",

                "text": "from datetime import datetime, timedelta\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nimport secrets\nimport string\nfrom threading import Lock\n\nfrom .models import Reservation, ReservationStatus, Spot, SpotType, Ticket, Vehicle, normalize_plate\nfrom .rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nclass GarageError(Exception):\n\t\"\"\"Base exception for expected garage operation failures.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass VehicleAlreadyParkedError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass NoSpotAvailableError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass CarNotFoundError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass ReservationNotFoundError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass ReservationConflictError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass ReservationExpiredError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass ParkingGarage:\n\tdef __init__(\n\t\tself,\n\t\tlevels: int,\n\t\tspots_per_level: Mapping[SpotType | str, int],\n\t\trate_card: RateCard,\n\t) -> None:\n\t\tif levels < 1:\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"levels must be at least 1\")\n\t\tnormalized_counts = {\n\t\t\tSpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type): count\n\t\t\tfor spot_type, count in spots_per_level.items()\n\t\t}\n\t\tif any(count < 0 for count in normalized_counts.values()):\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"spot counts must not be negative\")\n\n\t\tself.rate_card = rate_card\n\t\tself.spots: dict[str, Spot] = {}\n\t\tself.free_spots: dict[SpotType, set[str]] = {\n\t\t\tspot_type: set() for spot_type in SpotType\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor level in range(1, levels + 1):\n\t\t\tfor spot_type in SpotType:\n\t\t\t\tfor number in range(1, normalized_counts.get(spot_type, 0) + 1):\n\t\t\t\t\tspot_id = f\"L{level}-{spot_type.value.upper()}-{number}\"\n\t\t\t\t\tspot = Spot(\n\t\t\t\t\t\tspot_id=spot_id,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tlevel=level,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tspot_type=spot_type,\n\t\t\t\t\t\thas_charger=spot_type is SpotType.EV,\n\t\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\t\tself.spots[spot_id] = spot\n\t\t\t\t\tself.free_spots[spot_type].add(spot_id)\n\n\t\tself.active_tickets: dict[str, Ticket] = {}\n\t\tself.history: list[Ticket] = []\n\t\tself.reservations: dict[str, Reservation] = {}\n\t\tself.reservation_by_plate: dict[str, str] = {}\n\t\tself._lock = Lock()\n\n\tdef check_in(self, vehicle: Vehicle, entry_time: datetime | None = None) -> Ticket:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(entry_time or datetime.now())\n\t\t\tif vehicle.plate in self.active_tickets:\n\t\t\t\traise VehicleAlreadyParkedError(f\"{vehicle.plate} is already parked\")\n\n\t\t\tcandidate_types = self._spot_type_for(vehicle.vehicle_type)\n\t\t\tselected_type = next(\n\t\t\t\t(candidate for candidate in candidate_types if self.free_spots[candidate]), None\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tif selected_type is None:\n\t\t\t\traise NoSpotAvailableError(\n\t\t\t\t\tf\"no spot available for {vehicle.vehicle_type.value} vehicle\"\n\t\t\t\t)\n\n\t\t\tselected_id = self.free_spots[selected_type].pop()\n\t\t\tspot = self.spots[selected_id]\n\t\t\tticket = Ticket(\n\t\t\t\tplate=vehicle.plate,\n\t\t\t\tvehicle=vehicle,\n\t\t\t\tspot_id=selected_id,\n\t\t\t\tentry_time=entry_time or datetime.now(),\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tspot.occupied = True\n\t\t\tspot.vehicle = vehicle\n\t\t\tspot.ticket_id = ticket.ticket_id\n\t\t\tself.active_tickets[vehicle.plate] = ticket\n\t\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef create_reservation(\n\t\tself,\n\t\tvehicle: Vehicle,\n\t\tarrival_start: datetime,\n\t\tarrival_end: datetime,\n\t\tnow: datetime | None = None,\n\t) -> Reservation:\n\t\tcurrent = now or datetime.now()\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(current)\n\t\t\tif vehicle.plate in self.active_tickets:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(f\"{vehicle.plate} is already parked\")\n\t\t\tif vehicle.plate in self.reservation_by_plate:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(f\"{vehicle.plate} already has an active reservation\")\n\t\t\tif arrival_end <= arrival_start or arrival_start < current:\n\t\t\t\traise ValueError(\"arrival window must be in the future and end after it starts\")\n\t\t\tif arrival_start > current + timedelta(hours=24) or arrival_end > current + timedelta(hours=24):\n\t\t\t\traise ValueError(\"reservations are limited to the next 24 hours\")\n\t\t\tif not any(self.free_spots[candidate] for candidate in self._spot_type_for(vehicle.vehicle_type)):\n\t\t\t\traise NoSpotAvailableError(f\"no spot available for {vehicle.vehicle_type.value} reservation\")\n\t\t\tcode = self._new_confirmation_code()\n\t\t\treservation = Reservation(\n\t\t\t\tconfirmation_code=code,\n\t\t\t\tplate=vehicle.plate,\n\t\t\t\tvehicle_type=vehicle.vehicle_type,\n\t\t\t\tarrival_start=arrival_start,\n\t\t\t\tarrival_end=arrival_end,\n\t\t\t\tcreated_at=current,\n\t\t\t\tpayment_deadline=current + timedelta(minutes=10),\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tself.reservations[code] = reservation\n\t\t\tself.reservation_by_plate[vehicle.plate] = code\n\t\t\treturn reservation\n\n\tdef pay_reservation(self, confirmation_code: str, now: datetime | None = None) -> Reservation:\n\t\tcurrent = now or datetime.now()\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(current)\n\t\t\treservation = self._reservation_or_error(confirmation_code)\n\t\t\tif reservation.status is not ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(f\"reservation is {reservation.status.value}\")\n\t\t\tselected_type = next(\n\t\t\t\t(candidate for candidate in self._spot_type_for(reservation.vehicle_type) if self.free_spots[candidate]),\n\t\t\t\tNone,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tif selected_type is None:\n\t\t\t\traise NoSpotAvailableError(\"no compatible spot remains; payment was not completed\")\n\t\t\tspot_id = self.free_spots[selected_type].pop()\n\t\t\tspot = self.spots[spot_id]\n\t\t\tspot.reservation_code = reservation.confirmation_code\n\t\t\treservation.spot_id = spot_id\n\t\t\treservation.paid_at = current\n\t\t\treservation.status = ReservationStatus.PAID\n\t\t\treturn reservation\n\n\tdef cancel_reservation(self, confirmation_code: str, now: datetime | None = None) -> Reservation:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(now or datetime.now())\n\t\t\treservation = self._reservation_or_error(confirmation_code)\n\t\t\tif reservation.status not in {ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT, ReservationStatus.PAID}:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(f\"reservation is {reservation.status.value}\")\n\t\t\tself._release_reserved_spot(reservation)\n\t\t\treservation.status = ReservationStatus.CANCELLED\n\t\t\tself.reservation_by_plate.pop(reservation.plate, None)\n\t\t\treturn reservation\n\n\tdef find_reservation(self, lookup: str, now: datetime | None = None) -> Reservation | None:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(now or datetime.now())\n\t\t\tcode = lookup.strip().upper()\n\t\t\tif code not in self.reservations:\n\t\t\t\ttry:\n\t\t\t\t\tcode = self.reservation_by_plate.get(normalize_plate(lookup), \"\")\n\t\t\t\texcept ValueError:\n\t\t\t\t\treturn None\n\t\t\treturn self.reservations.get(code)\n\n\tdef convert_reservation_to_check_in(\n\t\tself, confirmation_code: str, entry_time: datetime | None = None\n\t) -> Ticket:\n\t\tcurrent = entry_time or datetime.now()\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(current)\n\t\t\treservation = self._reservation_or_error(confirmation_code)\n\t\t\tif reservation.status is not ReservationStatus.PAID or not reservation.spot_id:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(\"reservation must be paid before check-in\")\n\t\t\tif reservation.plate in self.active_tickets:\n\t\t\t\traise VehicleAlreadyParkedError(f\"{reservation.plate} is already parked\")\n\t\t\tspot = self.spots[reservation.spot_id]\n\t\t\tspot.reservation_code = None\n\t\t\tspot.occupied = True\n\t\t\tvehicle = Vehicle(reservation.plate, reservation.vehicle_type)\n\t\t\tticket = Ticket(plate=vehicle.plate, vehicle=vehicle, spot_id=spot.spot_id, entry_time=current)\n\t\t\tspot.vehicle = vehicle\n\t\t\tspot.ticket_id = ticket.ticket_id\n\t\t\tself.active_tickets[vehicle.plate] = ticket\n\t\t\treservation.status = ReservationStatus.CHECKED_IN\n\t\t\tself.reservation_by_plate.pop(reservation.plate, None)\n\t\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef upcoming_reservations(self, now: datetime | None = None) -> list[Reservation]:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(now or datetime.now())\n\t\t\treturn [reservation for reservation in self.reservations.values() if reservation.status in {ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT, ReservationStatus.PAID}]\n\n\tdef _expire_reservations(self, current: datetime) -> None:\n\t\tfor reservation in self.reservations.values():\n\t\t\tif reservation.status is ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT and current >= reservation.payment_deadline:\n\t\t\t\treservation.status = ReservationStatus.EXPIRED\n\t\t\t\tself.reservation_by_plate.pop(reservation.plate, None)\n\t\t\telif reservation.status is ReservationStatus.PAID and current > reservation.arrival_end:\n\t\t\t\tself._release_reserved_spot(reservation)\n\t\t\t\treservation.status = ReservationStatus.EXPIRED\n\t\t\t\tself.reservation_by_plate.pop(reservation.plate, None)\n\n\tdef _release_reserved_spot(self, reservation: Reservation) -> None:\n\t\tif reservation.spot_id:\n\t\t\tspot = self.spots[reservation.spot_id]\n\t\t\tspot.reservation_code = None\n\t\t\tif not spot.occupied:\n\t\t\t\tself.free_spots[spot.spot_type].add(spot.spot_id)\n\t\t\treservation.spot_id = None\n\n\tdef _reservation_or_error(self, confirmation_code: str) -> Reservation:\n\t\treservation = self.reservations.get(confirmation_code.strip().upper())\n\t\tif reservation is None:\n\t\t\traise ReservationNotFoundError(\"reservation not found\")\n\t\treturn reservation\n\n\tdef _new_confirmation_code(self) -> str:\n\t\talphabet = string.ascii_uppercase + string.digits\n\t\twhile True:\n\t\t\tcode = \"\".join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(6))\n\t\t\tif code not in self.reservations:\n\t\t\t\treturn code\n\n\tdef check_out(\n\t\tself, plate: str, exit_time: datetime | None = None\n\t) -> Ticket:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tticket = self.active_tickets.pop(normalize_plate(plate), None)\n\t\t\tif ticket is None:\n\t\t\t\traise CarNotFoundError(f\"no active ticket for {plate}\")\n\t\t\tticket.exit_time = exit_time or datetime.now()\n\t\t\tticket.fee = self.rate_card.calculate_fee(ticket.entry_time, ticket.exit_time)\n\t\t\tspot = self.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\t\t\tspot.occupied = False\n\t\t\tspot.vehicle = None\n\t\t\tspot.ticket_id = None\n\t\t\tself.free_spots[spot.spot_type].add(spot.spot_id)\n\t\t\tself.history.append(ticket)\n\t\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef find_car(self, plate: str) -> Ticket | None:\n\t\treturn self.active_tickets.get(normalize_plate(plate))\n\n\tdef is_spot_free(self, spot_type: SpotType | str) -> bool:\n\t\tnormalized_type = SpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type)\n\t\treturn bool(self.free_spots[normalized_type])\n\n\tdef available_spot_count(self, spot_type: SpotType | str) -> int:\n\t\tnormalized_type = SpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type)\n\t\treturn len(self.free_spots[normalized_type])\n\n\t@staticmethod\n\tdef _spot_type_for(vehicle_type: SpotType) -> list[SpotType]:\n\t\tif vehicle_type is SpotType.EV:\n\t\t\treturn [SpotType.EV]\n\t\tif vehicle_type is SpotType.COMPACT:\n\t\t\treturn [SpotType.COMPACT, SpotType.STANDARD]\n\t\treturn [SpotType.STANDARD, SpotType.COMPACT]\n",

pydantic import BaseModel, Field\n\nfrom .garage import (\n\tCarNotFoundError,\n\tNoSpotAvailableError,\n\tParkingGarage,\n\tReservationConflictError,\n\tReservationExpiredError,\n\tReservationNotFoundError,\n\tVehicleAlreadyParkedError,\n)\nfrom .models import Reservation, ReservationStatus, SpotType, Ticket, Vehicle, normalize_plate\nfrom .rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nBASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n\n\ndef build_garage() -> ParkingGarage:\n\treturn ParkingGarage(\n\t\tlevels=3,\n\t\tspots_per_level={SpotType.COMPACT: 10, SpotType.STANDARD: 15, SpotType.EV: 5},\n\t\trate_card=RateCard(50, 30, 200),\n\t)\n\n\ngarage = build_garage()\napp = FastAPI(title=\"Parking Garage Attendant System\", version=\"1.0.0\")\n\n\nclass CheckInRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\tentry_time: datetime | None = None\n\n\nclass CheckOutRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\texit_time: datetime | None = None\n\n\nclass ReservationRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\tarrival_start: datetime\n\tarrival_end: datetime\n\n\ndef ticket_data(ticket: Ticket, include_exit: bool = False) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tspot = garage.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\tdata: dict[str, object] = {\n\t\t\"ticket_id\": ticket.ticket_id,\n\t\t\"plate\": ticket.plate,\n\t\t\"vehicle_type\": ticket.vehicle.vehicle_type.value,\n\t\t\"spot_id\": ticket.spot_id,\n\t\t\"level\": spot.level,\n\t\t\"entry_time\": ticket.entry_time.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"status\": \"completed\" if ticket.exit_time else \"parked\",\n\t}\n\tif include_exit:\n\t\tdata[\"exit_time\"] = ticket.exit_time.isoformat() if ticket.exit_time else None\n\t\tdata[\"fee\"] = str(ticket.fee) if ticket.fee is not None else None\n\treturn data\n\n\ndef reservation_data(reservation: Reservation) -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"confirmation_code\": reservation.confirmation_code,\n\t\t\"plate\": reservation.plate,\n\t\t\"vehicle_type\": reservation.vehicle_type.value,\n\t\t\"arrival_start\": reservation.arrival_start.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"arrival_end\": reservation.arrival_end.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"created_at\": reservation.created_at.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"payment_deadline\": reservation.payment_deadline.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"status\": reservation.status.value,\n\t\t\"spot_id\": reservation.spot_id,\n\t}\n\n\ndef error_response(error: Exception) -> HTTPException:\n\tif isinstance(error, VehicleAlreadyParkedError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, NoSpotAvailableError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, CarNotFoundError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, ReservationNotFoundError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, (ReservationConflictError, ReservationExpiredError)):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\treturn HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(error))\n\n\n@app.get(\"/\", response_class=FileResponse)\ndef index() -> FileResponse:\n\treturn FileResponse(BASE_DIR / \"templates\" / \"index.html\")\n\n\n@app.get(\"/customer\", response_class=FileResponse)\ndef customer_portal() -> FileResponse:\n\treturn FileResponse(BASE_DIR / \"templates\" / \"customer.html\")\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check-in\", status_code=201)\ndef check_in(payload: CheckInRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tvehicle = Vehicle(payload.plate, payload.vehicle_type)\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.check_in(vehicle, payload.entry_time))}\n\texcept (ValueError, VehicleAlreadyParkedError, NoSpotAvailableError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check-out\")\ndef check_out(payload: CheckOutRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.check_out(normalize_plate(payload.plate), payload.exit_time), True)}\n\texcept (ValueError, CarNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/vehicle/{plate}\")\ndef vehicle_lookup(plate: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tnormalized_plate = normalize_plate(plate)\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(error)) from error\n\tticket = garage.find_car(normalized_plate)\n\tif ticket is None:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"vehicle is not currently parked\")\n\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(ticket)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability\")\ndef availability() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tcounts = {spot_type.value: garage.available_spot_count(spot_type) for spot_type in SpotType}\n\treserved = sum(reservation.status is ReservationStatus.PAID for reservation in garage.reservations.values())\n\treturn {\"available\": counts, \"total\": len(garage.spots), \"occupied\": len(garage.active_tickets), \"reserved\": reserved}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability/{spot_type}\")\ndef type_availability(spot_type: SpotType) -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\"spot_type\": spot_type.value, \"available\": garage.available_spot_count(spot_type), \"is_free\": garage.is_spot_free(spot_type)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/transactions\")\ndef transactions(\n\tplate: str = \"\",\n\tfrom_date: date | None = None,\n\tto_date: date | None = None,\n\tpage: int = Query(1, ge=1),\n\tpage_size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100),\n) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tnormalized_filter = normalize_plate(plate) if plate else \"\"\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(error)) from error\n\tfiltered = [ticket for ticket in reversed(garage.history) if (\n\t\t(not normalized_filter or normalized_filter in ticket.plate)\n\t\tand (from_date is None or ticket.entry_time.date() >= from_date)\n\t\tand (to_date is None or ticket.entry_time.date() <= to_date)\n\t)]\n\tstart = (page - 1) * page_size\n\tpage_items = filtered[start:start + page_size]\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"transactions\": [ticket_data(ticket, True) for ticket in page_items],\n\t\t\"page\": page,\n\t\t\"page_size\": page_size,\n\t\t\"total\": len(filtered),\n\t\t\"pages\": max(1, (len(filtered) + page_size - 1) // page_size),\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tavailability_data = availability()\n\treturn {\n\t\t**availability_data,\n\t\t\"active_vehicles\": len(garage.active_tickets),\n\t\t\"completed_transactions\": len(garage.history),\n\t\t\"ev_available\": garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.EV),\n\t\t\"upcoming_reservations\": [reservation_data(reservation) for reservation in garage.upcoming_reservations()],\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/customer/config\")\ndef customer_config() -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"rates\": {\n\t\t\t\"first_hour_rate\": str(garage.rate_card.first_hour_rate),\n\t\t\t\"additional_hour_rate\": str(garage.rate_card.additional_hour_rate),\n\t\t\t\"daily_cap\": str(garage.rate_card.daily_cap),\n\t\t},\n\t\t\"reservation_payment_minutes\": 10,\n\t}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations\", status_code=201)\ndef create_reservation(payload: ReservationRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treservation = garage.create_reservation(\n\t\t\tVehicle(payload.plate, payload.vehicle_type), payload.arrival_start, payload.arrival_end\n\t\t)\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(reservation), \"next_step\": \"payment\"}\n\texcept (ValueError, NoSpotAvailableError, ReservationConflictError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/pay\")\ndef pay_reservation(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(garage.pay_reservation(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (NoSpotAvailableError, ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reservations/lookup\")\ndef lookup_reservation(plate: str | None = None, code: str | None = None) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tif not plate and not code:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=\"provide a plate or confirmation code\")\n\treservation = garage.find_reservation(code or plate or \"\")\n\tif reservation is None:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"reservation not found\")\n\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(reservation)}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/cancel\")\ndef cancel_reservation(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(garage.cancel_reservation(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/check-in\", status_code=201)\ndef reservation_check_in(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.convert_reservation_to_check_in(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError, ReservationExpiredError, VehicleAlreadyParkedError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reservations\")\ndef reservations() -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\"reservations\": [reservation_data(reservation) for reservation in garage.upcoming_reservations()]}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reports\")\ndef reports() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tnow = datetime.now()\n\ttoday = now.date()\n\tweek_start = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday())\n\tcompleted = garage.history\n\trevenue_today = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() == today), 0)\n\trevenue_week = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() >= week_start), 0)\n\tstay_seconds = [\n\t\t(ticket.exit_time - ticket.entry_time).total_seconds()\n\t\tfor ticket in completed\n\t\tif ticket.exit_time is not None\n\t]\n\toccupancy: dict[str, dict[str, float | int]] = {}\n\tfor spot_type in SpotType:\n\t\ttype_spots = [spot for spot in garage.spots.values() if spot.spot_type is spot_type]\n\t\toccupied = sum(spot.occupied for spot in type_spots)\n\t\toccupancy[spot_type.value] = {\n\t\t\t\"occupied\": occupied,\n\t\t\t\"total\": len(type_spots),\n\t\t\t\"percentage\": round((occupied / len(type_spots)) * 100, 1) if type_spots else 0,\n\t\t}\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"revenue_today\": str(revenue_today),\n\t\t\"revenue_week\": str(revenue_week),\n\t\t\"occupancy\": occupancy,\n\t\t\"average_stay_minutes\": round(sum(stay_seconds) / len(stay_seconds) / 60, 1) if stay_seconds else 0,\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/static/{asset_path:path}\")\ndef static_asset(asset_path: str) -> FileResponse:\n\tpath = BASE_DIR / \"static\" / asset_path\n\tif not path.is_file() or BASE_DIR not in path.resolve().parents:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"asset not found\")\n\treturn FileResponse(path)",

                "text": "from datetime import datetime, timedelta\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom src.garage import (\n\tCarNotFoundError,\n\tNoSpotAvailableError,\n\tParkingGarage,\n\tVehicleAlreadyParkedError,\n)\nfrom src.models import ReservationStatus, SpotType, Vehicle\nfrom src.rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nSTART = datetime(2026, 1, 1, 8, 0)\n\n\ndef make_garage(**counts: int) -> ParkingGarage:\n\treturn ParkingGarage(\n\t\tlevels=1,\n\t\tspots_per_level=counts,\n\t\trate_card=RateCard(\"5.00\", \"3.00\", \"25.00\"),\n\t)\n\n\ndef test_ev_vehicle_can_only_use_ev_spot() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=1, ev=1)\n\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"KA01AB1234\", SpotType.EV), START)\n\tassert garage.spots[ticket.spot_id].spot_type is SpotType.EV\n\n\ndef test_ev_check_in_fails_when_ev_spots_are_full() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=1, ev=0)\n\twith pytest.raises(NoSpotAvailableError):\n\t\tgarage.check_in(Vehicle(\"KA01AB1234\", SpotType.EV), START)\n\n\ndef test_compact_overflows_into_standard() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=0, standard=1, ev=0)\n\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"MH12CD5678\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\tassert garage.spots[ticket.spot_id].spot_type is SpotType.STANDARD\n\n\ndef test_standard_overflows_into_compact() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=0, ev=0)\n\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"DL03EF9012\", SpotType.STANDARD), START)\n\tassert garage.spots[ticket.spot_id].spot_type is SpotType.COMPACT\n\n\ndef test_spot_exhaustion_is_clean() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=0, ev=0)\n\tgarage.check_in(Vehicle(\"GJ05GH3456\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\twith pytest.raises(NoSpotAvailableError):\n\t\tgarage.check_in(Vehicle(\"MH12CD5678\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\n\ndef test_no_double_assignment_or_duplicate_active_plate() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=2, standard=0, ev=0)\n\tfirst = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"KA01AB1234\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\twith pytest.raises(VehicleAlreadyParkedError):\n\t\tgarage.check_in(Vehicle(\"KA01AB1234\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\tsecond = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"MH12CD5678\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\tassert first.spot_id != second.spot_id\n\n\ndef test_checkout_releases_spot_and_records_history() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=0, ev=0)\n\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"UP16JK7890\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\tcompleted = garage.check_out(\"UP16JK7890\", START + timedelta(hours=1))\n\tassert completed.fee == Decimal(\"5.00\")\n\tassert garage.find_car(\"UP16JK7890\") is None\n\tassert garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.COMPACT)\n\tassert garage.history == [ticket]\n\n\ndef test_active_lookup_and_availability_are_constant_time_indexes() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=0, ev=1)\n\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"RJ14LM1234\", SpotType.EV), START)\n\tassert garage.find_car(\"RJ14LM1234\") is ticket\n\tassert not garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.EV)\n\tgarage.check_out(\"RJ14LM1234\", START + timedelta(hours=1))\n\tassert garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.EV)\n\n\ndef test_missing_car_checkout_fails() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1)\n\twith pytest.raises(CarNotFoundError):\n\t\tgarage.check_out(\"KA01AB1234\", START)\n\n\ndef test_invalid_indian_plate_is_rejected() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1)\n\twith pytest.raises(ValueError, match=\"invalid Indian plate\"):\n\t\tgarage.check_in(Vehicle(\"abc123\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\n\ndef test_pending_reservation_does_not_reduce_free_count_until_payment() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1)\n\treservation = garage.create_reservation(\n\t\tVehicle(\"KA01AB1234\", SpotType.COMPACT),\n\t\tSTART + timedelta(minutes=10),\n\t\tSTART + timedelta(hours=2),\n\t\tSTART,\n\t)\n\tassert reservation.status is ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT\n\tassert garage.available_spot_count(SpotType.COMPACT) == 1\n\tpaid = garage.pay_reservation(reservation.confirmation_code, START + timedelta(minutes=1))\n\tassert paid.status is ReservationStatus.PAID\n\tassert garage.available_spot_count(SpotType.COMPACT) == 0\n\n\ndef test_payment_expiration_releases_pending_reservation_and_allows_new_one() -> None:\n\tgarage = SpotType.COMPACT), START + timedelta(minutes=20), START + timedelta(hours=2), START + timedelta(minutes=11)\n\t)\n\tassert new_reservation.status is ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT\n\n\ndef                 "text": "from datetime import datetime, timedelta\nfrom decimal import Decimal\n\nimport pytest\n\nfrom src.garage import (\n\tCarNotFoundError,\n\tNoSpotAvailableError,\n\tParkingGarage,\n\tReservationConflictError,\n\tVehicleAlreadyParkedError,\n)\nfrom src.models import ReservationStatus, SpotType, Vehicle\nfrom src.rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nSTART = datetime(2026, 1, 1, 8, 0)\n\n\ndef make_garage(**counts: int) -> ParkingGarage:\n\treturn ParkingGarage(\n\t\tlevels=1,\n\t\tspots_per_level=counts,\n\t\trate_card=RateCard(\"5.00\", \"3.00\", \"25.00\"),\n\t)\n\n\ndef test_ev_vehicle_can_only_use_ev_spot() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=1, ev=1)\n\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"KA01AB1234\", SpotType.EV), START)\n\tassert garage.spots[ticket.spot_id].spot_type is SpotType.EV\n\n\ndef test_ev_check_in_fails_when_ev_spots_are_full() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=1, ev=0)\n\twith pytest.raises(NoSpotAvailableError):\n\t\tgarage.check_in(Vehicle(\"KA01AB1234\", SpotType.EV), START)\n\n\ndef test_compact_overflows_into_standard() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=0, standard=1, ev=0)\n\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"MH12CD5678\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\tassert garage.spots[ticket.spot_id].spot_type is SpotType.STANDARD\n\n\ndef test_standard_overflows_into_compact() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=0, ev=0)\n\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"DL03EF9012\", SpotType.STANDARD), START)\n\tassert garage.spots[ticket.spot_id].spot_type is SpotType.COMPACT\n\n\ndef test_spot_exhaustion_is_clean() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=0, ev=0)\n\tgarage.check_in(Vehicle(\"GJ05GH3456\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\twith pytest.raises(NoSpotAvailableError):\n\t\tgarage.check_in(Vehicle(\"MH12CD5678\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\n\ndef test_no_double_assignment_or_duplicate_active_plate() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=2, standard=0, ev=0)\n\tfirst = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"KA01AB1234\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\twith pytest.raises(VehicleAlreadyParkedError):\n\t\tgarage.check_in(Vehicle(\"KA01AB1234\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\tsecond = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"MH12CD5678\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\tassert first.spot_id != second.spot_id\n\n\ndef test_checkout_releases_spot_and_records_history() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=0, ev=0)\n\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"UP16JK7890\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\tcompleted = garage.check_out(\"UP16JK7890\", START + timedelta(hours=1))\n\tassert completed.fee == Decimal(\"5.00\")\n\tassert garage.find_car(\"UP16JK7890\") is None\n\tassert garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.COMPACT)\n\tassert garage.history == [ticket]\n\n\ndef test_active_lookup_and_availability_are_constant_time_indexes() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1, standard=0, ev=1)\n\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"RJ14LM1234\", SpotType.EV), START)\n\tassert garage.find_car(\"RJ14LM1234\") is ticket\n\tassert not garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.EV)\n\tgarage.check_out(\"RJ14LM1234\", START + timedelta(hours=1))\n\tassert garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.EV)\n\n\ndef test_missing_car_checkout_fails() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1)\n\twith pytest.raises(CarNotFoundError):\n\t\tgarage.check_out(\"KA01AB1234\", START)\n\n\ndef test_invalid_indian_plate_is_rejected() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1)\n\twith pytest.raises(ValueError, match=\"invalid Indian plate\"):\n\t\tgarage.check_in(Vehicle(\"abc123\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\n\ndef test_pending_reservation_does_not_reduce_free_count_until_payment() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1)\n\treservation = garage.create_reservation(\n\t\tVehicle(\"KA01AB1234\", SpotType.COMPACT),\n\t\tSTART + timedelta(minutes=10),\n\t\tSTART + timedelta(hours=2),\n\t\tSTART,\n\t)\n\tassert reservation.status is ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT\n\tassert garage.available_spot_count(SpotType.COMPACT) == 1\n\tpaid = garage.pay_reservation(reservation.confirmation_code, START + timedelta(minutes=1))\n\tassert paid.status is ReservationStatus.PAID\n\tassert garage.available_spot_count(SpotType.COMPACT) == 0\n\n\ndef test_payment_expiration_releases_pending_reservation_and_allows_new_one() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1)\n\treservation = garage.create_reservation(\n\t\tVehicle(\"MH12CD5678\", SpotType.COMPACT), START + timedelta(minutes=10), START + timedelta(hours=2), START\n\t)\n\tassert garage.find_reservation(reservation.confirmation_code, START + timedelta(minutes=11)).status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED\n\tnew_reservation = garage.create_reservation(\n\t\tVehicle(\"DL03EF9012\", SpotType.COMPACT), START + timedelta(minutes=20), START + timedelta(hours=2), START + timedelta(minutes=11)\n\t)\n\tassert new_reservation.status is ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT\n\n\ndef test_paid_reservation_expiration_releases_held_spot() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1)\n\treservation = garage.create_reservation(\n\t\tVehicle(\"GJ05GH3456\", SpotType.COMPACT), START + timedelta(minutes=10), START + timedelta(minutes=30), START\n\t)\n\tgarage.pay_reservation(reservation.confirmation_code, START + timedelta(minutes=1))\n\tassert garage.available_spot_count(SpotType.COMPACT) == 0\n\tassert garage.find_reservation(reservation.confirmation_code, START + timedelta(minutes=31)).status is ReservationStatus.EXPIRED\n\tassert garage.available_spot_count(SpotType.COMPACT) == 1\n\n\ndef test_only_one_active_reservation_per_plate() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=2)\n\tgarage.create_reservation(Vehicle(\"RJ14LM1234\", SpotType.COMPACT), START + timedelta(minutes=10), START + timedelta(hours=2), START)\n\twith pytest.raises(ReservationConflictError, match=\"already has an active reservation\"):\n\t\tgarage.create_reservation(Vehicle(\"RJ14LM1234\", SpotType.COMPACT), START + timedelta(minutes=20), START + timedelta(hours=2), START)\n\n\ndef test_paid_reservation_can_be_cancelled_and_converted() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=2)\n\treservation = timedelta(minutes=1))\n\tgarage.cancel_reservation(reservation.confirmation_code, START + timedelta(minutes=2))\n\tassert garage.available_spot_count(SpotType.COMPACT) == 2\n\n\tsecond = garage.create_reservation(Vehicle(\"KA01AB1234\", SpotType.COMPACT), START + timedelta(minutes=10), START + timedelta(hours=2), START)\n\tgarage.pay_reservation(second.confirmation_code, START + timedelta(minutes=1))\n\tticket = garage.convert_reservation_to_check_in(second.confirmation_code, START + timedelta(minutes=5))\n\tassert ticket.plate == \"KA-01-AB-1234\"\n\tassert second.status is
