                "text": "from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Query\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, Field\n\nfrom .garage import (\n\tCarNotFoundError,\n\tNoSpotAvailableError,\n\tParkingGarage,\n\tReservationConflictError,\n\tReservationExpiredError,\n\tReservationNotFoundError,\n\tVehicleAlreadyParkedError,\n)\nfrom .models import Reservation, ReservationStatus, SpotType, Ticket, Vehicle, normalize_plate\nfrom .rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nBASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n\n\ndef build_garage() -> ParkingGarage:\n\treturn ParkingGarage(\n\t\tlevels=3,\n\t\tspots_per_level={SpotType.COMPACT: 10, SpotType.STANDARD: 15, SpotType.EV: 5},\n\t\trate_card=RateCard(50, 30, 200),\n\t)\n\n\ngarage = build_garage()\napp = FastAPI(title=\"Parking Garage Attendant System\", version=\"1.0.0\")\n\n\nclass CheckInRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\tentry_time: datetime | None = None\n\n\nclass CheckOutRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\texit_time: datetime | None = None\n\n\nclass ReservationRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\tarrival_start: datetime\n\tarrival_end: datetime\n\n\ndef ticket_data(ticket: Ticket, include_exit: bool = False) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tspot = garage.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\tdata: dict[str, object] = {\n\t\t\"ticket_id\": ticket.ticket_id,\n\t\t\"plate\": ticket.plate,\n\t\t\"vehicle_type\": ticket.vehicle.vehicle_type.value,\n\t\t\"spot_id\": ticket.spot_id,\n\t\t\"level\": spot.level,\n\t\t\"entry_time\": ticket.entry_time.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"status\": \"completed\" if ticket.exit_time else \"parked\",\n\t}\n\tif include_exit:\n\t\tdata[\"exit_time\"] = ticket.exit_time.isoformat() if ticket.exit_time else None\n\t\tdata[\"fee\"] = str(ticket.fee) if ticket.fee is not None else None\n\treturn data\n\n\ndef reservation_data(reservation: Reservation) -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"confirmation_code\": reservation.confirmation_code,\n\t\t\"plate\": reservation.plate,\n\t\t\"vehicle_type\": reservation.vehicle_type.value,\n\t\t\"arrival_start\": reservation.arrival_start.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"arrival_end\": reservation.arrival_end.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"created_at\": reservation.created_at.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"payment_deadline\": reservation.payment_deadline.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"status\": reservation.status.value,\n\t\t\"spot_id\": reservation.spot_id,\n\t}\n\n\ndef error_response(error: Exception) -> HTTPException:\n\tif isinstance(error, VehicleAlreadyParkedError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, NoSpotAvailableError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, CarNotFoundError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, ReservationNotFoundError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, (ReservationConflictError, ReservationExpiredError)):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\treturn HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(error))\n\n\n@app.get(\"/\", response_class=FileResponse)\ndef index() -> FileResponse:\n\treturn FileResponse(BASE_DIR / \"templates\" / \"index.html\")\n\n\n@app.get(\"/customer\", response_class=FileResponse)\ndef customer_portal() -> FileResponse:\n\treturn FileResponse(BASE_DIR / \"templates\" / \"customer.html\")\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check-in\", status_code=201)\ndef check_in(payload: CheckInRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tvehicle = Vehicle(payload.plate, payload.vehicle_type)\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.check_in(vehicle, payload.entry_time))}\n\texcept (ValueError, VehicleAlreadyParkedError, NoSpotAvailableError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check-out\")\ndef check_out(payload: CheckOutRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.check_out(normalize_plate(payload.plate), payload.exit_time), True)}\n\texcept (ValueError, CarNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/vehicle/{plate}\")\ndef vehicle_lookup(plate: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tnormalized_plate = normalize_plate(plate)\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(error)) from error\n\tticket = garage.find_car(normalized_plate)\n\tif ticket is None:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"vehicle is not currently parked\")\n\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(ticket)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability\")\ndef availability() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tgarage.upcoming_reservations()\n\tcounts = {spot_type.value: garage.available_spot_count(spot_type) for spot_type in SpotType}\n\treserved = sum(reservation.status is ReservationStatus.PAID for reservation in garage.reservations.values())\n\treturn {\"available\": counts, \"total\": len(garage.spots), \"occupied\": len(garage.active_tickets), \"reserved\": reserved}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability/{spot_type}\")\ndef type_availability(spot_type: SpotType) -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\"spot_type\": spot_type.value, \"available\": garage.available_spot_count(spot_type), \"is_free\": garage.is_spot_free(spot_type)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/transactions\")\ndef transactions(\n\tplate: str = \"\",\n\tfrom_date: date | None = None,\n\tto_date: date | None = None,\n\tpage: int = Query(1, ge=1),\n\tpage_size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100),\n) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tnormalized_filter = normalize_plate(plate) if plate else \"\"\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(error)) from error\n\tfiltered = [ticket for ticket in reversed(garage.history) if (\n\t\t(not normalized_filter or normalized_filter in ticket.plate)\n\t\tand (from_date is None or ticket.entry_time.date() >= from_date)\n\t\tand (to_date is None or ticket.entry_time.date() <= to_date)\n\t)]\n\tstart = (page - 1) * page_size\n\tpage_items = filtered[start:start + page_size]\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"transactions\": [ticket_data(ticket, True) for ticket in page_items],\n\t\t\"page\": page,\n\t\t\"page_size\": page_size,\n\t\t\"total\": len(filtered),\n\t\t\"pages\": max(1, (len(filtered) + page_size - 1) // page_size),\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tavailability_data = availability()\n\treturn {\n\t\t**availability_data,\n\t\t\"active_vehicles\": len(garage.active_tickets),\n\t\t\"completed_transactions\": len(garage.history),\n\t\t\"ev_available\": garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.EV),\n\t\t\"upcoming_reservations\": [reservation_data(reservation) for reservation in garage.upcoming_reservations()],\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/customer/config\")\ndef customer_config() -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"rates\": {\n\t\t\t\"first_hour_rate\": str(garage.rate_card.first_hour_rate),\n\t\t\t\"additional_hour_rate\": str(garage.rate_card.additional_hour_rate),\n\t\t\t\"daily_cap\": str(garage.rate_card.daily_cap),\n\t\t},\n\t\t\"reservation_payment_minutes\": 10,\n\t}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations\", status_code=201)\ndef create_reservation(payload: ReservationRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treservation = garage.create_reservation(\n\t\t\tVehicle(payload.plate, payload.vehicle_type),\n\t\t\tpayload.arrival_start.replace(tzinfo=None),\n\t\t\tpayload.arrival_end.replace(tzinfo=None),\n\t\t)\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(reservation), \"next_step\": \"payment\"}\n\texcept (ValueError, NoSpotAvailableError, ReservationConflictError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/pay\")\ndef pay_reservation(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(garage.pay_reservation(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (NoSpotAvailableError, ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reservations/lookup\")\ndef lookup_reservation(plate: str | None = None, code: str | None = None) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tif not plate and not code:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=\"provide a plate or confirmation code\")\n\treservation = garage.find_reservation(code or plate or \"\")\n\tif reservation is None:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"reservation not found\")\n\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(reservation)}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/cancel\")\ndef cancel_reservation(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(garage.cancel_reservation(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/check-in\", status_code=201)\ndef reservation_check_in(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.convert_reservation_to_check_in(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError, ReservationExpiredError, VehicleAlreadyParkedError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reservations\")\ndef reservations() -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\"reservations\": [reservation_data(reservation) for reservation in garage.upcoming_reservations()]}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reports\")\ndef reports() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tnow = datetime.now()\n\ttoday = now.date()\n\tweek_start = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday())\n\tcompleted = garage.history\n\trevenue_today = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() == today), 0)\n\trevenue_week = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() >= week_start), 0)\n\tstay_seconds = [\n\t\t(ticket.exit_time - ticket.entry_time).total_seconds()\n\t\tfor ticket in completed\n\t\tif ticket.exit_time is not None\n\t]\n\toccupancy: dict[str, dict[str, float | int]] = {}\n\tfor spot_type in SpotType:\n\t\ttype_spots = [spot for spot in garage.spots.values() if spot.spot_type is spot_type]\n\t\toccupied = sum(spot.occupied for spot in type_spots)\n\t\toccupancy[spot_type.value] = {\n\t\t\t\"occupied\": occupied,\n\t\t\t\"total\": len(type_spots),\n\t\t\t\"percentage\": round((occupied / len(type_spots)) * 100, 1) if type_spots else 0,\n\t\t}\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"revenue_today\": str(revenue_today),\n\t\t\"revenue_week\": str(revenue_week),\n\t\t\"occupancy\": occupancy,\n\t\t\"average_stay_minutes\": round(sum(stay_seconds) / len(stay_seconds) / 60, 1) if stay_seconds else 0,\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/static/{asset_path:path}\")\ndef static_asset(asset_path: str) -> FileResponse:\n\tpath = BASE_DIR / \"static\" / asset_path\n\tif not path.is_file() or BASE_DIR not in path.resolve().parents:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"asset not found\")\n\treturn FileResponse(path)",

                "text": "# Parking Garage Attendant System\n\nA complete FastAPI web application and CLI for a configurable parking garage\nwith tiered fees, EV-only charging spots, compact/standard overflow, and\nconstant-time-style live lookups.\n\n## Features\n\n- Live check-in, check-out, plate lookup, availability, and transaction history.\n- Indian registration plate validation and canonical formatting.\n- Separate attendant and customer portals with mock-payment reservations.\n- Seven-second polling keeps both portals current without a manual refresh.\n- Responsive dashboard served by FastAPI with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.\n- Atomic in-memory spot assignment protected for concurrent requests.\n- Configurable levels, spot counts, rates, and per-stay daily cap.\n\n## Policies\n\n- Partial hours round up: a stay of 1 hour and 1 minute is charged as 2 hours.\n- The first charged hour uses `first_hour_rate`; every later charged hour uses\n\t`additional_hour_rate`.\n- Fees are displayed in Indian Rupees (`₹`); fee amounts remain numeric\n\tinternally.\n- `daily_cap` is a per-stay maximum. It applies to the elapsed stay from entry\n\tto exit and is not tied to the calendar date.\n- Compact vehicles prefer compact spots and overflow into standard spots when\n\tneeded. Standard vehicles do the reverse. Neither type can use EV spots.\n- EV vehicles may use only EV spots.\n- Plates accept `KA01AB1234` or `MH-12-CD-5678` style input: two state letters,\n  two RTO digits, one or two series letters, and four digits. Input is\n  uppercased and stored canonically as `STATE-RTO-SERIES-NUMBER`, for example\n  `KA-01-AB-1234`.\n\n## Reservations and customer portal\n\nOpen `/customer` for the customer-only portal. It shows live availability, the\n₹ rate card, a near-term arrival-window form, mock payment, and reservation\nlookup/cancellation. The attendant dashboard remains at `/` and shows paid\nupcoming reservations with a check-in conversion action.\n\n- A reservation is limited to the next 24 hours and has a specific arrival\n\twindow.\n- A pending reservation does not remove a spot from availability. It has 10\n\tminutes to complete mock payment.\n- After payment, one compatible spot is held until the arrival window ends.\n- Expired or cancelled reservations release their held spot immediately.\n- A plate may have only one active pending or paid reservation.\n- Confirmation codes are six uppercase letters/digits, such as `PK4X9B`.\n- Late arrivals are treated as normal walk-ins after the reservation expires.\n- No real payment provider is used; mock payment only changes reservation state.\n\nThe portals use short-interval polling every seven seconds because it is a\nsmall, reliable addition to the existing FastAPI app and avoids introducing a\nWebSocket connection manager for this in-memory version.\n\n## Run tests\n\n```bash\npython3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt\npython3 -m pytest -v\n```\n\n## Run the web application\n\n```bash\nuvicorn src.api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000\n```\n\nIn GitHub Codespaces, open the forwarded port `8000` in the Ports panel. The\nroot page is the attendant dashboard.\n\nYou can also run `python3 run.py`.\n\n## API\n\n- `POST /api/check-in` with `{\"plate\":\"KA01AB1234\",\"vehicle_type\":\"ev\"}`\n- `POST /api/check-out` with `{\"plate\":\"KA-01-AB-1234\"}`\n- `GET /api/vehicle/{plate}`\n- `GET /api/spots/availability`\n- `GET /api/spots/availability/{spot_type}`\n- `GET /api/transactions`\n- `GET /api/dashboard`\n- `GET /customer`\n- `GET /api/customer/config`\n- `POST /api/reservations`\n- `POST /api/reservations/{code}/pay`\n- `GET /api/reservations/lookup?plate=...` or `?code=...`\n- `POST /api/reservations/{code}/cancel`\n- `POST /api/reservations/{code}/check-in`\n- `GET /api/reservations`\n\nThe API returns `409` for duplicate check-ins and unavailable compatible spots,\n`404` for missing active vehicles, and `422` for invalid request data.\n\n## Architecture\n\n`models.py`, `rate_card.py`, and `garage.py` contain framework-independent\nbusiness logic. `api.py` adapts those objects to HTTP. The browser dashboard\nuses `fetch()` and updates only affected regions after each action. Active\nvehicles use `dict[plate, Ticket]`; free spots use\n`dict[SpotType, set[spot_id]]`; completed transactions stay in a separate\nappend-only list. These live operations do not scan transaction history.\n\n## Run the CLI\n\n```bash\npython -m src.cli\n```\n\nThe default CLI configuration is only an example. `ParkingGarage` accepts the\nnumber of levels, spots per level by type, and a `RateCard`, so applications can\nprovide any garage configuration.\n\n## Design\n\nCurrently parked vehicles are stored in `active_tickets`, indexed by plate.\nFree spots are indexed by `SpotType` and spot ID. Completed tickets are appended\nto the separate `history` list, so historical log growth does not require scans\nfor check-in, checkout, plate lookup, or availability queries.\n\n## Stretch features\n\n1. Persist completed transactions and restore active state after a restart.\n2. Add reservations and a queue for full spot types.\n3. Add daily reports for revenue, occupancy, and average stay duration.",

                "text": "from datetime import datetime, timedelta\nfrom threading import Lock\n\n\nclass Clock:\n    \"\"\"Thread-safe injectable time source for application behavior and tests.\"\"\"\n\n    def __init__(self, current_time: datetime | None = None) -> None:\n        self._current_time = current_time or datetime.now()\n        self._lock = Lock()\n\n    def now(self) -> datetime:\n        with self._lock:\n            return self._current_time\n\n    def set_time(self, current_time: datetime) -> datetime:\n        with self._lock:\n            self._current_time = current_time\n            return self._current_time\n\n    def advance_hours(self, hours: float) -> datetime:\n        with self._lock:\n            self._current_time += timedelta(hours=hours)\n            return self._current_time\n",

use 2 letters, 2 digits, 1-2 series letters, \"\n\t\t\t\"and 4 digits (for example KA01AB1234)\"\n\t\t)\n\treturn \"-\".join(match.groups())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Vehicle:\n\tplate: str\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\n\tdef __post_init__(self) -> None:\n\t\tobject.__setattr__(self, \"plate\", normalize_plate(self.plate))\n\t\tif isinstance(self.vehicle_type, str):\n\t\t\tobject.__setattr__(self, \"vehicle_type\", SpotType(self.vehicle_type.lower()))\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Spot:\n\tspot_id: str\n\tlevel: int\n\tspot_type: SpotType\n\thas_charger: bool = False\n\toccupied: bool = False\n\tvehicle: Vehicle | None = None\n\tticket_id: str | None = None\n\treservation_code: str | None = None\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Ticket:\n\tplate: str\n\tvehicle: Vehicle\n\tspot_id: str\n\tentry_time: datetime\n\texit_time: datetime | None = None\n\tfee: Decimal | None = None\n\tticket_id: str = \"\"\n\tauto_closed: bool = False\n\n\tdef __post_init__(self) -> None:\n\t\tif not self.ticket_id:\n\t\t\tself.ticket_id = uuid4().hex[:12].upper()\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Reservation:\n\tconfirmation_code: str\n\tplate: str\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\tarrival_start: datetime\n\tarrival_end: datetime\n\tcreated_at: datetime\n\tpayment_deadline: datetime\n\tstatus: ReservationStatus = ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT\n\tspot_id: str | None = None\n\tpaid_at: datetime | None = None\n\n",

test_auto_close_leaves_under_24_hour_session_untouched() -> None:\n\tgarage = make_garage(compact=1)\n\tticket = garage.check_in(Vehicle(\"MH12CD5678\", SpotType.COMPACT), START)\n\tassert             "$mid": 1,
            "fsPath": "\\workspaces\\Parking_Garage\\README.md",
            "_sep": 1,
            "external": "vscode-remote://codespaces%2Bautomatic-fortnight-5vrg6qgwqrg9hvgvp/workspaces/Parking_Garage/README.md",
            "path": "/workspaces/Parking_Garage/README.md",

          "edits": [
            [
              {
                "text": "# Parking Garage Attendant System\n\nA complete FastAPI web application and CLI for a configurable parking garage\nwith tiered fees, EV-only charging spots, compact/standard overflow, and\nconstant-time-style live lookups.\n\n## Features\n\n- Live check-in, check-out, plate lookup, availability, and transaction history.\n- Indian registration plate validation and canonical formatting.\n- Separate attendant and customer portals with mock-payment reservations.\n- Seven-second polling keeps both portals current without a manual refresh.\n- Responsive dashboard served by FastAPI with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.\n- Atomic in-memory spot assignment protected for concurrent requests.\n- Configurable levels, spot counts, rates, and per-stay daily cap.\n\n## Policies\n\n- Partial hours round up: a stay of 1 hour and 1 minute is charged as 2 hours.\n- The first charged hour uses `first_hour_rate`; every later charged hour uses\n\t`additional_hour_rate`.\n- Fees are displayed in Indian Rupees (`₹`); fee amounts remain numeric\n\tinternally.\n- `daily_cap` is a per-stay maximum. It applies to the elapsed stay from entry\n\tto exit and is not tied to the calendar date.\n- Compact vehicles prefer compact spots and overflow into standard spots when\n\tneeded. Standard vehicles do the reverse. Neither type can use EV spots.\n- EV vehicles may use only EV spots.\n- Plates accept `KA01AB1234` or `MH-12-CD-5678` style input: two state letters,\n  two RTO digits, one or two series letters, and four digits. Input is\n  uppercased and stored canonically as `STATE-RTO-SERIES-NUMBER`, for example\n  `KA-01-AB-1234`.\n\n## Reservations and customer portal\n\nOpen `/customer` for the customer-only portal. It shows live availability, the\n₹ rate card, a near-term arrival-window form, mock payment, and reservation\nlookup/cancellation. The attendant dashboard remains at `/` and shows paid\nupcoming reservations with a check-in conversion action.\n\n- A reservation is limited to the next 24 hours and has a specific arrival\n\twindow.\n- A pending reservation does not remove a spot from availability. It has 10\n\tminutes to complete mock payment.\n- After payment, one compatible spot is held until the arrival window ends.\n- Expired or cancelled reservations release their held spot immediately.\n- A plate may have only one active pending or paid reservation.\n- Confirmation codes are six uppercase letters/digits, such as `PK4X9B`.\n- Late arrivals are treated as normal walk-ins after the reservation expires.\n- No real payment provider is used; mock payment only changes reservation state.\n\nThe portals use short-interval polling every seven seconds because it is a\nsmall, reliable addition to the existing FastAPI app and avoids introducing a\nWebSocket connection manager for this in-memory version.\n\n## Nightly auto-close and test clock\n\n`POST /clock` is a test hook that stands in for a real nightly cron job. Send\neither `{\"set_time\":\"2026-09-18T14:00:00\"}` or\n`{\"advance_hours\":25}`. The endpoint updates the shared injectable clock and\nimmediately sweeps active sessions.\n\nAny session parked for more than 24 hours is force-closed. Auto-close billing\nuses rolling 24-hour periods from entry, with one configured daily cap per\nperiod: a 30-hour stay is billed as 2 daily caps. The spot is freed, the ticket\nis added to history with `auto_closed: true`, and a later sweep cannot process\nit again. Normal checkout uses the same clock source and lock.\n\n## Valet transfer\n\n`POST /transfer` accepts `{\"old_plate\":\"KA01AB1234\",\"new_plate\":\"MH12CD5678\"}`.\nIt changes the active ticket's plate while preserving its spot and entry time.\nThe transfer is atomic, never releases the spot, and rejects a missing source\nor an already-active destination plate.\n\n## Rate-card import status\n\nThe requested dirty rate-card payload was not included in the supplied\nspecification; it still contains the literal placeholder\n`<PASTE YOUR MESSY RATE CARD DATA HERE>`. The current configured rates remain\nthe existing sample values until the real payload is provided. No rates were\ninvented during this change, because doing so would silently change billing.\n\n## Run tests\n\n```bash\npython3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt\npython3 -m pytest -v\n```\n\n## Run the web application\n\n```bash\nuvicorn src.api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000\n```\n\nIn GitHub Codespaces, open the forwarded port `8000` in the Ports panel. The\nroot page is the attendant dashboard.\n\nYou can also run `python3 run.py`.\n\n## API\n\n- `POST /api/check-in` with `{\"plate\":\"KA01AB1234\",\"vehicle_type\":\"ev\"}`\n- `POST /api/check-out` with `{\"plate\":\"KA-01-AB-1234\"}`\n- `GET /api/vehicle/{plate}`\n- `GET /api/spots/availability`\n- `GET /api/spots/availability/{spot_type}`\n- `GET /api/transactions`\n- `GET /api/dashboard`\n- `GET /customer`\n- `GET /api/customer/config`\n- `POST /api/reservations`\n- `POST /api/reservations/{code}/pay`\n- `GET /api/reservations/lookup?plate=...` or `?code=...`\n- `POST /api/reservations/{code}/cancel`\n- `POST /api/reservations/{code}/check-in`\n- `GET /api/reservations`\n\nThe API returns `409` for duplicate check-ins and unavailable compatible spots,\n`404` for missing active vehicles, and `422` for invalid request data.\n\n## Architecture\n\n`models.py`, `rate_card.py`, and `garage.py` contain framework-independent\nbusiness logic. `api.py` adapts those objects to HTTP. The browser dashboard\nuses `fetch()` and updates only affected regions after each action. Active\nvehicles use `dict[plate, Ticket]`; free spots use\n`dict[SpotType, set[spot_id]]`; completed transactions stay in a separate\nappend-only list. These live operations do not scan transaction history.\n\n## Run the CLI\n\n```bash\npython -m src.cli\n```\n\nThe default CLI configuration is only an example. `ParkingGarage` accepts the\nnumber of levels, spots per level by type, and a `RateCard`, so applications can\nprovide any garage configuration.\n\n## Design\n\nCurrently parked vehicles are stored in `active_tickets`, indexed by plate.\nFree spots are indexed by `SpotType` and spot ID. Completed tickets are appended\nto the separate `history` list, so historical log growth does not require scans\nfor check-in, checkout, plate lookup, or availability queries.\n\n## Stretch features\n\n1. Persist completed transactions and restore active state after a restart.\n2. Add reservations and a queue for full spot types.\n3. Add daily reports for revenue, occupancy, and average stay duration.",

                  "startColumn": 1,
                  "endLineNumber": 154,
                  "endColumn": 1
                }
              }

            "$mid": 1,
            "fsPath": "\\workspaces\\Parking_Garage\\README.md",
            "_sep": 1,
            "external": "vscode-remote://codespaces%2Bautomatic-fortnight-5vrg6qgwqrg9hvgvp/workspaces/Parking_Garage/README.md",
            "path": "/workspaces/Parking_Garage/README.md",
            "scheme": "vscode-remote",
            "authority": "codespaces+automatic-fortnight-5vrg6qgwqrg9hvgvp"
          },
          "edits": [
            [
              {
                "text": "# Parking Garage Attendant System\n\nA complete FastAPI web application and CLI for a configurable parking garage\nwith tiered fees, EV-only charging spots, compact/standard overflow, and\nconstant-time-style live lookups.\n\n## Features\n\n- Live check-in, check-out, plate lookup, availability, and transaction history.\n- Indian registration plate validation and canonical formatting.\n- Separate attendant and customer portals with mock-payment reservations.\n- Seven-second polling keeps both portals current without a manual refresh.\n- Responsive dashboard served by FastAPI with vanilla HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.\n- Atomic in-memory spot assignment protected for concurrent requests.\n- Configurable levels, spot counts, rates, and per-stay daily cap.\n\n## Policies\n\n- Partial hours round up: a stay of 1 hour and 1 minute is charged as 2 hours.\n- The first charged hour uses `first_hour_rate`; every later charged hour uses\n\t`additional_hour_rate`.\n- Fees are displayed in Indian Rupees (`₹`); fee amounts remain numeric\n\tinternally.\n- `daily_cap` is a per-stay maximum. It applies to the elapsed stay from entry\n\tto exit and is not tied to the calendar date.\n- Compact vehicles prefer compact spots and overflow into standard spots when\n\tneeded. Standard vehicles do the reverse. Neither type can use EV spots.\n- EV vehicles may use only EV spots.\n- Plates accept `KA01AB1234` or `MH-12-CD-5678` style input: two state letters,\n  two RTO digits, one or two series letters, and four digits. Input is\n  uppercased and stored canonically as `STATE-RTO-SERIES-NUMBER`, for example\n  `KA-01-AB-1234`.\n\n## Reservations and customer portal\n\nOpen `/customer` for the customer-only portal. It shows live availability, the\n₹ rate card, a near-term arrival-window form, mock payment, and reservation\nlookup/cancellation. The attendant dashboard remains at `/` and shows paid\nupcoming reservations with a check-in conversion action.\n\n- A reservation is limited to the next 24 hours and has a specific arrival\n\twindow.\n- A pending reservation does not remove a spot from availability. It has 10\n\tminutes to complete mock payment.\n- After payment, one compatible spot is held until the arrival window ends.\n- Expired or cancelled reservations release their held spot immediately.\n- A plate may have only one active pending or paid reservation.\n- Confirmation codes are six uppercase letters/digits, such as `PK4X9B`.\n- Late arrivals are treated as normal walk-ins after the reservation expires.\n- No real payment provider is used; mock payment only changes reservation state.\n\nThe portals use short-interval polling every seven seconds because it is a\nsmall, reliable addition to the existing FastAPI app and avoids introducing a\nWebSocket connection manager for this in-memory version.\n\n## Nightly auto-close and test clock\n\n`POST /clock` is a test hook that stands in for a real nightly cron job. Send\neither `{\"set_time\":\"2026-09-18T14:00:00\"}` or\n`{\"advance_hours\":25}`. The endpoint updates the shared injectable clock and\nimmediately sweeps active sessions.\n\nAny session parked for more than 24 hours is force-closed. Auto-close billing\nuses rolling 24-hour periods from entry, with one configured daily cap per\nperiod: a 30-hour stay is billed as 2 daily caps. The spot is freed, the ticket\nis added to history with `auto_closed: true`, and a later sweep cannot process\nit again. Normal checkout uses the same clock source and lock.\n\n## Valet transfer\n\n`POST /transfer` accepts `{\"old_plate\":\"KA01AB1234\",\"new_plate\":\"MH12CD5678\"}`.\nIt changes the active ticket's plate while preserving its spot and entry time.\nThe transfer is atomic, never releases the spot, and rejects a missing source\nor an already-active destination plate.\n\n## Rate-card import status\n\nThe requested dirty rate-card payload was not included in the supplied\nspecification; it still contains the literal placeholder\n`<PASTE YOUR MESSY RATE CARD DATA HERE>`. The current configured rates remain\nthe existing sample values until the real payload is provided. No rates were\ninvented during this change, because doing so would silently change billing.\n\n## Run tests\n\n```bash\npython3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt\npython3 -m pytest -v\n```\n\n## Run the web application\n\n```bash\nuvicorn src.api:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000\n```\n\nIn GitHub Codespaces, open the forwarded port `8000` in the Ports panel. The\nroot page is the attendant dashboard.\n\nYou can also run `python3 run.py`.\n\n## API\n\n- `POST /api/check-in` with `{\"plate\":\"KA01AB1234\",\"vehicle_type\":\"ev\"}`\n- `POST /api/check-out` with `{\"plate\":\"KA-01-AB-1234\"}`\n- `GET /api/vehicle/{plate}`\n- `GET /api/spots/availability`\n- `GET /api/spots/availability/{spot_type}`\n- `GET /api/transactions`\n- `GET /api/dashboard`\n- `GET /customer`\n- `GET /api/customer/config`\n- `POST /api/reservations`\n- `POST /api/reservations/{code}/pay`\n- `GET /api/reservations/lookup?plate=...` or `?code=...`\n- `POST /api/reservations/{code}/cancel`\n- `POST /api/reservations/{code}/check-in`\n- `GET /api/reservations`\n- `POST /clock`\n- `POST /transfer`\n\nThe API returns `409` for duplicate check-ins and unavailable compatible spots,\n`404` for missing active vehicles, and `422` for invalid request data.\n\n## Architecture\n\n`models.py`, `rate_card.py`, and `garage.py` contain framework-independent\nbusiness logic. `api.py` adapts those objects to HTTP. The browser dashboard\nuses `fetch()` and updates only affected regions after each action. Active\nvehicles use `dict[plate, Ticket]`; free spots use\n`dict[SpotType, set[spot_id]]`; completed transactions stay in a separate\nappend-only list. These live operations do not scan transaction history.\n\n## Run the CLI\n\n```bash\npython -m src.cli\n```\n\nThe default CLI configuration is only an example. `ParkingGarage` accepts the\nnumber of levels, spots per level by type, and a `RateCard`, so applications can\nprovide any garage configuration.\n\n## Design\n\nCurrently parked vehicles are stored in `active_tickets`, indexed by plate.\nFree spots are indexed by `SpotType` and spot ID. Completed tickets are appended\nto the separate `history` list, so historical log growth does not require scans\nfor check-in, checkout, plate lookup, or availability queries.\n\n## Stretch features\n\n1. Persist completed transactions and restore active state after a restart.\n2. Add reservations and a queue for full spot types.\n3. Add daily reports for revenue, occupancy, and average stay duration.",
                "range": {
                  "startLineNumber": 1,
                  "startColumn": 1,
                  "endLineNumber": 156,
                  "endColumn": 1
                }
              }

Ticket(\n\t\t\t\tplate=vehicle.plate,\n\t\t\t\tvehicle=vehicle,\n\t\t\t\tspot_id=selected_id,\n\t\t\t\tentry_time=entry_time or self.clock.now(),\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tspot.occupied = True\n\t\t\tspot.vehicle = vehicle\n\t\t\tspot.ticket_id = ticket.ticket_id\n\t\t\tself.active_tickets[vehicle.plate] = ticket\n\t\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef str(garage.rate_card.daily_cap),\n\t\t},\n\t\t\"reservation_payment_minutes\": 10,\n\t}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations\", status_code=201)\ndef create_reservation(payload: ReservationRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treservation = garage.create_reservation(\n\t\t\tVehicle(payload.plate, payload.vehicle_type),\n\t\t\tpayload.arrival_start.replace(tzinfo=None),\n\t\t\tpayload.arrival_end.replace(tzinfo=None),\n\t\t)\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(reservation), error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/pay\")\ndef pay_reservation(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(garage.pay_reservation(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (NoSpotAvailableError, ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reservations/lookup\")\ndef lookup_reservation(plate: str | None = None, code: str | None = None) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tif not plate and not code:\n\t\traise cancel_reservation(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(garage.cancel_reservation(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/check-in\", status_code=201)\ndef reservation_check_in(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.convert_reservation_to_check_in(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError, VehicleAlreadyParkedError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reservations\")\ndef reservations() -> advance_hours\")\n\ttry:\n\t\tif request.set_time is not None:\n\t\t\tcurrent = garage.clock.set_time(request.set_time.replace(tzinfo=None))\n\t\telse:\n\t\t\tcurrent = garage.clock.advance_hours(request.advance_hours or 0)\n\t\tgarage.upcoming_reservations(current)\n\t\tclosed = garage.auto_close_overdue(current)\n\t\treturn {\"clock_time\": current.isoformat(), \"auto_closed\": [ticket_data(ticket, True) for ticket in closed]}\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/transfer\")\ndef transfer(request: VehicleAlreadyParkedError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reports\")\ndef reports() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tnow = datetime.now()\n\ttoday = ticket.exit_time.date() == today), 0)\n\trevenue_week = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() >= week_start), 0)\n\tstay_seconds = [\n\t\t(ticket.exit_time - ticket.entry_time).total_seconds()\n\t\tfor ticket in completed\n\t\tif ticket.exit_time is not None\n\t]\n\toccupancy: dict[str, dict[str, float | int]] = {}\n\tfor spot_type in SpotType:\n\t\ttype_spots = [spot for spot in garage.spots.values() if spot.spot_type is spot_type]\n\t\toccupied = sum(spot.occupied for spot in type_spots)\n\t\toccupancy[spot_type.value] = {\n\t\t\t\"occupied\": occupied,\n\t\t\t\"total\": len(type_spots),\n\t\t\t\"percentage\": round((occupied / len(type_spots)) * 100, 1) if type_spots else 0,\n\t\t}\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"revenue_today\": str(revenue_today),\n\t\t\"revenue_week\": str(revenue_week),\n\t\t\"occupancy\": occupancy,\n\t\t\"average_stay_minutes\": round(sum(stay_seconds) / len(stay_seconds) / 60, 1) if stay_seconds else 0,\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/static/{asset_path:path}\")\ndef static_asset(asset_path: str) -> FileResponse:\n\tpath = BASE_DIR / \"static\" /             "text": "Add authentication, refresh the UI/UX, clarify the payment flow, and\r\nintegrate a no-show auto-cancel rule with the existing /clock-driven\r\nnightly job (T2). Don't break existing tests — run them before and after,\r\nshow me the results.\r\n\r\n=====================================================================\r\nSECTION 1 — Authentication\r\n=====================================================================\r\n\r\nATTENDANT PORTAL: add real email + password authentication.\r\n- Staff can sign up (name, email, password) and log in/out.\r\n- Password hashed (bcrypt or equivalent), session-based auth (signed\r\n  cookie), protected routes — every attendant-portal page and API route\r\n  redirects to a login page if not authenticated.\r\n- Show the logged-in staff member's name/email in place of the current\r\n  static \"Garage Admin\" placeholder.\r\n\r\nCUSTOMER PORTAL: keep it low-friction — a customer should still be able\r\nto make a reservation and find it later via plate + confirmation code\r\nWITHOUT creating an account (guest flow), since forcing signup for a\r\none-time parking reservation adds unnecessary friction. But also add an\r\nOPTIONAL \"sign in with email\" for returning customers who want to see\r\ntheir past reservations across visits. If you think full customer\r\naccounts are actually the better call here, tell me why before building\r\nit that way instead — otherwise go with the guest-plus-optional-email\r\napproach above.\r\n\r\n=====================================================================\r\nSECTION 2 — UI/UX refresh (current design reads as flat/generic)\r\n=====================================================================\r\n\r\nThe current look is too plain — flat white cards, one accent color, no\r\nvisual personality. Refresh both portals with:\r\n- A more distinctive color pairing (not just one indigo accent on white\r\n  — add a secondary/complementary color used deliberately, e.g. for the\r\n  EV highlight vs a different tone for \"live\" status vs primary actions).\r\n- Subtle motion: a smooth transition when a stat number changes (e.g.\r\n  \"Available now\" ticking down), a brief success animation on completed\r\n  check-in/checkout/payment, hover states with slight lift/shadow on\r\n  cards and buttons.\r\n- Better empty states — replace flat lines like \"No completed activity\r\n  yet.\" with a small icon + slightly warmer copy.\r\n- More visual hierarchy on the customer portal hero section — it\r\n  currently reads as a generic SaaS landing page; make the live\r\n  availability numbers feel more like the actual point of the page\r\n  (bigger, more prominent) rather than sitting far below the fold.\r\n- Keep the sidebar nav structure on the attendant side, but consider\r\n  adding subtle icons/active-state styling that feels more crafted.\r\n- Everything stays responsive; don't sacrifice usability for style.\r\n\r\n=====================================================================\r\nSECTION 3 — Payment method selection (Cash vs UPI)\r\n=====================================================================\r\n\r\nOn the reservation payment step, let the customer choose a payment\r\nmethod before confirming:\r\n- UPI: proceed through the existing mock payment flow (enter a mock UPI\r\n  ID, simulated processing delay, success/failure) — same simulated\r\n  logic as before, just now explicitly labeled as UPI and gated behind\r\n  selecting it.\r\n- Cash: no mock gateway step — instead, mark the reservation as\r\n  `payment_method: cash`, `payment_status: pending`, and hold the spot\r\n  immediately upon confirming (since payment will happen physically at\r\n  the gate on arrival). The attendant portal's check-in flow should show\r\n  \"Cash due: ₹X\" for these reservations and let the attendant mark it\r\n  collected as part of checking the car in.\r\n- Both paths end in the same confirmation screen (Section 4).\r\n- Update the reservation-hold rule: UPI reservations hold the spot only\r\n  after mock payment succeeds (as before); cash reservations hold the\r\n  spot immediately on confirmation. State this clearly in README.md.\r\n\r\n=====================================================================\r\nSECTION 4 — Clear post-booking confirmation\r\n=====================================================================\r\n\r\nRight after a reservation is confirmed (either payment path), show a\r\nfull confirmation view immediately — not just via a later \"find my\r\nreservation\" lookup — with: confirmation code, plate, spot type,\r\narrival window, payment method, payment status/amount, and a clear\r\n\"Cancel reservation\" action available right there. This same detail view\r\nshould also be what \"find my reservation\" returns later.\r\n\r\n=====================================================================\r\nSECTION 5 — No-show auto-cancel, integrated with the T2 clock sweep\r\n=====================================================================\r\n\r\nExtend the existing POST /clock sweep (the one that auto-closes sessions\r\nover 24h) to ALSO check reservations: any reservation (paid or\r\ncash-pending) whose arrival window has ended more than 30 minutes ago,\r\nwith no check-in, gets auto-cancelled and its held spot released back to\r\nthe free pool. This should run as part of the same sweep function/same\r\n/clock call as the 24h auto-close check — one clock advance triggers\r\nboth checks, not two separate mechanisms.\r\n\r\nAdd tests: a reservation whose window ended 20 minutes ago is still\r\nheld; one whose window ended 35 minutes ago gets auto-cancelled and its\r\nspot freed via a single POST /clock call; a reservation that got checked\r\nin before the 30-minute grace period elapsed is never touched by the\r\nsweep.\r\n\r\nUpdate README.md with this grace-period rule stated explicitly next to\r\nthe existing 24h auto-close rule, since they're now the same mechanism.\r\n\r\n=====================================================================\r\nFINAL STEP\r\n=====================================================================\r\n\r\nRun the full test suite (everything from Phase 1-3 through T4/T2/T6 plus\r\nall of the above) and show me the complete pass/fail summary.",

              {
                "text": "from dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom datetime import datetime\nfrom enum import Enum\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nimport re\nfrom uuid import uuid4\n\n\nclass SpotType(str, Enum):\n\tCOMPACT = \"compact\"\n\tSTANDARD = \"standard\"\n\tEV = \"ev\"\n\n\nclass ReservationStatus(str, Enum):\n\tPENDING_PAYMENT = \"pending_payment\"\n\tPAID = \"paid\"\n\tCANCELLED = \"cancelled\"\n\tEXPIRED = \"expired\"\n\tCHECKED_IN = \"checked_in\"\n\n\nclass PaymentMethod(str, Enum):\n\tUPI = \"upi\"\n\tCASH = \"cash\"\n\n\nclass PaymentStatus(str, Enum):\n\tPENDING = \"pending\"\n\tPAID = \"paid\"\n\tCOLLECTED = \"collected\"\n\n\nPLATE_PATTERN = re.compile(r\"^([A-Z]{2})-?(\\d{2})-?([A-Z]{1,2})-?(\\d{4})$\")\n\n\ndef normalize_plate(plate: str) -> str:\n\t\"\"\"Validate and canonicalize an Indian registration plate.\"\"\"\n\tcompact = re.sub(r\"[\\s-]+\", \"\", plate).upper()\n\tmatch = PLATE_PATTERN.fullmatch(compact)\n\tif match is None:\n\t\traise ValueError(\n\t\t\t\"invalid Indian plate; use 2 letters, 2 digits, 1-2 series letters, \"\n\t\t\t\"and 4 digits (for example KA01AB1234)\"\n\t\t)\n\treturn \"-\".join(match.groups())\n\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass Vehicle:\n\tplate: str\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\n\tdef __post_init__(self) -> None:\n\t\tobject.__setattr__(self, \"plate\", normalize_plate(self.plate))\n\t\tif isinstance(self.vehicle_type, str):\n\t\t\tobject.__setattr__(self, \"vehicle_type\", SpotType(self.vehicle_type.lower()))\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Spot:\n\tspot_id: str\n\tlevel: int\n\tspot_type: SpotType\n\thas_charger: bool = False\n\toccupied: bool = False\n\tvehicle: Vehicle | None = None\n\tticket_id: str | None = None\n\treservation_code: str | None = None\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Ticket:\n\tplate: str\n\tvehicle: Vehicle\n\tspot_id: str\n\tentry_time: datetime\n\texit_time: datetime | None = None\n\tfee: Decimal | None = None\n\tticket_id: str = \"\"\n\tauto_closed: bool = False\n\n\tdef __post_init__(self) -> None:\n\t\tif not self.ticket_id:\n\t\t\tself.ticket_id = uuid4().hex[:12].upper()\n\n\n@dataclass\nclass Reservation:\n\tconfirmation_code: str\n\tplate: str\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\tarrival_start: datetime\n\tarrival_end: datetime\n\tcreated_at: datetime\n\tpayment_deadline: datetime\n\tstatus: ReservationStatus = ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT\n\tspot_id: str | None = None\n\tpaid_at: datetime | None = None\n\tpayment_method: PaymentMethod = PaymentMethod.UPI\n\tpayment_status: PaymentStatus = PaymentStatus.PENDING\n\tpayment_amount: Decimal | None = None\n\tupi_id: str | None = None\n\n",

RateCard\n\n\nclass GarageError(Exception):\n\t\"\"\"Base exception for expected garage operation failures.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass VehicleAlreadyParkedError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass ReservationConflictError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass ParkingGarage:\n\tdef __init__(\n\t\tself,\n\t\tlevels: int,\n\t\tspots_per_level: Mapping[SpotType | str, int],\n\t\trate_card: RateCard,\n\t\tclock: Clock | None = None,\n\t) -> None:\n\t\tif levels < 1:\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"levels must be at least 1\")\n\t\tnormalized_counts = {\n\t\t\tSpotType(spot_type.lower() if spot\n\t\t\t\t\tself.free_spots[spot_type].add(spot_id)\n\n\t\tself.active_tickets: dict[str, Ticket] = {}\n\t\tself.history: list[Ticket] = []\n\t\tself.reservations: dict[str, Reservation] = \"\")\n\t\t\t\texcept ValueError:\n\t\t\t\t\treturn None\n\t\t\treturn self.reservations.get(code)\n\n\tdef convert_reservation_to_check_in(\n\t\tself, confirmation_code: str, entry_time: datetime | None = None\n\t) -> Ticket:\n\t\tcurrent = entry_time or self.clock.now()\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(current)\n\t\t\treservation =                                   "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 8,
                                  "text": "<body><main class=\"customer-shell\"><header class=\"customer-header\"><a class=\"brand\" href=\"/\"><b>Parkflow</b><span>Customer parking</span></a><span class=\"live\"><i></i> Live availability</span></header>\n",

                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 7,
                                  "text": "<section class=\"hero\"><p class=\"eyebrow\">RESERVE WITH CONFIDENCE</p><h1>Your space,<br><em>held fairly.</em></h1><p>See live availability, choose an arrival window, and confirm your place with a secure mock payment.</p></section>\n",

                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 6,
                                  "text": "<section class=\"availability-section\"><div class=\"section-heading\"><div><p class=\"eyebrow\">RIGHT NOW</p><h2>Live availability</h2></div><span id=\"last-updated\">Updating...</span></div><div id=\"customer-availability\" class=\"availability-grid\"></div></section>\n",

                            },

                                {
                                  "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 5,
                                  "text": "<section class=\"customer-grid\"><div class=\"card reservation-card\"><div class=\"section-heading\"><div><p class=\"eyebrow\">STEP 01</p><h2>Choose your arrival</h2></div></div><form id=\"reservation-form\"><label>Indian license plate<input id=\"reservation-plate\" required placeholder=\"KA01AB1234\" maxlength=\"20\"><small>Example: KA01AB1234 or MH-12-CD-5678</small></label><label>Spot type<select id=\"reservation-type\"><option value=\"compact\">Compact</option><option value=\"standard\">Standard</option><option value=\"ev\">EV with charger</option></select></label><div class=\"time-grid\"><label>Arriving from<input id=\"arrival-start\" type=\"datetime-local\" required></label><label>Until<input id=\"arrival-end\" type=\"datetime-local\" required></label></div><p id=\"reservation-error\" class=\"error\"></p><button class=\"primary-button\" type=\"submit\">Continue to payment <span>→</span></button></form></div><div class=\"card rate-card\"><div class=\"section-heading\"><div><p class=\"eyebrow\">FAIR PRICING</p><h2>Rate card</h2></div><span class=\"rupee\">₹</span></div><div class=\"rates\"><div><span>First hour</span><strong id=\"first-rate\">₹—</strong></div><div><span>Each extra hour</span><strong id=\"extra-rate\">₹—</strong></div><div><span>Daily cap</span><strong id=\"cap-rate\">₹—</strong></div></div><p>Partial hours are always rounded up. The daily cap applies to one continuous stay.</p></div></section>\n",

                                  "text": "function showPayment(reservation) { selectedReservation = reservation; $('#payment-card').hidden = false; $('#payment-summary').innerHTML = `<div class=\"summary-line\"><span>Confirmation</span><strong>${reservation.confirmation_code}</strong></div><div class=\"summary-line\"><span>Vehicle</span><strong>${reservation.plate} · ${reservation.vehicle_type.toUpperCase()}</strong></div><div class=\"summary-line\"><span>Arrival window</span><strong>${formatTime(reservation.arrival_start)} – ${formatTime(reservation.arrival_end)}</strong></div>`; const deadline = new Date(reservation.payment_deadline).getTime(); clearInterval(paymentTimer); paymentTimer = setInterval(() => { const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((deadline - Date.now()) / 1000)); $('#payment-timer').textContent = `${String(Math.floor(seconds / 60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(seconds % 60).padStart(2,'0')}`; if (!seconds) { clearInterval(paymentTimer); toast('Payment window expired.                                   "type": 2,
                                  "priority": 5,
                                  "text": "$('#reservation-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const plate = $('#reservation-plate'); const error = $('#reservation-error'); error.textContent = ''; if (!plate.value.trim()) { error.textContent = 'Enter your license plate.'; plate.focus(); return; } const start = new Date($('#arrival-start').value); const end = new Date($('#arrival-end').value); if (Number.isNaN(start.getTime()) || Number.isNaN(end.getTime()) || end <= start) { error.textContent = 'Choose a valid arrival window.'; return; } const button = event.target.querySelector('button'); button.disabled = true; button.textContent = 'Creating reservation…'; try { const data = await api('/api/reservations', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({plate: plate.value, vehicle_type: $('#reservation-type').value, arrival_start: start.toISOString(), arrival_end: end.toISOString()})}); showPayment(data.reservation); toast('Reservation created. Complete payment within 10 minutes.'); await refreshAvailability(); } catch (requestError) { error.textContent = requestError.message; } finally { button.disabled = false; button.innerHTML = 'Continue to payment <span>→</span>'; } });\n",

Your spot is held until the arrival window ends.</p>'); button.textContent = 'Payment confirmed'; await refreshAvailability(); } catch (error) { toast(error.message, true); button.disabled = false; button.innerHTML = 'Confirm mock payment <span>→</span>'; } });\n",

                "text": "from dataclasses import dataclass\nfrom hashlib import pbkdf2_hmac\nfrom hmac import compare_digest\nimport hashlib\nimport hmac\nimport secrets\nfrom threading import Lock\n\n@dataclass(frozen=True)\nclass StaffUser:\n    user_id: str\n    name: str\n    email: str\n    password_hash: str\n\nclass AuthStore:\n    def __init__(self, secret: str = \"parking-garage-dev-secret\") -> None:\n        self.secret = secret.encode(); self.users: dict[str, StaffUser] = {}; self.sessions: dict[str, str] = {}; self._lock = Lock()\n    def create_user(self, name: str, email: str, password: str) -> StaffUser:\n        if len(password) < 8: raise ValueError(\"password must be at least 8 characters\")\n        email = email.strip().lower()\n        with self._lock:\n            if any(user.email == email for user in self.users.values()): raise ValueError(\"email is already registered\")\n            user = StaffUser(secrets.token_urlsafe(9), name.strip(), email, self._hash(password)); self.users[user.user_id] = user; return user\n    def authenticate(self, email: str, password: str) -> StaffUser | None:\n        email = email.strip().lower(); user = next((u for u in self.users.values() if u.email == email), None)\n        return user if user and compare_digest(user.password_hash, self._hash(password, user.password_hash.split('$',1)[0])) else None\n    def sign_in(self, user: StaffUser) -> str:\n        payload = secrets.token_urlsafe(24); signature = hmac.new(self.secret, payload.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest(); self.sessions[payload] = user.user_id; return f\"{payload}.{signature}\"\n    def user_from_cookie(self, cookie: str | None) -> StaffUser | None:\n        if not cookie or '.' not in cookie: return None\n        payload, signature = cookie.rsplit('.', 1); expected = hmac.new(self.secret, payload.encode(), hashlib.sha256).hexdigest()\n        if not compare_digest(signature, expected): return None\n        user_id = self.sessions.get(payload); return self.users.get(user_id) if user_id else None\n    def sign_out(self, cookie: str | None) -> None:\n        if cookie and '.' in cookie: self.sessions.pop(cookie.rsplit('.', 1)[0], None)\n    @staticmethod\n    def _hash(password: str, salt: str | None = None) -> str:\n        salt = salt or secrets.token_hex(16); return f\"{salt}${pbkdf2_hmac('sha256', password.encode(), salt.encode(), 120000).hex()}\"\n",

                "text": "from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Query, Request, Response\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, Field\n\nfrom .garage import (\n\tCarNotFoundError,\n\tNoSpotAvailableError,\n\tParkingGarage,\n\tReservationConflictError,\n\tReservationNotFoundError,\n\tVehicleAlreadyParkedError,\n)\nfrom .auth import AuthStore\nfrom .models import PaymentMethod, Reservation, ReservationStatus, SpotType, Ticket, Vehicle, normalize_plate\nfrom .rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nBASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n\n\ndef build_garage() -> ParkingGarage:\n\treturn ParkingGarage(\n\t\tlevels=3,\n\t\tspots_per_level={SpotType.COMPACT: 10, SpotType.STANDARD: 15, SpotType.EV: 5},\n\t\trate_card=RateCard(50, 30, 200),\n\t)\n\n\ngarage = build_garage()\napp = FastAPI(title=\"Parking Garage Attendant System\", version=\"1.0.0\")\nauth = AuthStore()\n\n\nclass CheckInRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\tentry_time: datetime | None = None\n\n\nclass CheckOutRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\texit_time: datetime | None = None\n\n\nclass ReservationRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\tarrival_start: datetime\n\tarrival_end: datetime\n\n\nclass ClockRequest(BaseModel):\n\tset_time: datetime | None = None\n\tadvance_hours: float | None = None\n\n\nclass TransferRequest(BaseModel):\n\told_plate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\tnew_plate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\n\ndef ticket_data(ticket: Ticket, include_exit: bool = False) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tspot = garage.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\tdata: dict[str, object] = {\n\t\t\"ticket_id\": ticket.ticket_id,\n\t\t\"plate\": ticket.plate,\n\t\t\"vehicle_type\": ticket.vehicle.vehicle_type.value,\n\t\t\"spot_id\": ticket.spot_id,\n\t\t\"level\": spot.level,\n\t\t\"entry_time\": ticket.entry_time.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"status\": \"completed\" if ticket.exit_time else \"parked\",\n\t\t\"auto_closed\": ticket.auto_closed,\n\t}\n\tif include_exit:\n\t\tdata[\"exit_time\"] = ticket.exit_time.isoformat() if ticket.exit_time else None\n\t\tdata[\"fee\"] = str(ticket.fee) if ticket.fee is not None else None\n\treturn data\n\n\ndef reservation_data(reservation: Reservation) -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"confirmation_code\": reservation.confirmation_code,\n\t\t\"plate\": reservation.plate,\n\t\t\"vehicle_type\": reservation.vehicle_type.value,\n\t\t\"arrival_start\": reservation.arrival_start.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"arrival_end\": reservation.arrival_end.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"created_at\": reservation.created_at.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"payment_deadline\": reservation.payment_deadline.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"status\": reservation.status.value,\n\t\t\"spot_id\": reservation.spot_id,\n\t}\n\n\ndef error_response(error: Exception) -> HTTPException:\n\tif isinstance(error, VehicleAlreadyParkedError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, NoSpotAvailableError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, CarNotFoundError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, ReservationNotFoundError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, ReservationConflictError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\treturn HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(error))\n\n\n@app.get(\"/\", response_class=FileResponse)\ndef index() -> FileResponse:\n\treturn FileResponse(BASE_DIR / \"templates\" / \"index.html\")\n\n\n@app.get(\"/customer\", response_class=FileResponse)\ndef customer_portal() -> FileResponse:\n\treturn FileResponse(BASE_DIR / \"templates\" / \"customer.html\")\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check-in\", status_code=201)\ndef check_in(payload: CheckInRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tvehicle = Vehicle(payload.plate, payload.vehicle_type)\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.check_in(vehicle, payload.entry_time))}\n\texcept (ValueError, VehicleAlreadyParkedError, NoSpotAvailableError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check-out\")\ndef check_out(payload: CheckOutRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.check_out(normalize_plate(payload.plate), payload.exit_time), True)}\n\texcept (ValueError, CarNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/vehicle/{plate}\")\ndef vehicle_lookup(plate: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tnormalized_plate = normalize_plate(plate)\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(error)) from error\n\tticket = garage.find_car(normalized_plate)\n\tif ticket is None:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"vehicle is not currently parked\")\n\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(ticket)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability\")\ndef availability() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tgarage.upcoming_reservations()\n\tcounts = {spot_type.value: garage.available_spot_count(spot_type) for spot_type in SpotType}\n\treserved = sum(reservation.status is ReservationStatus.PAID for reservation in garage.reservations.values())\n\treturn {\"available\": counts, \"total\": len(garage.spots), \"occupied\": len(garage.active_tickets), \"reserved\": reserved}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability/{spot_type}\")\ndef type_availability(spot_type: SpotType) -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\"spot_type\": spot_type.value, \"available\": garage.available_spot_count(spot_type), \"is_free\": garage.is_spot_free(spot_type)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/transactions\")\ndef transactions(\n\tplate: str = \"\",\n\tfrom_date: date | None = None,\n\tto_date: date | None = None,\n\tpage: int = Query(1, ge=1),\n\tpage_size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100),\n) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tnormalized_filter = normalize_plate(plate) if plate else \"\"\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(error)) from error\n\tfiltered = [ticket for ticket in reversed(garage.history) if (\n\t\t(not normalized_filter or normalized_filter in ticket.plate)\n\t\tand (from_date is None or ticket.entry_time.date() >= from_date)\n\t\tand (to_date is None or ticket.entry_time.date() <= to_date)\n\t)]\n\tstart = (page - 1) * page_size\n\tpage_items = filtered[start:start + page_size]\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"transactions\": [ticket_data(ticket, True) for ticket in page_items],\n\t\t\"page\": page,\n\t\t\"page_size\": page_size,\n\t\t\"total\": len(filtered),\n\t\t\"pages\": max(1, (len(filtered) + page_size - 1) // page_size),\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tavailability_data = availability()\n\treturn {\n\t\t**availability_data,\n\t\t\"active_vehicles\": len(garage.active_tickets),\n\t\t\"completed_transactions\": len(garage.history),\n\t\t\"ev_available\": garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.EV),\n\t\t\"upcoming_reservations\": [reservation_data(reservation) for reservation in garage.upcoming_reservations()],\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/customer/config\")\ndef customer_config() -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"rates\": {\n\t\t\t\"first_hour_rate\": str(garage.rate_card.first_hour_rate),\n\t\t\t\"additional_hour_rate\": str(garage.rate_card.additional_hour_rate),\n\t\t\t\"daily_cap\": str(garage.rate_card.daily_cap),\n\t\t},\n\t\t\"reservation_payment_minutes\": 10,\n\t}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations\", status_code=201)\ndef create_reservation(payload: ReservationRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treservation = garage.create_reservation(\n\t\t\tVehicle(payload.plate, payload.vehicle_type),\n\t\t\tpayload.arrival_start.replace(tzinfo=None),\n\t\t\tpayload.arrival_end.replace(tzinfo=None),\n\t\t)\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(reservation), \"next_step\": \"payment\"}\n\texcept (ValueError, NoSpotAvailableError, ReservationConflictError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/pay\")\ndef pay_reservation(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(garage.pay_reservation(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (NoSpotAvailableError, ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reservations/lookup\")\ndef lookup_reservation(plate: str | None = None, code: str | None = None) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tif not plate and not code:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=\"provide a plate or confirmation code\")\n\treservation = garage.find_reservation(code or plate or \"\")\n\tif reservation is None:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"reservation not found\")\n\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(reservation)}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/cancel\")\ndef cancel_reservation(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(garage.cancel_reservation(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/check-in\", status_code=201)\ndef reservation_check_in(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.convert_reservation_to_check_in(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError, VehicleAlreadyParkedError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reservations\")\ndef reservations() -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\"reservations\": [reservation_data(reservation) for reservation in garage.upcoming_reservations()]}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/clock\")\ndef clock(request: ClockRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tif (request.set_time is None) == (request.advance_hours is None):\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=\"provide exactly one of set_time or advance_hours\")\n\ttry:\n\t\tif request.set_time is not None:\n\t\t\tcurrent = garage.clock.set_time(request.set_time.replace(tzinfo=None))\n\t\telse:\n\t\t\tcurrent = garage.clock.advance_hours(request.advance_hours or 0)\n\t\tgarage.upcoming_reservations(current)\n\t\tclosed = garage.auto_close_overdue(current)\n\t\treturn {\"clock_time\": current.isoformat(), \"auto_closed\": [ticket_data(ticket, True) for ticket in closed]}\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/transfer\")\ndef transfer(request: TransferRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.transfer(request.old_plate, request.new_plate))}\n\texcept (ValueError, CarNotFoundError, VehicleAlreadyParkedError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reports\")\ndef reports() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tnow = datetime.now()\n\ttoday = now.date()\n\tweek_start = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday())\n\tcompleted = garage.history\n\trevenue_today = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() == today), 0)\n\trevenue_week = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() >= week_start), 0)\n\tstay_seconds = [\n\t\t(ticket.exit_time - ticket.entry_time).total_seconds()\n\t\tfor ticket in completed\n\t\tif ticket.exit_time is not None\n\t]\n\toccupancy: dict[str, dict[str, float | int]] = {}\n\tfor spot_type in SpotType:\n\t\ttype_spots = [spot for spot in garage.spots.values() if spot.spot_type is spot_type]\n\t\toccupied = sum(spot.occupied for spot in type_spots)\n\t\toccupancy[spot_type.value] = {\n\t\t\t\"occupied\": occupied,\n\t\t\t\"total\": len(type_spots),\n\t\t\t\"percentage\": round((occupied / len(type_spots)) * 100, 1) if type_spots else 0,\n\t\t}\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"revenue_today\": str(revenue_today),\n\t\t\"revenue_week\": str(revenue_week),\n\t\t\"occupancy\": occupancy,\n\t\t\"average_stay_minutes\": round(sum(stay_seconds) / len(stay_seconds) / 60, 1) if stay_seconds else 0,\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/static/{asset_path:path}\")\ndef static_asset(asset_path: str) -> FileResponse:\n\tpath = BASE_DIR / \"static\" / asset_path\n\tif not path.is_file() or BASE_DIR not in path.resolve().parents:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"asset not found\")\n\treturn FileResponse(path)",

(\n\tCarNotFoundError,\n\tNoSpotAvailableError,\n\tParkingGarage,\n\tReservationConflictError,\n\tReservationNotFoundError,\n\tVehicleAlreadyParkedError,\n)\nfrom .auth import AuthStore\nfrom .models import PaymentMethod, Reservation, ReservationStatus, SpotType, Ticket, Vehicle, normalize_plate\nfrom .rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nBASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n\n\ndef build_garage() -> ParkingGarage:\n\treturn ParkingGarage(\n\t\tlevels=3,\n\t\tspots_per_level={SpotType.COMPACT: 10, SpotType.STANDARD: 15, SpotType.EV: 5},\n\t\trate_card=RateCard(50, 30, 200),\n\t)\n\n\ngarage = build_garage()\napp = FastAPI(title=\"Parking Garage Attendant System\", version=\"1.0.0\")\nauth = AuthStore()\n\n\nclass CheckInRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = ticket_data(ticket: Ticket, include_exit: bool = False) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tspot = garage.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\tdata: dict[str, object] = {\n\t\t\"ticket_id\": ticket.exit_time.isoformat() if ticket.exit_time else None\n\t\tdata[\"fee\"] = str(ticket.fee) if ticket.fee is not None else None\n\treturn data\n\n\ndef reservation_data(reservation: Reservation)                 "text": "<!doctype html><html lang=\"en\"><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\"><meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1\"><title>Parkflow Staff Login</title><link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"/static/customer.css\"></head><body><main class=\"customer-shell\"><header class=\"customer-header\"><a class=\"brand\" href=\"/customer\"><b>Parkflow</b><span>Staff access</span></a></header><section class=\"card\" style=\"max-width:460px;margin:12vh auto\"><p class=\"eyebrow\">ATTENDANT PORTAL</p><h1>Welcome back</h1><p>Sign in to manage the garage.</p><form id=\"login-form\"><label>Email<input name=\"email\" type=\"email\" required></label><label>Password<input name=\"password\" type=\"password\" required minlength=\"8\"></label><p id=\"error\" class=\"error\"></p><button class=\"primary-button\">Sign in</button></form><p class=\"fine-print\">First time here? <a href=\"#\" id=\"signup-link\">Create staff account</a></p></section></main><script>const form=document.querySelector('#login-form');form.addEventListener('submit',async e=>{e.preventDefault();const body=Object.fromEntries(new FormData(form));const r=await fetch('/api/auth/login',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify(body)});if(r.ok)location='/';else document.querySelector('#error').textContent=(await r.json()).detail});document.querySelector('#signup-link').onclick=async e=>{e.preventDefault();const name=prompt('Your name');const email=prompt('Work email');const password=prompt('Password (8+ characters)');if(!name||!email||!password)return;const r=await fetch('/api/auth/signup',{method:'POST',headers:{'content-type':'application/json'},body:JSON.stringify({name,email,password})});if(r.ok)location='/';else document.querySelector('#error').textContent=(await r.json()).detail};</script></body></html>\n",
