Lock\n\nfrom .clock import Clock\nfrom .models import PaymentMethod, PaymentStatus, Reservation, ReservationStatus, Spot, SpotType, Ticket, Vehicle, normalize_plate\nfrom .rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nclass GarageError(Exception):\n\t\"\"\"Base exception for expected garage operation failures.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass VehicleAlreadyParkedError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass NoSpotAvailableError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass CarNotFoundError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass ReservationNotFoundError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass ReservationConflictError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass ParkingGarage:\n\tdef __init__(\n\t\tself,\n\t\tlevels: int,\n\t\tspots_per_level: Mapping[SpotType | str, int],\n\t\trate_card: RateCard,\n\t\tclock: Clock | None = None,\n\t) -> None:\n\t\tif levels < 1:\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"levels must be at least 1\")\n\t\tnormalized_counts = {\n\t\t\tSpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type): count\n\t\t\tfor spot_type, count in spots_per_level.items()\n\t\t}\n\t\tif any(count < 0 for count in normalized_counts.values()):\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"spot counts must not be negative\")\n\n\t\tself.rate_card = rate_card\n\t\tself.clock = clock or Clock()\n\t\tself.spots: dict[str, Spot] = {}\n\t\tself.free_spots: dict[SpotType, set[str]] = {\n\t\t\tspot_type: set() for spot_type in SpotType\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor level in range(1, levels + 1):\n\t\t\tfor spot_type in SpotType:\n\t\t\t\tfor number in range(1, normalized_counts.get(spot_type, 0) + 1):\n\t\t\t\t\tspot_id = f\"L{level}-{spot_type.value.upper()}-{number}\"\n\t\t\t\t\tspot = Spot(\n\t\t\t\t\t\tspot_id=spot_id,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tlevel=level,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tspot_type=spot_type,\n\t\t\t\t\t\thas_charger=spot_type is SpotType.EV,\n\t\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\t\tself.spots[spot_id] = spot\n\t\t\t\t\tself.free_spots[spot_type].add(spot_id)\n\n\t\tself.active_tickets: dict[str, Ticket] = {}\n\t\tself.history: list[Ticket] = []\n\t\tself.reservations: dict[str, Reservation] = {}\n\t\tself.reservation_by_plate: dict[str, str] = {}\n\t\tself._lock = Lock()\n\n\tdef check_in(self, vehicle: Vehicle, entry_time: datetime | None = None) -> Ticket:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(entry_time or self.clock.now())\n\t\t\tif vehicle.plate in self.active_tickets:\n\t\t\t\traise VehicleAlreadyParkedError(f\"{vehicle.plate} is already parked\")\n\n\t\t\tcandidate_types = self._spot_type_for(vehicle.vehicle_type)\n\t\t\tselected_type = next(\n\t\t\t\t(candidate for candidate in candidate_types if self.free_spots[candidate]), None\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tif selected_type is None:\n\t\t\t\traise NoSpotAvailableError(\n\t\t\t\t\tf\"no spot available for {vehicle.vehicle_type.value} vehicle\"\n\t\t\t\t)\n\n\t\t\tselected_id = self.free_spots[selected_type].pop()\n\t\t\tspot = self.spots[selected_id]\n\t\t\tticket = Ticket(\n\t\t\t\tplate=vehicle.plate,\n\t\t\t\tvehicle=vehicle,\n\t\t\t\tspot_id=selected_id,\n\t\t\t\tentry_time=entry_time or self.clock.now(),\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tspot.occupied = True\n\t\t\tspot.vehicle = vehicle\n\t\t\tspot.ticket_id = ticket.ticket_id\n\t\t\tself.active_tickets[vehicle.plate] = ticket\n\t\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef create_reservation(\n\t\tself,\n\t\tvehicle: Vehicle,\n\t\tarrival_start: datetime,\n\t\tarrival_end: datetime,\n\t\tnow: datetime | None = None,\n\t\tpayment_method: PaymentMethod = PaymentMethod.UPI,\n\t) -> Reservation:\n\t\tcurrent = now or self.clock.now()\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(current)\n\t\t\tif vehicle.plate in self.active_tickets:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(f\"{vehicle.plate} is already parked\")\n\t\t\tif vehicle.plate in self.reservation_by_plate:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(f\"{vehicle.plate} already has an active reservation\")\n\t\t\tif arrival_end <= arrival_start or arrival_start < current:\n\t\t\t\traise ValueError(\"arrival window must be in the future and end after it starts\")\n\t\t\tif arrival_start > current + timedelta(hours=24) or arrival_end > current + timedelta(hours=24):\n\t\t\t\traise ValueError(\"reservations are limited to the next 24 hours\")\n\t\t\tif not any(self.free_spots[candidate] for candidate in self._spot_type_for(vehicle.vehicle_type)):\n\t\t\t\traise NoSpotAvailableError(f\"no spot available for {vehicle.vehicle_type.value} reservation\")\n\t\t\tcode = self._new_confirmation_code()\n\t\t\treservation = Reservation(\n\t\t\t\tconfirmation_code=code,\n\t\t\t\tplate=vehicle.plate,\n\t\t\t\tvehicle_type=vehicle.vehicle_type,\n\t\t\t\tarrival_start=arrival_start,\n\t\t\t\tarrival_end=arrival_end,\n\t\t\t\tcreated_at=current,\n\t\t\t\tpayment_deadline=current + timedelta(minutes=10),\n\t\t\t\tpayment_method=payment_method,\n\t\t\t\tpayment_amount=self.rate_card.first_hour_rate,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tself.reservations[code] = reservation\n\t\t\tself.reservation_by_plate[vehicle.plate] = code\n\t\t\tif payment_method is PaymentMethod.CASH:\n\t\t\t\tself._hold_reservation_spot(reservation, current)\n\t\t\treturn reservation\n\n\tdef pay_reservation(self, confirmation_code: str, now: datetime | None = None) -> Reservation:\n\t\tcurrent = now or self.clock.now()\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(current)\n\t\t\treservation = self._reservation_or_error(confirmation_code)\n\t\t\tif reservation.payment_method is not PaymentMethod.UPI:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(\"cash reservations are collected at the gate\")\n\t\t\tif reservation.status is not ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(f\"reservation is {reservation.status.value}\")\n\t\t\tself._hold_reservation_spot(reservation, current)\n\t\t\treservation.status = ReservationStatus.PAID\n\t\t\treservation.payment_status = PaymentStatus.PAID\n\t\t\treturn reservation\n\n\tdef _hold_reservation_spot(self, reservation: Reservation, current: datetime) -> None:\n\t\tselected_type = next((candidate for candidate in self._spot_type_for(reservation.vehicle_type) if self.free_spots[candidate]), None)\n\t\tif selected_type is None:\n\t\t\traise NoSpotAvailableError(\"no compatible spot remains for reservation\")\n\t\tspot_id = self.free_spots[selected_type].pop()\n\t\tspot = self.spots[spot_id]\n\t\tspot.reservation_code = reservation.confirmation_code\n\t\treservation.spot_id = spot_id\n\t\treservation.paid_at = current\n\t\tif reservation.payment_method is PaymentMethod.CASH:\n\t\t\treservation.status = ReservationStatus.PAID\n\n\tdef mark_cash_collected(self, confirmation_code: str) -> Reservation:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\treservation = self._reservation_or_error(confirmation_code)\n\t\t\tif reservation.payment_method is not PaymentMethod.CASH:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(\"only cash reservations need collection\")\n\t\t\treservation.payment_status = PaymentStatus.COLLECTED\n\t\t\treturn reservation\n\n\tdef cancel_reservation(self, confirmation_code: str, now: datetime | None = None) -> Reservation:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(now or self.clock.now())\n\t\t\treservation = self._reservation_or_error(confirmation_code)\n\t\t\tif reservation.status not in {ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT, ReservationStatus.PAID}:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(f\"reservation is {reservation.status.value}\")\n\t\t\tself._release_reserved_spot(reservation)\n\t\t\treservation.status = ReservationStatus.CANCELLED\n\t\t\tself.reservation_by_plate.pop(reservation.plate, None)\n\t\t\treturn reservation\n\n\tdef find_reservation(self, lookup: str, now: datetime | None = None) -> Reservation | None:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(now or self.clock.now())\n\t\t\tcode = lookup.strip().upper()\n\t\t\tif code not in self.reservations:\n\t\t\t\ttry:\n\t\t\t\t\tcode = self.reservation_by_plate.get(normalize_plate(lookup), \"\")\n\t\t\t\texcept ValueError:\n\t\t\t\t\treturn None\n\t\t\treturn self.reservations.get(code)\n\n\tdef convert_reservation_to_check_in(\n\t\tself, confirmation_code: str, entry_time: datetime | None = None\n\t) -> Ticket:\n\t\tcurrent = entry_time or self.clock.now()\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(current)\n\t\t\treservation = self._reservation_or_error(confirmation_code)\n\t\t\tif reservation.status is not ReservationStatus.PAID or not reservation.spot_id:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(\"reservation must be paid before check-in\")\n\t\t\tif reservation.plate in self.active_tickets:\n\t\t\t\traise VehicleAlreadyParkedError(f\"{reservation.plate} is already parked\")\n\t\t\tspot = self.spots[reservation.spot_id]\n\t\t\tspot.reservation_code = None\n\t\t\tspot.occupied = True\n\t\t\tvehicle = Vehicle(reservation.plate, reservation.vehicle_type)\n\t\t\tticket = Ticket(plate=vehicle.plate, vehicle=vehicle, spot_id=spot.spot_id, entry_time=current)\n\t\t\tspot.vehicle = vehicle\n\t\t\tspot.ticket_id = ticket.ticket_id\n\t\t\tself.active_tickets[vehicle.plate] = ticket\n\t\t\treservation.status = ReservationStatus.CHECKED_IN\n\t\t\tself.reservation_by_plate.pop(reservation.plate, None)\n\t\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef upcoming_reservations(self, now: datetime | None = None) -> list[Reservation]:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(now or self.clock.now())\n\t\t\treturn [reservation for reservation in self.reservations.values() if reservation.status in {ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT, ReservationStatus.PAID}]\n\n\tdef _expire_reservations(self, current: datetime, apply_no_show_grace: bool = False) -> None:\n\t\tfor reservation in self.reservations.values():\n\t\t\tif reservation.status is ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT and current >= reservation.payment_deadline:\n\t\t\t\treservation.status = ReservationStatus.EXPIRED\n\t\t\t\tself.reservation_by_plate.pop(reservation.plate, None)\n\t\t\telif reservation.status is ReservationStatus.PAID and current > reservation.arrival_end + (timedelta(minutes=30) if apply_no_show_grace else timedelta(0)):\n\t\t\t\tself._release_reserved_spot(reservation)\n\t\t\t\treservation.status = ReservationStatus.EXPIRED\n\t\t\t\tself.reservation_by_plate.pop(reservation.plate, None)\n\n\tdef _release_reserved_spot(self, reservation: Reservation) -> None:\n\t\tif reservation.spot_id:\n\t\t\tspot = self.spots[reservation.spot_id]\n\t\t\tspot.reservation_code = None\n\t\t\tif not spot.occupied:\n\t\t\t\tself.free_spots[spot.spot_type].add(spot.spot_id)\n\t\t\treservation.spot_id = None\n\n\tdef _reservation_or_error(self, confirmation_code: str) -> Reservation:\n\t\treservation = self.reservations.get(confirmation_code.strip().upper())\n\t\tif reservation is None:\n\t\t\traise ReservationNotFoundError(\"reservation not found\")\n\t\treturn reservation\n\n\tdef _new_confirmation_code(self) -> str:\n\t\talphabet = string.ascii_uppercase + string.digits\n\t\twhile True:\n\t\t\tcode = \"\".join(secrets.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(6))\n\t\t\tif code not in self.reservations:\n\t\t\t\treturn code\n\n\tdef check_out(\n\t\tself, plate: str, exit_time: datetime | None = None\n\t) -> Ticket:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tticket = self.active_tickets.pop(normalize_plate(plate), None)\n\t\t\tif ticket is None:\n\t\t\t\traise CarNotFoundError(f\"no active ticket for {plate}\")\n\t\t\tticket.exit_time = exit_time or self.clock.now()\n\t\t\tticket.fee = self.rate_card.calculate_fee(ticket.entry_time, ticket.exit_time)\n\t\t\tspot = self.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\t\t\tspot.occupied = False\n\t\t\tspot.vehicle = None\n\t\t\tspot.ticket_id = None\n\t\t\tself.free_spots[spot.spot_type].add(spot.spot_id)\n\t\t\tself.history.append(ticket)\n\t\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef auto_close_overdue(self, current_time: datetime | None = None) -> list[Ticket]:\n\t\t\"\"\"Close active sessions over 24 hours using rolling daily caps.\"\"\"\n\t\tcurrent = current_time or self.clock.now()\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(current, apply_no_show_grace=True)\n\t\t\tclosed: list[Ticket] = []\n\t\t\tfor plate, ticket in list(self.active_tickets.items()):\n\t\t\t\tif current - ticket.entry_time <= timedelta(hours=24):\n\t\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t\tself.active_tickets.pop(plate)\n\t\t\t\tticket.exit_time = current\n\t\t\t\tdays = max(1, math.ceil((current - ticket.entry_time).total_seconds() / (24 * 60 * 60)))\n\t\t\t\tticket.fee = (self.rate_card.daily_cap * Decimal(days)).quantize(Decimal(\"0.01\"))\n\t\t\t\tticket.auto_closed = True\n\t\t\t\tself._release_ticket_spot(ticket)\n\t\t\t\tself.history.append(ticket)\n\t\t\t\tclosed.append(ticket)\n\t\t\treturn closed\n\n\tdef transfer(self, old_plate: str, new_plate: str) -> Ticket:\n\t\told_key = normalize_plate(old_plate)\n\t\tnew_key = normalize_plate(new_plate)\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tticket = self.active_tickets.get(old_key)\n\t\t\tif ticket is None:\n\t\t\t\traise CarNotFoundError(f\"no active ticket for {old_plate}\")\n\t\t\tif new_key in self.active_tickets:\n\t\t\t\traise VehicleAlreadyParkedError(f\"{new_key} is already parked\")\n\t\t\tvehicle = Vehicle(new_key, ticket.vehicle.vehicle_type)\n\t\t\tticket.plate = vehicle.plate\n\t\t\tticket.vehicle = vehicle\n\t\t\tself.active_tickets.pop(old_key)\n\t\t\tself.active_tickets[new_key] = ticket\n\t\t\tspot = self.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\t\t\tspot.vehicle = vehicle\n\t\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef _release_ticket_spot(self, ticket: Ticket) -> None:\n\t\tspot = self.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\t\tspot.occupied = False\n\t\tspot.vehicle = None\n\t\tspot.ticket_id = None\n\t\tself.free_spots[spot.spot_type].add(spot.spot_id)\n\n\tdef find_car(self, plate: str) -> Ticket | None:\n\t\treturn self.active_tickets.get(normalize_plate(plate))\n\n\tdef is_spot_free(self, spot_type: SpotType | str) -> bool:\n\t\tnormalized_type = SpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type)\n\t\treturn bool(self.free_spots[normalized_type])\n\n\tdef available_spot_count(self, spot_type: SpotType | str) -> int:\n\t\tnormalized_type = SpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type)\n\t\treturn len(self.free_spots[normalized_type])\n\n\t@staticmethod\n\tdef _spot_type_for(vehicle_type: SpotType) -> list[SpotType]:\n\t\tif vehicle_type is SpotType.EV:\n\t\t\treturn [SpotType.EV]\n\t\tif vehicle_type is SpotType.COMPACT:\n\t\t\treturn [SpotType.COMPACT, SpotType.STANDARD]\n\t\treturn [SpotType.STANDARD, SpotType.COMPACT]\n",

                "text": "from datetime import date, datetime, timedelta\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Query, Request, Response\nfrom fastapi.responses import FileResponse, RedirectResponse\nfrom pydantic import BaseModel, Field\n\nfrom .garage import (\n\tCarNotFoundError,\n\tNoSpotAvailableError,\n\tParkingGarage,\n\tReservationConflictError,\n\tReservationNotFoundError,\n\tVehicleAlreadyParkedError,\n)\nfrom .auth import AuthStore\nfrom .models import PaymentMethod, Reservation, ReservationStatus, SpotType, Ticket, Vehicle, normalize_plate\nfrom .rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nBASE_DIR = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent\n\n\ndef build_garage() -> ParkingGarage:\n\treturn ParkingGarage(\n\t\tlevels=3,\n\t\tspots_per_level={SpotType.COMPACT: 10, SpotType.STANDARD: 15, SpotType.EV: 5},\n\t\trate_card=RateCard(50, 30, 200),\n\t)\n\n\ngarage = build_garage()\napp = FastAPI(title=\"Parking Garage Attendant System\", version=\"1.0.0\")\nauth = AuthStore()\n\n\nclass CheckInRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\tentry_time: datetime | None = None\n\n\nclass CheckOutRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\texit_time: datetime | None = None\n\n\nclass ReservationRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\tvehicle_type: SpotType\n\tarrival_start: datetime\n\tarrival_end: datetime\n\tpayment_method: PaymentMethod = PaymentMethod.UPI\n\tupi_id: str | None = None\n\n\nclass StaffSignup(BaseModel):\n\tname: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=80)\n\temail: str\n\tpassword: str = Field(min_length=8)\n\n\nclass StaffLogin(BaseModel):\n\temail: str\n\tpassword: str\n\n\nclass ClockRequest(BaseModel):\n\tset_time: datetime | None = None\n\tadvance_hours: float | None = None\n\n\nclass TransferRequest(BaseModel):\n\told_plate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\tnew_plate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\n\ndef ticket_data(ticket: Ticket, include_exit: bool = False) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tspot = garage.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\tdata: dict[str, object] = {\n\t\t\"ticket_id\": ticket.ticket_id,\n\t\t\"plate\": ticket.plate,\n\t\t\"vehicle_type\": ticket.vehicle.vehicle_type.value,\n\t\t\"spot_id\": ticket.spot_id,\n\t\t\"level\": spot.level,\n\t\t\"entry_time\": ticket.entry_time.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"status\": \"completed\" if ticket.exit_time else \"parked\",\n\t\t\"auto_closed\": ticket.auto_closed,\n\t}\n\tif include_exit:\n\t\tdata[\"exit_time\"] = ticket.exit_time.isoformat() if ticket.exit_time else None\n\t\tdata[\"fee\"] = str(ticket.fee) if ticket.fee is not None else None\n\treturn data\n\n\ndef reservation_data(reservation: Reservation) -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"confirmation_code\": reservation.confirmation_code,\n\t\t\"plate\": reservation.plate,\n\t\t\"vehicle_type\": reservation.vehicle_type.value,\n\t\t\"arrival_start\": reservation.arrival_start.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"arrival_end\": reservation.arrival_end.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"created_at\": reservation.created_at.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"payment_deadline\": reservation.payment_deadline.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"status\": reservation.status.value,\n\t\t\"spot_id\": reservation.spot_id,\n\t\t\"payment_method\": reservation.payment_method.value,\n\t\t\"payment_status\": reservation.payment_status.value,\n\t\t\"payment_amount\": str(reservation.payment_amount) if reservation.payment_amount is not None else None,\n\t}\n\n\ndef error_response(error: Exception) -> HTTPException:\n\tif isinstance(error, VehicleAlreadyParkedError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, NoSpotAvailableError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, CarNotFoundError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, ReservationNotFoundError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, ReservationConflictError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\treturn HTTPException(status_code=400, detail=str(error))\n\n\n@app.get(\"/\", response_class=FileResponse)\ndef index(request: Request) -> Response:\n\tif auth.users and auth.user_from_cookie(request.cookies.get(\"staff_session\")) is None:\n\t\treturn RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\treturn FileResponse(BASE_DIR / \"templates\" / \"index.html\")\n\n\n@app.get(\"/login\", response_class=FileResponse)\ndef login_page() -> FileResponse:\n\treturn FileResponse(BASE_DIR / \"templates\" / \"login.html\")\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/auth/signup\")\ndef signup(payload: StaffSignup, response: Response) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tuser = auth.create_user(payload.name, payload.email, payload.password)\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error)) from error\n\tresponse.set_cookie(\"staff_session\", auth.sign_in(user), httponly=True, samesite=\"lax\")\n\treturn {\"user\": {\"name\": user.name, \"email\": user.email}}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/auth/login\")\ndef login(payload: StaffLogin, response: Response) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tuser = auth.authenticate(payload.email, payload.password)\n\tif user is None:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail=\"invalid email or password\")\n\tresponse.set_cookie(\"staff_session\", auth.sign_in(user), httponly=True, samesite=\"lax\")\n\treturn {\"user\": {\"name\": user.name, \"email\": user.email}}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/auth/logout\")\ndef logout(request: Request, response: Response) -> dict[str, bool]:\n\tauth.sign_out(request.cookies.get(\"staff_session\"))\n\tresponse.delete_cookie(\"staff_session\")\n\treturn {\"ok\": True}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/customer\", response_class=FileResponse)\ndef customer_portal() -> FileResponse:\n\treturn FileResponse(BASE_DIR / \"templates\" / \"customer.html\")\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check-in\", status_code=201)\ndef check_in(payload: CheckInRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tvehicle = Vehicle(payload.plate, payload.vehicle_type)\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.check_in(vehicle, payload.entry_time))}\n\texcept (ValueError, VehicleAlreadyParkedError, NoSpotAvailableError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/check-out\")\ndef check_out(payload: CheckOutRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.check_out(normalize_plate(payload.plate), payload.exit_time), True)}\n\texcept (ValueError, CarNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/vehicle/{plate}\")\ndef vehicle_lookup(plate: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tnormalized_plate = normalize_plate(plate)\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(error)) from error\n\tticket = garage.find_car(normalized_plate)\n\tif ticket is None:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"vehicle is not currently parked\")\n\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(ticket)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability\")\ndef availability() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tgarage.upcoming_reservations()\n\tcounts = {spot_type.value: garage.available_spot_count(spot_type) for spot_type in SpotType}\n\treserved = sum(reservation.status is ReservationStatus.PAID for reservation in garage.reservations.values())\n\treturn {\"available\": counts, \"total\": len(garage.spots), \"occupied\": len(garage.active_tickets), \"reserved\": reserved}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability/{spot_type}\")\ndef type_availability(spot_type: SpotType) -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\"spot_type\": spot_type.value, \"available\": garage.available_spot_count(spot_type), \"is_free\": garage.is_spot_free(spot_type)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/transactions\")\ndef transactions(\n\tplate: str = \"\",\n\tfrom_date: date | None = None,\n\tto_date: date | None = None,\n\tpage: int = Query(1, ge=1),\n\tpage_size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100),\n) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tnormalized_filter = normalize_plate(plate) if plate else \"\"\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(error)) from error\n\tfiltered = [ticket for ticket in reversed(garage.history) if (\n\t\t(not normalized_filter or normalized_filter in ticket.plate)\n\t\tand (from_date is None or ticket.entry_time.date() >= from_date)\n\t\tand (to_date is None or ticket.entry_time.date() <= to_date)\n\t)]\n\tstart = (page - 1) * page_size\n\tpage_items = filtered[start:start + page_size]\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"transactions\": [ticket_data(ticket, True) for ticket in page_items],\n\t\t\"page\": page,\n\t\t\"page_size\": page_size,\n\t\t\"total\": len(filtered),\n\t\t\"pages\": max(1, (len(filtered) + page_size - 1) // page_size),\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tavailability_data = availability()\n\treturn {\n\t\t**availability_data,\n\t\t\"active_vehicles\": len(garage.active_tickets),\n\t\t\"completed_transactions\": len(garage.history),\n\t\t\"ev_available\": garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.EV),\n\t\t\"upcoming_reservations\": [reservation_data(reservation) for reservation in garage.upcoming_reservations()],\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/customer/config\")\ndef customer_config() -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"rates\": {\n\t\t\t\"first_hour_rate\": str(garage.rate_card.first_hour_rate),\n\t\t\t\"additional_hour_rate\": str(garage.rate_card.additional_hour_rate),\n\t\t\t\"daily_cap\": str(garage.rate_card.daily_cap),\n\t\t},\n\t\t\"reservation_payment_minutes\": 10,\n\t}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations\", status_code=201)\ndef create_reservation(payload: ReservationRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treservation = garage.create_reservation(\n\t\t\tVehicle(payload.plate, payload.vehicle_type),\n\t\t\tpayload.arrival_start.replace(tzinfo=None),\n\t\t\tpayload.arrival_end.replace(tzinfo=None),\n\t\t\tpayment_method=payload.payment_method,\n\t\t)\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(reservation), \"next_step\": \"payment\"}\n\texcept (ValueError, NoSpotAvailableError, ReservationConflictError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/pay\")\ndef pay_reservation(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(garage.pay_reservation(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (NoSpotAvailableError, ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/cash-collected\")\ndef cash_collected(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(garage.mark_cash_collected(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reservations/lookup\")\ndef lookup_reservation(plate: str | None = None, code: str | None = None) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tif not plate and not code:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=\"provide a plate or confirmation code\")\n\treservation = garage.find_reservation(code or plate or \"\")\n\tif reservation is None:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"reservation not found\")\n\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(reservation)}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/cancel\")\ndef cancel_reservation(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(garage.cancel_reservation(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/check-in\", status_code=201)\ndef reservation_check_in(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.convert_reservation_to_check_in(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError, VehicleAlreadyParkedError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reservations\")\ndef reservations() -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\"reservations\": [reservation_data(reservation) for reservation in garage.upcoming_reservations()]}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/clock\")\ndef clock(request: ClockRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tif (request.set_time is None) == (request.advance_hours is None):\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=\"provide exactly one of set_time or advance_hours\")\n\ttry:\n\t\tif request.set_time is not None:\n\t\t\tcurrent = garage.clock.set_time(request.set_time.replace(tzinfo=None))\n\t\telse:\n\t\t\tcurrent = garage.clock.advance_hours(request.advance_hours or 0)\n\t\tclosed = garage.auto_close_overdue(current)\n\t\treturn {\"clock_time\": current.isoformat(), \"auto_closed\": [ticket_data(ticket, True) for ticket in closed]}\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/transfer\")\ndef transfer(request: TransferRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.transfer(request.old_plate, request.new_plate))}\n\texcept (ValueError, CarNotFoundError, VehicleAlreadyParkedError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reports\")\ndef reports() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tnow = datetime.now()\n\ttoday = now.date()\n\tweek_start = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday())\n\tcompleted = garage.history\n\trevenue_today = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() == today), 0)\n\trevenue_week = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() >= week_start), 0)\n\tstay_seconds = [\n\t\t(ticket.exit_time - ticket.entry_time).total_seconds()\n\t\tfor ticket in completed\n\t\tif ticket.exit_time is not None\n\t]\n\toccupancy: dict[str, dict[str, float | int]] = {}\n\tfor spot_type in SpotType:\n\t\ttype_spots = [spot for spot in garage.spots.values() if spot.spot_type is spot_type]\n\t\toccupied = sum(spot.occupied for spot in type_spots)\n\t\toccupancy[spot_type.value] = {\n\t\t\t\"occupied\": occupied,\n\t\t\t\"total\": len(type_spots),\n\t\t\t\"percentage\": round((occupied / len(type_spots)) * 100, 1) if type_spots else 0,\n\t\t}\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"revenue_today\": str(revenue_today),\n\t\t\"revenue_week\": str(revenue_week),\n\t\t\"occupancy\": occupancy,\n\t\t\"average_stay_minutes\": round(sum(stay_seconds) / len(stay_seconds) / 60, 1) if stay_seconds else 0,\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/static/{asset_path:path}\")\ndef static_asset(asset_path: str) -> FileResponse:\n\tpath = BASE_DIR / \"static\" / asset_path\n\tif not path.is_file() or BASE_DIR not in path.resolve().parents:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"asset not found\")\n\treturn FileResponse(path)",

Customer</title><link rel=\"stylesheet\" href=\"/static/customer.css\"></head>\n<body><main class=\"customer-shell\"><header class=\"customer-header\"><a class=\"brand\" href=\"/\"><b>Parkflow</b><span>Customer parking</span></a><span class=\"live\"><i></i> Live availability</span></header>\n<section class=\"hero\"><p class=\"eyebrow\">RESERVE WITH CONFIDENCE</p><h1>Your space,<br><em>held fairly.</em></h1><p>See live availability, choose an arrival window, and confirm your place with a secure mock payment.</p></section>\n<section class=\"availability-section\"><div class=\"section-heading\"><div><p class=\"eyebrow\">RIGHT NOW</p><h2>Live availability</h2></div><span id=\"last-updated\">Updating...</span></div><div id=\"customer-availability\" class=\"availability-grid\"></div></section>\n<section class=\"customer-grid\"><div class=\"card reservation-card\"><div class=\"section-heading\"><div><p class=\"eyebrow\">STEP 01</p><h2>Choose your arrival</h2></div></div><form id=\"reservation-form\"><label>Indian license plate<input id=\"reservation-plate\" required placeholder=\"KA01AB1234\" maxlength=\"20\"><small>Example: KA01AB1234 or MH-12-CD-5678</small></label><label>Spot type<select id=\"reservation-type\"><option value=\"compact\">Compact</option><option value=\"standard\">Standard</option><option value=\"ev\">EV with charger</option></select></label><div class=\"time-grid\"><label>Arriving from<input id=\"arrival-start\" type=\"datetime-local\" required></label><label>Until<input id=\"arrival-end\" type=\"datetime-local\" required></label></div><p id=\"reservation-error\" class=\"error\"></p><button class=\"primary-button\" type=\"submit\">Continue to payment <span>→</span></button></form></div><div class=\"card rate-card\"><div class=\"section-heading\"><div><p class=\"eyebrow\">FAIR PRICING</p><h2>Rate card</h2></div><span class=\"rupee\">₹</span></div><div class=\"rates\"><div><span>First hour</span><strong id=\"first-rate\">₹—</strong></div><div><span>Each extra hour</span><strong 'ev' : ''}\"><span>${type === 'ev' ? 'EV with charger' : `${type} spot`}</span><strong>${count}</strong><span>available now</span></div>`).join(''); $('#first-rate').textContent = money(config.rates.first_hour_rate); $('#extra-rate').textContent = money(config.rates.additional_hour_rate); $('#cap-rate').textContent = money(config.rates.daily_cap); }\nfunction showPayment(reservation) { selectedReservation = reservation; $('#payment-card').hidden = false; $('#payment-summary').innerHTML = `<div class=\"summary-line\"><span>Confirmation</span><strong>${reservation.confirmation_code}</strong></div><div class=\"summary-line\"><span>Vehicle</span><strong>${reservation.plate} · ${reservation.vehicle_type.toUpperCase()}</strong></div><div class=\"summary-line\"><span>Arrival window</span><strong>${formatTime(reservation.arrival_start)} – ${formatTime(reservation.arrival_end)}</strong></div>`; const deadline = new Date(reservation.payment_deadline).getTime(); clearInterval(paymentTimer); paymentTimer = setInterval(() => { const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((deadline - Date.now()) / 1000)); $('#payment-timer').textContent = `${String(Math.floor(seconds / 60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(seconds % 60).padStart(2,'0')}`; if (!seconds) { clearInterval(paymentTimer); toast('Payment window expired. Please start again.', true); $('#payment-card').hidden = true; } }, 500); }\nfunction toast(text, error = false) { const node = $('#reservation-error'); node.textContent = text; node.className = error ? 'error' : ''; }\n$('#reservation-plate').addEventListener('input', (event) => { event.target.value = event.target.value.toUpperCase(); });\n$('#reservation-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const plate = $('#reservation-plate'); const error = $('#reservation-error'); error.textContent = ''; if (!plate.value.trim()) { error.textContent = 'Enter your license plate.'; plate.focus(); return; } const start = new Date($('#arrival-start').value); const end = new Date($('#arrival-end').value); if (Number.isNaN(start.getTime()) || Number.isNaN(end.getTime()) || end <= start) { error.textContent = 'Choose a valid arrival window.'; return; } const button = event.target.querySelector('button'); button.disabled = true; button.textContent = 'Creating reservation…'; try { const data = await api('/api/reservations', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({plate: plate.value, vehicle_type: $('#reservation-type').value, arrival_start: start.toISOString(), arrival_end: end.toISOString()})}); showPayment(data.reservation); toast('Reservation created. Complete payment within 10 minutes.'); await refreshAvailability(); } catch (requestError) { error.textContent = requestError.message; } finally { button.disabled = false; button.innerHTML = 'Continue to payment <span>→</span>'; } });\n$('#payment-method').addEventListener('change', () => { $('#upi-field').hidden = $('#payment-method').value === 'cash'; });\n$('#pay-button').addEventListener('click', async () => { if (!selectedReservation) return; const button = $('#pay-button'); button.disabled = true; button.textContent = 'Confirming…'; try { const method = $('#payment-method').value; if (method === 'cash') { selectedReservation.payment_method = 'cash'; selectedReservation.payment_status = 'pending'; $('#payment-summary').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', '<p class=\"success\">Reservation confirmed. Cash due at the gate.</p>'); button.textContent = 'Reservation confirmed'; } else { if (!$('#upi-id').value.trim()) throw new Error('Enter a mock UPI ID.'); const data = await api(`/api/reservations/${selectedReservation.confirmation_code}/pay`, {method:'POST'}); selectedReservation = data.reservation; $('#payment-summary').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', '<p class=\"success\">UPI payment confirmed. Your spot is held until the arrival window ends.</p>'); button.textContent = 'Payment confirmed'; } await refreshAvailability(); } catch (error) { toast(error.message, true); button.disabled = false; button.innerHTML = 'Confirm payment <span>→</span>'; } });\n$('#lookup-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const value = $('#lookup-value').value.trim(); if (!value) return; const result = $('#reservation-result'); try { const data = await api(`/api/reservations/lookup?${value.length === 6 ? `code=${encodeURIComponent(value)}` : `plate=${encodeURIComponent(value)}`}`); const r = data.reservation; result.className = 'result'; result.innerHTML = `<div class=\"summary-line\"><span>Confirmation</span><strong>${r.confirmation_code}</strong></div><div class=\"summary-line\"><span>Status</span><strong>${r.status.replaceAll('_',' ')}</strong></div><div class=\"summary-line\"><span>Arrival</span><strong>${formatTime(r.arrival_start)} – ${formatTime(r.arrival_end)}</strong></div>${['pending_payment','paid'].includes(r.status) ? `<button id=\"cancel-reservation\" class=\"secondary-button\">Cancel reservation</button>` : ''}`; $('#cancel-reservation')?.addEventListener('click', async () => { await api(`/api/reservations/${r.confirmation_code}/cancel`, {method:'POST'}); result.innerHTML += '<p class=\"success\">Reservation cancelled and the held spot was released.</p>'; await refreshAvailability(); }); } catch (error) { result.className = 'result empty'; result.textContent = error.message; } });\nsetDefaultWindow(); refreshAvailability().catch(error => toast(error.message, true)); setInterval(() => refreshAvailability().catch(() => {}), 7000);\n",

                "text": "from datetime import datetime, timedelta\nfrom decimal import Decimal\nfrom collections.abc import Mapping\nimport secrets\nimport string\nimport math\nfrom threading import Lock\n\nfrom .clock import Clock\nfrom .models import PaymentMethod, PaymentStatus, Reservation, ReservationStatus, Spot, SpotType, Ticket, Vehicle, normalize_plate\nfrom .rate_card import RateCard\n\n\nclass GarageError(Exception):\n\t\"\"\"Base exception for expected garage operation failures.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass VehicleAlreadyParkedError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass NoSpotAvailableError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass CarNotFoundError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass ReservationNotFoundError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass ReservationConflictError(GarageError):\n\tpass\n\n\nclass ParkingGarage:\n\tdef __init__(\n\t\tself,\n\t\tlevels: int,\n\t\tspots_per_level: Mapping[SpotType | str, int],\n\t\trate_card: RateCard,\n\t\tclock: Clock | None = None,\n\t) -> None:\n\t\tif levels < 1:\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"levels must be at least 1\")\n\t\tnormalized_counts = {\n\t\t\tSpotType(spot_type.lower() if isinstance(spot_type, str) else spot_type): count\n\t\t\tfor spot_type, count in spots_per_level.items()\n\t\t}\n\t\tif any(count < 0 for count in normalized_counts.values()):\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"spot counts must not be negative\")\n\n\t\tself.rate_card = rate_card\n\t\tself.clock = clock or Clock()\n\t\tself.spots: dict[str, Spot] = {}\n\t\tself.free_spots: dict[SpotType, set[str]] = {\n\t\t\tspot_type: set() for spot_type in SpotType\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor level in range(1, levels + 1):\n\t\t\tfor spot_type in SpotType:\n\t\t\t\tfor number in range(1, normalized_counts.get(spot_type, 0) + 1):\n\t\t\t\t\tspot_id = f\"L{level}-{spot_type.value.upper()}-{number}\"\n\t\t\t\t\tspot = Spot(\n\t\t\t\t\t\tspot_id=spot_id,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tlevel=level,\n\t\t\t\t\t\tspot_type=spot_type,\n\t\t\t\t\t\thas_charger=spot_type is SpotType.EV,\n\t\t\t\t\t)\n\t\t\t\t\tself.spots[spot_id] = spot\n\t\t\t\t\tself.free_spots[spot_type].add(spot_id)\n\n\t\tself.active_tickets: dict[str, Ticket] = {}\n\t\tself.history: list[Ticket] = []\n\t\tself.reservations: dict[str, Reservation] = {}\n\t\tself.reservation_by_plate: dict[str, str] = {}\n\t\tself._lock = Lock()\n\n\tdef check_in(self, vehicle: Vehicle, entry_time: datetime | None = None) -> Ticket:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(entry_time or self.clock.now())\n\t\t\tif vehicle.plate in self.active_tickets:\n\t\t\t\traise VehicleAlreadyParkedError(f\"{vehicle.plate} is already parked\")\n\n\t\t\tcandidate_types = self._spot_type_for(vehicle.vehicle_type)\n\t\t\tselected_type = next(\n\t\t\t\t(candidate for candidate in candidate_types if self.free_spots[candidate]), None\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tif selected_type is None:\n\t\t\t\traise NoSpotAvailableError(\n\t\t\t\t\tf\"no spot available for {vehicle.vehicle_type.value} vehicle\"\n\t\t\t\t)\n\n\t\t\tselected_id = self.free_spots[selected_type].pop()\n\t\t\tspot = self.spots[selected_id]\n\t\t\tticket = Ticket(\n\t\t\t\tplate=vehicle.plate,\n\t\t\t\tvehicle=vehicle,\n\t\t\t\tspot_id=selected_id,\n\t\t\t\tentry_time=entry_time or self.clock.now(),\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tspot.occupied = True\n\t\t\tspot.vehicle = vehicle\n\t\t\tspot.ticket_id = ticket.ticket_id\n\t\t\tself.active_tickets[vehicle.plate] = ticket\n\t\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef create_reservation(\n\t\tself,\n\t\tvehicle: Vehicle,\n\t\tarrival_start: datetime,\n\t\tarrival_end: datetime,\n\t\tnow: datetime | None = None,\n\t\tpayment_method: PaymentMethod = PaymentMethod.UPI,\n\t) -> Reservation:\n\t\tcurrent = now or self.clock.now()\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(current)\n\t\t\tif vehicle.plate in self.active_tickets:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(f\"{vehicle.plate} is already parked\")\n\t\t\tif vehicle.plate in self.reservation_by_plate:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(f\"{vehicle.plate} already has an active reservation\")\n\t\t\tif arrival_end <= arrival_start or arrival_start < current:\n\t\t\t\traise ValueError(\"arrival window must be in the future and end after it starts\")\n\t\t\tif arrival_start > current + timedelta(hours=24) or arrival_end > current + timedelta(hours=24):\n\t\t\t\traise ValueError(\"reservations are limited to the next 24 hours\")\n\t\t\tif not any(self.free_spots[candidate] for candidate in self._spot_type_for(vehicle.vehicle_type)):\n\t\t\t\traise NoSpotAvailableError(f\"no spot available for {vehicle.vehicle_type.value} reservation\")\n\t\t\tcode = self._new_confirmation_code()\n\t\t\treservation = Reservation(\n\t\t\t\tconfirmation_code=code,\n\t\t\t\tplate=vehicle.plate,\n\t\t\t\tvehicle_type=vehicle.vehicle_type,\n\t\t\t\tarrival_start=arrival_start,\n\t\t\t\tarrival_end=arrival_end,\n\t\t\t\tcreated_at=current,\n\t\t\t\tpayment_deadline=current + timedelta(minutes=10),\n\t\t\t\tpayment_method=payment_method,\n\t\t\t\tpayment_amount=self.rate_card.first_hour_rate,\n\t\t\t)\n\t\t\tself.reservations[code] = reservation\n\t\t\tself.reservation_by_plate[vehicle.plate] = code\n\t\t\tif payment_method is PaymentMethod.CASH:\n\t\t\t\tself._hold_reservation_spot(reservation, current)\n\t\t\treturn reservation\n\n\tdef pay_reservation(self, confirmation_code: str, now: datetime | None = None, payment_method: PaymentMethod = PaymentMethod.UPI) -> Reservation:\n\t\tcurrent = now or self.clock.now()\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(current)\n\t\t\treservation = self._reservation_or_error(confirmation_code)\n\t\t\tif payment_method is PaymentMethod.CASH:\n\t\t\t\treservation.payment_method = PaymentMethod.CASH\n\t\t\t\tself._hold_reservation_spot(reservation, current)\n\t\t\t\treturn reservation\n\t\t\tif reservation.payment_method is not PaymentMethod.UPI:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(\"cash reservations are collected at the gate\")\n\t\t\tif reservation.status is not ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(f\"reservation is {reservation.status.value}\")\n\t\t\tself._hold_reservation_spot(reservation, current)\n\t\t\treservation.status = ReservationStatus.PAID\n\t\t\treservation.payment_status = PaymentStatus.PAID\n\t\t\treturn reservation\n\n\tdef _hold_reservation_spot(self, reservation: Reservation, current: datetime) -> None:\n\t\tselected_type = next((candidate for candidate in self._spot_type_for(reservation.vehicle_type) if self.free_spots[candidate]), None)\n\t\tif selected_type is None:\n\t\t\traise NoSpotAvailableError(\"no compatible spot remains for reservation\")\n\t\tspot_id = self.free_spots[selected_type].pop()\n\t\tspot = self.spots[spot_id]\n\t\tspot.reservation_code = reservation.confirmation_code\n\t\treservation.spot_id = spot_id\n\t\treservation.paid_at = current\n\t\tif reservation.payment_method is PaymentMethod.CASH:\n\t\t\treservation.status = ReservationStatus.PAID\n\n\tdef mark_cash_collected(self, confirmation_code: str) -> Reservation:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\treservation = self._reservation_or_error(confirmation_code)\n\t\t\tif reservation.payment_method is not PaymentMethod.CASH:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(\"only cash reservations need collection\")\n\t\t\treservation.payment_status = PaymentStatus.COLLECTED\n\t\t\treturn reservation\n\n\tdef cancel_reservation(self, confirmation_code: str, now: datetime | None = None) -> Reservation:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(now or self.clock.now())\n\t\t\treservation = self._reservation_or_error(confirmation_code)\n\t\t\tif reservation.status not in {ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT, ReservationStatus.PAID}:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(f\"reservation is {reservation.status.value}\")\n\t\t\tself._release_reserved_spot(reservation)\n\t\t\treservation.status = ReservationStatus.CANCELLED\n\t\t\tself.reservation_by_plate.pop(reservation.plate, None)\n\t\t\treturn reservation\n\n\tdef find_reservation(self, lookup: str, now: datetime | None = None) -> Reservation | None:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(now or self.clock.now())\n\t\t\tcode = lookup.strip().upper()\n\t\t\tif code not in self.reservations:\n\t\t\t\ttry:\n\t\t\t\t\tcode = self.reservation_by_plate.get(normalize_plate(lookup), \"\")\n\t\t\t\texcept ValueError:\n\t\t\t\t\treturn None\n\t\t\treturn self.reservations.get(code)\n\n\tdef convert_reservation_to_check_in(\n\t\tself, confirmation_code: str, entry_time: datetime | None = None\n\t) -> Ticket:\n\t\tcurrent = entry_time or self.clock.now()\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(current)\n\t\t\treservation = self._reservation_or_error(confirmation_code)\n\t\t\tif reservation.status is not ReservationStatus.PAID or not reservation.spot_id:\n\t\t\t\traise ReservationConflictError(\"reservation must be paid before check-in\")\n\t\t\tif reservation.plate in self.active_tickets:\n\t\t\t\traise VehicleAlreadyParkedError(f\"{reservation.plate} is already parked\")\n\t\t\tspot = self.spots[reservation.spot_id]\n\t\t\tspot.reservation_code = None\n\t\t\tspot.occupied = True\n\t\t\tvehicle = Vehicle(reservation.plate, reservation.vehicle_type)\n\t\t\tticket = Ticket(plate=vehicle.plate, vehicle=vehicle, spot_id=spot.spot_id, entry_time=current)\n\t\t\tspot.vehicle = vehicle\n\t\t\tspot.ticket_id = ticket.ticket_id\n\t\t\tself.active_tickets[vehicle.plate] = ticket\n\t\t\treservation.status = ReservationStatus.CHECKED_IN\n\t\t\tself.reservation_by_plate.pop(reservation.plate, None)\n\t\t\treturn ticket\n\n\tdef upcoming_reservations(self, now: datetime | None = None) -> list[Reservation]:\n\t\twith self._lock:\n\t\t\tself._expire_reservations(now or self.clock.now())\n\t\t\treturn [reservation for reservation in self.reservations.values() if reservation.status in {ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT, ReservationStatus.PAID}]\n\n\tdef _expire_reservations(self, current: datetime, apply_no_show_grace: bool = False) -> None:\n\t\tfor reservation in self.reservations.values():\n\t\t\tif reservation.status is ReservationStatus.PENDING_PAYMENT and current >= reservation.payment_deadline:\n\t\t\t\treservation.status = ReservationStatus.EXPIRED\n\t\t\t\tself.reservation_by_plate.pop(reservation.plate, None)\n\t\t\telif reservation.status is ReservationStatus.PAID and current > reservation.arrival_end +             [
              {
                "text": "const $ = (selector) => document.querySelector(selector);\nconst api = async (url, options = {}) => { const response = await fetch(url, {headers: {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, ...options}); const data = await response.json(); if (!response.ok) throw new Error(data.detail || 'Request failed'); return data; };\nlet selectedReservation = null;\nlet paymentTimer;\nconst money = (value) => `₹${Number(value).toFixed(2)}`;\nconst formatTime = (value) => new Date(value).toLocaleString([], {month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'});\nfunction setDefaultWindow() { const now = new Date(); const end = new Date(now.getTime() + 2 * 60 * 60 * 1000); const local = (date) => new Date(date.getTime() - date.getTimezoneOffset() * 60000).toISOString().slice(0,16); $('#arrival-start').value = local(now); $('#arrival-end').value = local(end); }\nasync function refreshAvailability() { const [dashboard, config] = await Promise.all([api('/api/dashboard'), api('/api/customer/config')]); $('#last-updated').textContent = `Updated ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})}`; $('#customer-availability').innerHTML = Object.entries(dashboard.available).map(([type, count]) => `<div class=\"availability-item ${type === 'ev' ? 'ev' : ''}\"><span>${type === 'ev' ? 'EV with charger' : `${type} spot`}</span><strong>${count}</strong><span>available now</span></div>`).join(''); $('#first-rate').textContent = money(config.rates.first_hour_rate); $('#extra-rate').textContent = money(config.rates.additional_hour_rate); $('#cap-rate').textContent = money(config.rates.daily_cap); }\nfunction showPayment(reservation) { selectedReservation = reservation; $('#payment-card').hidden = false; $('#payment-summary').innerHTML = `<div class=\"summary-line\"><span>Confirmation</span><strong>${reservation.confirmation_code}</strong></div><div class=\"summary-line\"><span>Vehicle</span><strong>${reservation.plate} · ${reservation.vehicle_type.toUpperCase()}</strong></div><div class=\"summary-line\"><span>Arrival window</span><strong>${formatTime(reservation.arrival_start)} – ${formatTime(reservation.arrival_end)}</strong></div>`; const deadline = new Date(reservation.payment_deadline).getTime(); clearInterval(paymentTimer); paymentTimer = setInterval(() => { const seconds = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((deadline - Date.now()) / 1000)); $('#payment-timer').textContent = `${String(Math.floor(seconds / 60)).padStart(2,'0')}:${String(seconds % 60).padStart(2,'0')}`; if (!seconds) { clearInterval(paymentTimer); toast('Payment window expired. Please start again.', true); $('#payment-card').hidden = true; } }, 500); }\nfunction toast(text, error = false) { const node = $('#reservation-error'); node.textContent = text; node.className = error ? 'error' : ''; }\n$('#reservation-plate').addEventListener('input', (event) => { event.target.value = event.target.value.toUpperCase(); });\n$('#reservation-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const plate = $('#reservation-plate'); const error = $('#reservation-error'); error.textContent = ''; if (!plate.value.trim()) { error.textContent = 'Enter your license plate.'; plate.focus(); return; } const start = new Date($('#arrival-start').value); const end = new Date($('#arrival-end').value); if (Number.isNaN(start.getTime()) || Number.isNaN(end.getTime()) || end <= start) { error.textContent = 'Choose a valid arrival window.'; return; } const button = event.target.querySelector('button'); button.disabled = true; button.textContent = 'Creating reservation…'; try { const data = await api('/api/reservations', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({plate: plate.value, vehicle_type: $('#reservation-type').value, arrival_start: start.toISOString(), arrival_end: end.toISOString()})}); showPayment(data.reservation); toast('Reservation created. Complete payment within 10 minutes.'); await refreshAvailability(); } catch (requestError) { error.textContent = requestError.message; } finally { button.disabled = false; button.innerHTML = 'Continue to payment <span>→</span>'; } });\n$('#payment-method').addEventListener('change', () => { $('#upi-field').hidden = $('#payment-method').value === 'cash'; });\n$('#pay-button').addEventListener('click', async () => { if (!selectedReservation) return; const button = $('#pay-button'); button.disabled = true; button.textContent = 'Confirming…'; try { const method = $('#payment-method').value; if (method === 'upi' && !$('#upi-id').value.trim()) throw new Error('Enter a mock UPI ID.'); const data = await api(`/api/reservations/${selectedReservation.confirmation_code}/pay`, {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({payment_method: method, upi_id: $('#upi-id').value.trim() || null})}); selectedReservation = data.reservation; $('#payment-summary').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend', `<p class=\"success\">Reservation confirmed. ${method === 'cash' ? 'Cash due at the gate.' : 'UPI payment confirmed and spot held.'}</p>`); button.textContent = 'Reservation confirmed'; await refreshAvailability(); } catch (error) { toast(error.message, true); button.disabled = false; button.innerHTML = 'Confirm payment <span>→</span>'; } });\n$('#lookup-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const value = $('#lookup-value').value.trim(); if (!value) return; const result = $('#reservation-result'); try { const data = await api(`/api/reservations/lookup?${value.length === 6 ? `code=${encodeURIComponent(value)}` : `plate=${encodeURIComponent(value)}`}`); const r = data.reservation; result.className = 'result'; result.innerHTML = `<div class=\"summary-line\"><span>Confirmation</span><strong>${r.confirmation_code}</strong></div><div class=\"summary-line\"><span>Status</span><strong>${r.status.replaceAll('_',' ')}</strong></div><div class=\"summary-line\"><span>Arrival</span><strong>${formatTime(r.arrival_start)} – ${formatTime(r.arrival_end)}</strong></div>${['pending_payment','paid'].includes(r.status) ? `<button id=\"cancel-reservation\" class=\"secondary-button\">Cancel reservation</button>` : ''}`; $('#cancel-reservation')?.addEventListener('click', async () => { await api(`/api/reservations/${r.confirmation_code}/cancel`, {method:'POST'}); result.innerHTML += '<p class=\"success\">Reservation cancelled and the held spot was released.</p>'; await refreshAvailability(); }); } catch (error) { result.className = 'result empty'; result.textContent = error.message; } });\nsetDefaultWindow(); refreshAvailability().catch(error => toast(error.message, true)); setInterval(() => refreshAvailability().catch(() => {}), 7000);\n",

(\n\tCarNotFoundError,\n\tNoSpotAvailableError,\n\tParkingGarage,\n\tReservationConflictError,\n\tReservationNotFoundError,\n\tVehicleAlreadyParkedError,\n)\nfrom .auth import AuthStore\nfrom .models build_garage() -> ParkingGarage:\n\treturn ParkingGarage(\n\t\tlevels=3,\n\t\tspots_per_level={SpotType.COMPACT: 10, SpotType.STANDARD: 15, SpotType.EV: 5},\n\t\trate_card=RateCard(50, 30, 200),\n\t)\n\n\ngarage = build_garage()\napp = FastAPI(title=\"Parking Garage Attendant System\", version=\"1.0.0\")\nauth = AuthStore()\n\n\nclass CheckInRequest(BaseModel):\n\tplate: str = max_length=80)\n\temail: str\n\tpassword: str = Field(min_length=8)\n\n\nclass StaffLogin(BaseModel):\n\temail: str\n\tpassword: str\n\nclass PaymentRequest(BaseModel):\n\tpayment_method: TransferRequest(BaseModel):\n\told_plate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\tnew_plate: str = Field(min_length=1, max_length=20)\n\n\ndef ticket_data(ticket: Ticket, include_exit: bool = False) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tspot = garage.spots[ticket.spot_id]\n\tdata: dict[str, object] = {\n\t\t\"ticket_id\": ticket.ticket_id,\n\t\t\"plate\": ticket.plate,\n\t\t\"vehicle_type\": ticket.vehicle.vehicle_type.value,\n\t\t\"spot_id\": ticket.spot_id,\n\t\t\"level\": spot.level,\n\t\t\"entry_time\": ticket.entry_time.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"status\": \"completed\" if ticket.exit_time else \"parked\",\n\t\t\"auto_closed\": ticket.auto_closed,\n\t}\n\tif include_exit:\n\t\tdata[\"exit_time\"] = ticket.exit_time.isoformat() if ticket.exit_time else None\n\t\tdata[\"fee\"] = str(ticket.fee) if ticket.fee is not None else None\n\treturn data\n\n\ndef reservation_data(reservation: Reservation) -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"confirmation_code\": reservation.confirmation_code,\n\t\t\"plate\": reservation.plate,\n\t\t\"vehicle_type\": reservation.vehicle_type.value,\n\t\t\"arrival_start\": reservation.arrival_start.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"arrival_end\": reservation.arrival_end.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"created_at\": reservation.created_at.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"payment_deadline\": reservation.payment_deadline.isoformat(),\n\t\t\"status\": reservation.status.value,\n\t\t\"spot_id\": reservation.spot_id,\n\t\t\"payment_method\": reservation.payment_method.value,\n\t\t\"payment_status\": reservation.payment_status.value,\n\t\t\"payment_amount\": str(reservation.payment_amount) if reservation.payment_amount is not None else None,\n\t}\n\n\ndef error_response(error: Exception) -> HTTPException:\n\tif isinstance(error, VehicleAlreadyParkedError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, NoSpotAvailableError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=409, detail=str(error))\n\tif isinstance(error, CarNotFoundError):\n\t\treturn HTTPException(status_code=404, samesite=\"lax\")\n\treturn {\"user\": {\"name\": user.name, \"email\": user.email}}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/auth/login\")\ndef login(payload: StaffLogin, response: Response) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tuser = auth.authenticate(payload.email, payload.password)\n\tif user is None:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=401, detail=\"invalid email or user.email}}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/auth/logout\")\ndef logout(request: Request, response: Response) -> dict[str, dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tvehicle = Vehicle(payload.plate, payload.vehicle_type)\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.check_in(vehicle, payload.entry_time))}\n\texcept (ValueError, object]:\n\tgarage.upcoming_reservations()\n\tcounts = {spot_type.value: garage.available_spot_count(spot_type) for spot_type in SpotType}\n\treserved = sum(reservation.status is ReservationStatus.PAID for reservation in garage.reservations.values())\n\treturn {\"available\": counts, \"total\": len(garage.spots), \"occupied\": len(garage.active_tickets), \"reserved\": reserved}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability/{spot_type}\")\ndef type_availability(spot_type: SpotType) -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\"spot_type\": spot_type.value, \"available\": garage.available_spot_count(spot_type), \"is_free\": garage.is_spot_free(spot_type)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/transactions\")\ndef transactions(\n\tplate: str = \"\",\n\tfrom_date: date | None = None,\n\tto_date: date | None = None,\n\tpage: int = Query(1, ge=1),\n\tpage_size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100),\n) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tnormalized_filter = normalize_plate(plate) if plate else \"\"\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(error)) from error\n\tfiltered = [ticket for ticket in reversed(garage.history) if (\n\t\t(not normalized_filter or normalized_filter in ticket.plate)\n\t\tand (from_date is None or ticket.entry_time.date() >= from_date)\n\t\tand (to_date is None or ticket.entry_time.date() <= to_date)\n\t)]\n\tstart = (page - 1) * page_size\n\tpage_items = filtered[start:start + page_size]\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"transactions\": [ticket_data(ticket, True) for ticket in page_items],\n\t\t\"page\": page,\n\t\t\"page_size\": page_size,\n\t\t\"total\": len(filtered),\n\t\t\"pages\": max(1, (len(filtered) + page_size - 1) // ticket_data(garage.check_out(normalize_plate(payload.plate), payload.exit_time), True)}\n\texcept (ValueError, CarNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/vehicle/{plate}\")\ndef vehicle_lookup(plate: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tnormalized_plate = normalize_plate(plate)\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(error)) from error\n\tticket = garage.find_car(normalized_plate)\n\tif ticket is None:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"vehicle is not currently parked\")\n\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(ticket)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability\")\ndef availability() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tgarage.upcoming_reservations()\n\tcounts = {spot_type.value: garage.available_spot_count(spot_type) for spot_type in SpotType}\n\treserved = sum(reservation.status is ReservationStatus.PAID for reservation in garage.reservations.values())\n\treturn {\"available\": counts, \"total\": len(garage.spots), \"occupied\": len(garage.active_tickets), \"reserved\": reserved}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/spots/availability/{spot_type}\")\ndef type_availability(spot_type: SpotType) -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\"spot_type\": spot_type.value, \"available\": garage.available_spot_count(spot_type), \"is_free\": garage.is_spot_free(spot_type)}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/transactions\")\ndef transactions(\n\tplate: str = \"\",\n\tfrom_date: date | None = None,\n\tto_date: date | None = None,\n\tpage: int = Query(1, ge=1),\n\tpage_size: int = Query(10, ge=1, le=100),\n) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\tnormalized_filter = normalize_plate(plate) if plate else \"\"\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(error)) from error\n\tfiltered = [ticket for ticket in reversed(garage.history) if (\n\t\t(not normalized_filter or normalized_filter in ticket.plate)\n\t\tand (from_date is None or ticket.entry_time.date() >= from_date)\n\t\tand (to_date is None or ticket.entry_time.date() <= to_date)\n\t)]\n\tstart = (page - 1) * page_size\n\tpage_items = filtered[start:start + page_size]\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"transactions\": [ticket_data(ticket, True) for ticket in page_items],\n\t\t\"page\": page,\n\t\t\"page_size\": page_size,\n\t\t\"total\": len(filtered),\n\t\t\"pages\": max(1, (len(filtered) + page_size - 1) // page_size),\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/dashboard\")\ndef dashboard() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tavailability_data = availability()\n\treturn {\n\t\t**availability_data,\n\t\t\"active_vehicles\": len(garage.active_tickets),\n\t\t\"completed_transactions\": len(garage.history),\n\t\t\"ev_available\": garage.is_spot_free(SpotType.EV),\n\t\t\"upcoming_reservations\": [reservation_data(reservation) for reservation in garage.upcoming_reservations()],\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/customer/config\")\ndef customer_config() -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"rates\": {\n\t\t\t\"first_hour_rate\": str(garage.rate_card.first_hour_rate),\n\t\t\t\"additional_hour_rate\": str(garage.rate_card.additional_hour_rate),\n\t\t\t\"daily_cap\": str(garage.rate_card.daily_cap),\n\t\t},\n\t\t\"reservation_payment_minutes\": 10,\n\t}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations\", status_code=201)\ndef create_reservation(payload: ReservationRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treservation = garage.create_reservation(\n\t\t\tVehicle(payload.plate, payload.vehicle_type),\n\t\t\tpayload.arrival_start.replace(tzinfo=None),\n\t\t\tpayload.arrival_end.replace(tzinfo=None),\n\t\t\tpayment_method=payload.payment_method,\n\t\t)\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(reservation), \"next_step\": \"payment\"}\n\texcept (ValueError, NoSpotAvailableError, ReservationConflictError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/pay\")\ndef pay_reservation(confirmation_code: str, payload: PaymentRequest | None = None) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\trequest = payload or PaymentRequest()\n\t\tif payload is not None and request.payment_method is PaymentMethod.UPI and not request.upi_id:\n\t\t\traise ValueError(\"mock UPI ID is required\")\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(garage.pay_reservation(confirmation_code, payment_method=request.payment_method))}\n\texcept (NoSpotAvailableError, ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/cash-collected\")\ndef cash_collected(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(garage.mark_cash_collected(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reservations/lookup\")\ndef lookup_reservation(plate: str | None = None, code: str | None = None) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tif not plate and not code:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=\"provide a plate or confirmation code\")\n\treservation = garage.find_reservation(code or plate or \"\")\n\tif reservation is None:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"reservation not found\")\n\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(reservation)}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/cancel\")\ndef cancel_reservation(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"reservation\": reservation_data(garage.cancel_reservation(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/api/reservations/{confirmation_code}/check-in\", status_code=201)\ndef reservation_check_in(confirmation_code: str) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.convert_reservation_to_check_in(confirmation_code))}\n\texcept (ReservationConflictError, ReservationNotFoundError, VehicleAlreadyParkedError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reservations\")\ndef reservations() -> dict[str, object]:\n\treturn {\"reservations\": [reservation_data(reservation) for reservation in garage.upcoming_reservations()]}\n\n\n@app.post(\"/clock\")\ndef clock(request: ClockRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\tif (request.set_time is None) == (request.advance_hours is None):\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=\"provide exactly one of set_time or advance_hours\")\n\ttry:\n\t\tif request.set_time is not None:\n\t\t\tcurrent = garage.clock.set_time(request.set_time.replace(tzinfo=None))\n\t\telse:\n\t\t\tcurrent = garage.clock.advance_hours(request.advance_hours or 0)\n\t\tclosed = garage.auto_close_overdue(current)\n\t\treturn {\"clock_time\": current.isoformat(), \"auto_closed\": [ticket_data(ticket, True) for ticket in closed]}\n\texcept ValueError as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.post(\"/transfer\")\ndef transfer(request: TransferRequest) -> dict[str, object]:\n\ttry:\n\t\treturn {\"ticket\": ticket_data(garage.transfer(request.old_plate, request.new_plate))}\n\texcept (ValueError, CarNotFoundError, VehicleAlreadyParkedError) as error:\n\t\traise error_response(error) from error\n\n\n@app.get(\"/api/reports\")\ndef reports() -> dict[str, object]:\n\tnow = datetime.now()\n\ttoday = now.date()\n\tweek_start = today - timedelta(days=today.weekday())\n\tcompleted = garage.history\n\trevenue_today = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() == today), 0)\n\trevenue_week = sum((ticket.fee or 0 for ticket in completed if ticket.exit_time and ticket.exit_time.date() >= week_start), 0)\n\tstay_seconds = [\n\t\t(ticket.exit_time - ticket.entry_time).total_seconds()\n\t\tfor ticket in completed\n\t\tif ticket.exit_time is not None\n\t]\n\toccupancy: dict[str, dict[str, float | int]] = {}\n\tfor spot_type in SpotType:\n\t\ttype_spots = [spot for spot in garage.spots.values() if spot.spot_type is spot_type]\n\t\toccupied = sum(spot.occupied for spot in type_spots)\n\t\toccupancy[spot_type.value] = {\n\t\t\t\"occupied\": occupied,\n\t\t\t\"total\": len(type_spots),\n\t\t\t\"percentage\": round((occupied / len(type_spots)) * 100, 1) if type_spots else 0,\n\t\t}\n\treturn {\n\t\t\"revenue_today\": str(revenue_today),\n\t\t\"revenue_week\": str(revenue_week),\n\t\t\"occupancy\": occupancy,\n\t\t\"average_stay_minutes\": round(sum(stay_seconds) / len(stay_seconds) / 60, 1) if stay_seconds else 0,\n\t}\n\n\n@app.get(\"/static/{asset_path:path}\")\ndef static_asset(asset_path: str) -> FileResponse:\n\tpath = BASE_DIR / \"static\" / asset_path\n\tif not path.is_file() or BASE_DIR not in path.resolve().parents:\n\t\traise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"asset not found\")\n\treturn FileResponse(path)",

' error' : ''}`; setTimeout(() => { node.className = 'toast'; }, 4500); };\nconst formatTime = (value) => value ? new Date(value).toLocaleString([], {month:'short', day:'numeric', hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'}) : '—';\nconst setBusy = (button, busy, label) => { button.disabled = busy; if (busy) { button.dataset.label = button.innerHTML; button.innerHTML = `${label} <span>…</span>`; } else { button.innerHTML = button.dataset.label; } };\nconst validate = (input, errorNode) => { const valid = input.value.trim().length > 0; input.classList.toggle('invalid', !valid); errorNode.textContent = valid ? '' : 'Enter a license plate.'; return valid; };\nlet currentPage = 1;\nasync function refreshDashboard() { const dashboard = await api('/api/dashboard'); $('#total-spots').textContent = dashboard.total; $('#available-spots').textContent = Object.values(dashboard.available).reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0); $('#occupied-spots').textContent = dashboard.occupied; $('#ev-spots').textContent = dashboard.available.ev; $('#ev-status').textContent = dashboard.ev_available ? '' : 'Enter a license plate.'; return valid; };\nlet currentPage = 1;\nasync function refreshDashboard() { const dashboard = await api('/api/dashboard'); $('#total-spots').textContent = dashboard.total; $('#available-spots').textContent = Object.values(dashboard.available).reduce((a,b) => a+b, 0); $('#occupied-spots').textContent = dashboard.occupied; $('#ev-spots').textContent = dashboard.available.ev; $('#ev-status').textContent = dashboard.ev_available ? 'Charger ready' : 'All occupied'; $('#updated').textContent = `Updated ${new Date().toLocaleTimeString([], {hour:'2-digit', minute:'2-digit'})}`; const availabilityMarkup = Object.entries(dashboard.available).map(([type,count]) => `<div class=\"availability-item ${type === 'ev' ? 'ev' : ''}\"><strong>${count}</strong><span>${type} available</span></div>`).join(''); $('#availability').innerHTML = availabilityMarkup; $('#dashboard-availability').innerHTML = availabilityMarkup; const history = await api('/api/transactions?page=1&page_size=5'); $('#activity').innerHTML = history.transactions.length ? history.transactions.map(t => `<div class=\"activity-row\"><time>${formatTime(t.exit_time)}</time><span><strong>${t.plate}</strong> checked out at ${t.spot_id}</span><span class=\"fee\">₹${Number(t.fee).toFixed(2)}</span></div>`).join('') : '<div class=\"empty\">No completed activity yet.</div>'; $('#upcoming-reservations').innerHTML = dashboard.upcoming_reservations.length ? dashboard.upcoming_reservations.map(r => `<div class=\"reservation-row\"><span><strong>${r.confirmation_code}</strong> · ${r.plate}</span><span>${r.vehicle_type.toUpperCase()} · ${r.status.replaceAll('_',' ')}</span>${r.status === 'paid' ? `<button class=\"convert-reservation\" data-code=\"${r.confirmation_code}\">Check in</button>` : '<small>Awaiting payment</small>'}</div>`).join('') : '<div class=\"empty\">No upcoming reservations.</div>'; }\nasync function refreshReports() { const data = await api('/api/reports'); $('#revenue-today').textContent = `₹${Number(data.revenue_today).toFixed(2)}`; $('#revenue-week').textContent = `₹${Number(data.revenue_week).toFixed(2)}`; $('#average-stay').textContent = data.average_stay_minutes; $('#occupancy-bars').innerHTML = Object.entries(data.occupancy).map(([type, item]) => `<div class=\"bar-row ${type}\"><span>${type.toUpperCase()}</span><div class=\"bar\"><i style=\"width:${item.percentage}%\"></i></div><strong>${item.percentage}%</strong></div>`).join(''); }\nasync function loadHistory() { const params = new URLSearchParams({page: currentPage, page_size: 10}); const plate = $('#history-filter').value.trim(); if (plate) params.set('plate', plate); if ($('#from-date').value) params.set('from_date', $('#from-date').value); if ($('#to-date').value) params.set('to_date', $('#to-date').value); const data = await api(`/api/transactions?${params}`); $('#transaction-count').textContent = `${data.total} completed`; $('#page-label').textContent = `Page ${data.page} of ${data.pages}`; $('#previous-page').disabled = data.page <= 1; $('#next-page').disabled = data.page >= data.pages; $('#history-body').innerHTML = data.transactions.length ? data.transactions.map(t => `<tr><td><strong>${t.plate}</strong></td><td><span class=\"type\">${t.vehicle_type}</span></td><td>${t.spot_id}</td><td>${formatTime(t.entry_time)}</td><td>${formatTime(t.exit_time)}</td><td class=\"money-cell\">₹${Number(t.fee).toFixed(2)}</td></tr>`).join('') : '<tr><td colspan=\"6\" class=\"empty\">No matching transactions.</td></tr>'; }\nasync function updatePreview() { const type = $('#check-in-form select').value; const data = await api(`/api/spots/availability/${type}`); const fallback = type === 'compact' ? 'standard' : 'compact'; const fallbackData = type === 'ev' ? null : await api(`/api/spots/availability/${fallback}`); let text = data.is_free ? `${type.toUpperCase()} spot available — preferred assignment.` : fallbackData?.is_free ? `${type.toUpperCase()} full — overflow capacity will be used.` : `${type.toUpperCase()} unavailable — check-in will be rejected.`; $('#spot-preview').textContent = text; $('#spot-preview').style.borderColor = data.is_free ? 'var(--acid)' : fallbackData?.is_free ? 'var(--orange)' : 'var(--danger)'; }\nfunction wireValidation(input, errorSelector) { return validate(input, $(errorSelector)); }\nfor (const tab of document.querySelectorAll('.tab')) tab.addEventListener('click', async () => { document.querySelectorAll('.tab,.tab-panel').forEach(node => node.classList.remove('active')); tab.classList.add('active'); $(`#tab-${tab.dataset.tab}`).classList.add('active'); if (tab.dataset.tab === 'history') await loadHistory(); if (tab.dataset.tab === 'reports') await refreshReports(); });\n$('#check-in-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const form = event.target; const input = form.elements.plate; if (!wireValidation(input, '[data-error=\"plate\"]')) return; const button = form.querySelector('button'); setBusy(button, true, 'Assigning'); try { const data = await api('/api/check-in', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({plate: input.value, vehicle_type: form.elements.vehicle_type.value})}); toast(`${data.ticket.plate} assigned to ${data.ticket.spot_id}`); form.reset(); await Promise.all([refreshDashboard(), refreshReports()]); updatePreview(); } catch (error) { toast(error.message, true); } finally { setBusy(button, false); } });\n$('#check-out-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const form = event.target; const input = form.elements.plate; if (!wireValidation(input, '[data-error=\"checkout-plate\"]')) return; const button = form.querySelector('button'); setBusy(button, true, 'Calculating'); try { const data = await api('/api/check-out', {method:'POST', body: JSON.stringify({plate: input.value})}); toast(`${data.ticket.plate} checked out. } });\n$('#search-form').addEventListener('submit', async (event) => { event.preventDefault(); const form = event.target; const input = form.elements.plate; if (!wireValidation(input, '[data-error=\"search-plate\"]')) return; const button = form.querySelector('button'); setBusy(button, true, 'Searching'); try { const data = await api(`/api/vehicle/${encodeURIComponent(input.value)}`); const t = data.ticket; $('#search-result').className = 'search-result'; $('#search-result').innerHTML = `<strong>${t.plate}</strong>${t.vehicle_type.toUpperCase()} · ${t.spot_id} · Level ${t.level}<br>Parked since ${formatTime(t.entry_time)}`; } catch (error) { $('#search-result').className = 'search-result empty'; $('#search-result').textContent = error.message; } finally { setBusy(button, false); } });\ndocument.querySelectorAll('#check-in-form input[name=\"plate\"], #check-out-form input[name=\"plate\"], #search-form input[name=\"plate\"]').forEach(input => input.addEventListener('input', () => { input.value = input.value.toUpperCase(); }));\ndocument.addEventListener('click', async (event) => { const button = event.target.closest('.convert-reservation'); if (!button) return; button.disabled = true; button.textContent = 'Checking in…'; try { const data = await api(`/api/reservations/${button.dataset.code}/check-in`, {method:'POST'}); toast(`${data.ticket.plate} checked in at ${data.ticket.spot_id}`); await refreshDashboard(); } catch (error) { toast(error.message, true); loadHistory(); });\ndocument.querySelector('#logout-button')?.addEventListener('click', async () => { await api('/api/auth/logout', {method:'POST'}); location.href = '/login'; }); Promise.all([refreshDashboard(), refreshReports(), updatePreview(), api('/api/auth/me').then(data => { $('#staff-name').textContent = data.user.name; $('#staff-email').textContent = data.user.email; $('#staff-avatar').textContent = data.user.name.slice(0, 2).toUpperCase(); }).catch(() => {})]).catch(error => toast(error.message, true)); setInterval(() => refreshDashboard().catch(() => {}), 7000);\n",
